# Secrets Vault

Profile-wide encrypted credential vault for DeepSeek Harness. Open **Secrets Vault** in the sidebar or the chat input's **+** menu. Create a unique master passphrase (at least 12 characters) and save the random 256-bit recovery key shown once in the private dialog separately, outside Harness. Losing both makes recovery impossible.

## Node.js core and storage

Version 2 uses only Node.js built-ins: asynchronous scrypt (N=32768, r=8, p=1, 64 MiB maximum memory) and AES-256-GCM with random salts/nonces and authenticated format headers. No Python, SQLCipher, native addon, installation script or bundled interpreter. Import the independent storage API through the `./core` package export; it has no DSH dependencies. The adapter owns profile resolution, recovery and private UI authorization.

The selected profile holds `secrets-vault/vault.v2.json` and `vault.v2.json.recovery.json`. Metadata and secrets are encrypted; directory permissions are 0700 and files 0600 on POSIX. Root selection is explicit `profileDirectory`, then `DSH_PROFILE_DIR`, then an outer native `node_modules/@mainframe/secrets-vault` alias resolving to this package (not pnpm's inner self-reference). Otherwise activation fails closed. Obsolete `python` overrides must be removed, not silently ignored.

The core serializes reads, writes, locking and rekeying. The Host also serializes entire recovery/UI/tool transactions for all sessions. Records carry revisions: stale UI edits, secret replacements and deletes fail rather than overwrite another session. Agents change allowed metadata against the current serialized revision. Each write creates a private exclusive random temporary file, syncs it, atomically renames it, then syncs the directory. Precommit failures retain old state; uncertain commits block further access until restart. This is a bounded whole-file store (32 MiB encrypted file, 4096 records), not an unbounded database. Physical power-loss testing has not been performed.

One Host owns the store for its lifetime, including when locked. A canonical-path in-process registry and atomically populated `.node-owner` directory reject a second owner; `.node-lock` also excludes older 2.0.x owners. After a crash, valid markers are recovered automatically **only when the recorded PID is confirmed absent**. Live/reused PIDs, ambiguous metadata and denied process probes remain blocked rather than risking concurrent writers. Empty legacy gates can be safely replaced atomically on POSIX. Never remove a marker while a Host might be running. Graceful disposal rejects new requests, drains admitted operations, wipes key buffers best effort and releases ownership, with no worker process to wait for. Interrupted preparation/cleanup may leave harmless token-named metadata directories; these are not credential data or backups.

The core is portable Node.js code, but POSIX permissions and directory fsync are currently tested on macOS. Windows filesystem durability/ACL behavior is not certified. Agent SSH operations still require local OpenSSH/Unix sockets; clipboard import still uses macOS `pbpaste`. Portable storage does not imply cross-platform support for every adapter operation.

## Upgrade to 2.0.7

Tool discovery now supports metadata-only `query`, `offset` and `limit` (1–100, default 100), returning `total` and `nextOffset` (`null` at the end). The catalog is bounded to 4096 records. Pages sort by updated descending, then id ascending; offsets describe the current catalog, not a snapshot. Changes may shift pages: restart at zero after a mutation. Per-record actions no longer clone the full catalog. One closed-schema tool retains eight actions; malformed or action-inapplicable fields now return static diagnostics instead of being silently ignored.

Queued cancellations are checked at admission and dequeue; clipboard import checks again before reading and saving. An initiated durable save is always awaited. Preparation attribution comes only from the trusted executing agent. Disposed/stale UI generations cannot retain a late recovery key. Owned teardown retries one transient EIO/EINTR/EBUSY release failure inside the original disposer; persistent failures propagate without deleting another owner's markers.

The DSH compatibility constraint is exactly `0.2.2-rc.1`, grounded in inspected runtime contracts and source/VM tests; neither older nor future runtime compatibility is claimed. This is not installed-profile or GUI acceptance.

### Historical 2.0.6 lifecycle repair

Host teardown became owned by an early Cordis effect: it closes admission synchronously, drains admitted transactions, then invokes owned store disposal (now with the bounded transient retry above). Ordinary `ctx.on('dispose')` listeners in previous versions were not lifecycle cleanup. After installing this repair, restart a Host that loaded an affected version: old leaked owners cannot safely be recovered by hot-reloading or publicly disposing another plugin's handle. Preserve all vault files and ownership markers; do not bypass ownership checks. Storage format and cryptography are unchanged.

## Lifetime and threat model

Unlock lasts until **Lock** or Host exit. Screen/browser lock, disconnect, closing a dialog and switching sessions do not lock it; there is no inactivity timer. Passwords go directly from the authenticated browser to the Host, never into configuration, chat, argv, environment or logs. Buffer keys are cleared best effort; managed strings and runtime copies cannot be reliably zeroized. The vault protects locked files, not malicious code with same-user filesystem/process access. No real credentials are used in tests.

React UI uses native slots, semantic `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, localized plugin metadata (English/Russian), an original SVG icon, focus-contained dialogs and native management-page layout contracts. UI copy follows the native DSH language live: Russian for `ru`, English for every other language. `locale/en.json` and `locale/ru.json` own the complete flat `ui` dictionaries and plugin metadata; run `node build-client.mjs` after editing them or `client.template.js` to regenerate the self-contained runtime `client.js`. The build-only shared locale helper embeds dictionaries and registers them through the native locale API, including English for other external languages regardless of their fallback chain. Stored UI errors retain translation keys so open dialogs and errors update without resending secrets. Tool descriptions/results and user-entered metadata are not translated. Source contracts do not establish pixel-level browser correctness.

## Upgrade from version 1

**SQLCipher files cannot be decrypted by this pure Node.js implementation. No automatic migrator is shipped.** Before upgrading an initialized v1 vault, retain the old plugin/runtime and backups. Any `vault.db` **or** `vault.db.recovery.json` beside the new format causes explicit refusal, including orphaned envelopes. They are never read, overwritten or deleted by v2. Use the previous plugin to access existing credentials; plan a separately reviewed private migration before changing an initialized deployment. Never erase an existing vault to get past this guard. An old advisory `vault.db.lock` alone is not vault data and is left untouched.

A deployment whose old Vault reports uninitialized can start v2 without migrating credentials. Version 2 uses a separate filename, so the previous runtime cannot mistake it for a SQLCipher database.

## Agent use

`secrets_vault` lists metadata/opaque IDs, prepares private forms, edits name/description/tags, imports explicitly requested clipboard contents, and performs scoped HTTPS/SSH operations. It cannot set/unlock a password, return/delete secrets, issue recovery keys or grant itself usage permission. Only the user enables **Allow agent use**; that grants access to any profile agent, not only one session.

- HTTPS: Bearer token or Basic password, exact configured HTTPS origin, no redirects/arbitrary headers; optional JSON body, bounded/redacted result, 30-second timeout. Requests may modify remote data.
- SSH: configured host/port/username, existing trusted `known_hosts`, no automatic host acceptance or forwarding. Keys pass over stdin to a private temporary ssh-agent (60-second lifetime), not a key file. Encrypted-key passphrases use a one-shot protected Unix socket askpass broker, never argv/environment/secret disk files. Commands may modify remote systems.
- Clipboard: explicit macOS import while unlocked; creates or replaces a record and always revokes agent-use permission. No background monitoring, secret tool argument, result or clipboard clearing.

Output redaction covers known raw, URL-encoded and base64 values **best effort**; malicious servers can encode or split secrets. Never authorize untrusted endpoints. Pending UI requests are checked every two seconds while connected; dismissing a request does not keep reopening it, but a new explicit access/prepare request opens it again.

## Backup and recovery

For a consistent backup, click **Lock**, then copy **both** `vault.v2.json` and `vault.v2.json.recovery.json` with no concurrent recovery/rotation. Ownership markers and temporary files are not backup data. The data file alone is insufficient even with the master password. Keep password/recovery credentials separately from the pair.

New setup issues a recovery key privately. **Recover vault** accepts it and a new master password; **Replace recovery key** requires fresh master-password authentication. Both rotate the data encryption password and recovery credential; existing agent permissions remain unchanged and should be reviewed after suspected compromise. Keys never enter tools/status/list/notifications/chat. The issuance dialog requires confirmation that the external copy was saved.

Independent password/recovery envelopes use AES-256-GCM and asynchronous scrypt, with purpose/version/generation-bound associated data. Rekey first durably stages the envelope and an authenticated encrypted previous-key bridge; unlock can resume either side of an interrupted data-file replacement, then removes the bridge. Invalid envelopes fail closed without password-only fallback. Recovery transactions are serialized by the Host. A standalone core user must likewise serialize multi-step envelope workflows.

Issuance is not exactly-once: after a lost response, unlock with the **new** master password, then replace the recovery key rather than retrying the consumed key. Setup interrupted after envelope creation but before data creation preserves the envelope and refuses overwrite. Old full backups remain recoverable with their old credentials; offline snapshots cannot be revoked.

## Performance and remaining limits

The CPU-only [discovery benchmark](./discovery-benchmark.mjs) uses synthetic metadata and disables filesystem/ownership work. In one 200-iteration local run, 4096-record full clone/sort took median 8.239 ms (p95 8.712), versus 0.280 ms (p95 0.290) for a 100-row page; a single-row lookup took 0.002 ms (p95 0.003). These are not end-to-end or cross-machine guarantees. Idle client polling is already status-only every two seconds; full UI catalog refresh remains explicit. The model-facing serialized tool schema/description/prompt grew from 2351 to 3313 UTF-8 bytes to expose paging and validation (not a measured token count).

Remote operations still occupy the shared Host transaction queue, delaying metadata and lock requests. Keeping that queue avoids changing secret/lock ordering; parallel remote execution needs a separate ownership design. HTTPS combines caller cancellation with a 30-second deadline, manual redirects and a 65536-byte response cap. SSH applies 30-second per-process limits, not one whole-transaction deadline; multiple process phases and cleanup can take longer. Cancellation cannot roll back remote side effects. Synthetic tests cover HTTPS deadline wiring/body cancellation and shared-queue release, not remote behavior.

## Verification

The full suite below launches local OpenSSH/key-generation integration: run it only when explicitly authorized. For source-only verification, select the other test files explicitly and exclude `operations.test.mjs` entirely; `http-synthetic.test.mjs` replaces fetch and never connects.

Run `node --test *.test.mjs core/*.test.mjs` from this package directory. No Python provisioning or optional silent integration skips. Tests use isolated synthetic stores only, covering encryption, restart/rekey, corruption, ownership, concurrent writes and revision conflicts, atomic-failure boundaries, symlinks, disposal, private recovery and UI/tool authorization. Operations tests additionally launch local OpenSSH helpers with synthetic keys. GUI rendering and Windows/Linux platform behavior require separate verification.

# MAINFRAME

MAINFRAME provides reusable instructions, skills, agents, commands, and hooks
for coding agents. Each component has one product-neutral source. Maintained
adapters translate that source into the native layouts of **Codex** and
**ZCode Desktop**.

This repository also develops four separate **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** plugins.
Each is built as its own package and installed into a DSH profile through DSH's
native manager. [DSH plugin guide](docs/installation/dsh-adapter.md)

[![GitHub Actions on main](https://github.com/CATWILLgh/MAINFRAME/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/CATWILLgh/MAINFRAME/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain)
![Installer Python 3.11 or newer](https://img.shields.io/badge/installer%20Python-3.11%2B-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)
![GitHub CI Python 3.12](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20CI%20Python-3.12-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)

## Where MAINFRAME installs

The versions below identify the latest full delivery mapping maintained here
for each surface. The native guides record earlier and scoped-update versions.
Delivery checks establish file and configuration convergence. Native discovery,
permissions, event execution, and model behavior require separate evidence on
the requested surface.

| Product | Full delivery mapping | Other maintained paths |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Codex Desktop](docs/installation/codex-installer.md) | Engine `0.167.0-alpha.4.1` | `0.166.0-alpha.5.1` and `0.167.0-alpha.3.2` support skill-only updates of an existing installation. |
| [Codex CLI](docs/installation/codex-installer.md) | Engine `0.153.4` | Read-only native discovery is available on the inspected CLI. |
| [ZCode Desktop](docs/installation/zcode-installer.md) | Build `3.18.0.10300` | Build `3.17.2.9661` supports skill-only updates of an existing installation. |

Some hooks have narrower native bindings. Codex retains partial shell guards
where the host omits the actual tool working directory, and both adapters
retain useful code-quality and Fallow behavior within their event limits.
ZCode's installed hook bindings cover the primary runtime. The installer reports
unsupported full contracts and retained partial bindings. [Codex mapping](docs/installation/native/codex.md) · [ZCode mapping](docs/installation/native/zcode.md)

## Install or update MAINFRAME

Use the checked-out repository as the open project in the product you want to
configure. Run the maintained installer on macOS or Linux with Python 3.11 or
newer and Git.

1. Clone or update this repository.
2. Open this repository in Codex or ZCode Desktop.
3. Send [ADAPT-MAINFRAME.md](ADAPT-MAINFRAME.md) by itself as an attachment or
   file reference. The project's [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) defines this invocation.
4. Follow the returned activation handoff. Codex may require reviewing and
   trusting new hooks. ZCode asks you to refresh Skills when skill files changed.
   Use a new chat for discovery on the same surface.

The agent uses the maintained [installer](install.py) to plan, apply, and
verify. It resolves actual instruction conflicts before applying and records
delivery separately from native behavior in an ignored
`ADAPTATION.<product-id>.json`. Use the same route to update an existing
installation on a supported runtime. The per-product procedures also cover
scoped Desktop updates, hook controls, removal, and recovery. [Installation guide](docs/installation/README.md)

The installer prepares the analyzers needed by supported hook bindings and
the shared OpenSpec CLI when delivering its skill. It reuses compatible tools
or provisions their pinned distributions before activation. Some provisioning
paths need Node.js and npm. [Shared runtime and provisioning](docs/installation/components/integrations.md)

## What MAINFRAME delivers

The [inventory](ADAPTATION.example.json) lists 55 MAINFRAME components and
four DSH packages. Each global adapter delivers the MAINFRAME components its
native mapping supports.

| Canonical source | Native result |
| --- | --- |
| [Global instruction](instructions/global.md) | One owned section of the product's user-level instructions |
| [27 skills](skills/) | Global skill packages with their approved references, scripts, and assets |
| [7 roles](agents/) | Native agent or subagent profiles |
| [9 commands](commands/) | Explicit workflows projected into the product's command mechanism |
| [10 hooks](hooks/) | Canonical detectors bound to supported native events |
| [Credential helper](shared/credentials/mainframe-secret) | A compatible `mainframe-secret` command and integration with the non-secret index |

Root project instructions, source docs, installer modules, tests, local state,
and archives stay in the repository. The adapter delivers only the small
native transport required by a supported hook. [Payload boundary](docs/installation/README.md#repository-and-payload-boundary)

## Use MAINFRAME in a project

Open the project where you want the work done. Describe the task to select a
relevant skill, such as [testing](skills/mainframe-testing/SKILL.md),
[React frontend work](skills/mainframe-frontend/SKILL.md), or
[shipped-software analysis](skills/mainframe-leanrea/SKILL.md). The native role
profiles are available through the host's delegation mechanism on supported
surfaces. Hook behavior follows the host's supported events and activation state.

Invoke explicit workflows using the product's command mechanism. Codex
projects them as explicit-only skills. ZCode exposes slash commands and uses
a separate ticket-finder skill projection for noninteractive automations.
For example, invoke `$mainframe-project-skill` explicitly in Codex or send
`/mainframe-project-skill` as its own ZCode command to create or update the
current project's reusable skill. [Codex commands](docs/installation/native/codex.md#explicit-commands) · [ZCode commands](docs/installation/native/zcode.md#skills-and-explicit-commands)

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [todo](commands/todo.md) | Capture or update an idea in the current project's tracked queue |
| [mainframe-init](commands/mainframe-init.md) | Establish ownership and verification for one user-facing coordinating session |
| [mainframe-project-skill](commands/mainframe-project-skill.md) | Initialize, update, or extend the current project's evolving skill |
| [mainframe-tickets-init](commands/mainframe-tickets-init.md) | Initialize or migrate project ticket directories, format and root instructions |
| [mainframe-tickets-find](commands/mainframe-tickets-find.md) | Investigate random project areas and record or enrich deduplicated problem tickets |
| [mainframe-tickets-refine](commands/mainframe-tickets-refine.md) | Deeply investigate ticket execution paths, blast radius, and duplicates; route each outcome |
| [mainframe-tickets-implement](commands/mainframe-tickets-implement.md) | Implement, validate, and locally commit each ready engineering ticket sequentially |
| [mainframe-tickets-verify](commands/mainframe-tickets-verify.md) | Independently verify implemented tickets; edit only ticket records |

## DeepSeek Harness plugins

The four packages target DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`. Choose the ones you want for a
profile.

| Plugin | Capability |
| --- | --- |
| [Activity Analytics](plugins/dsh/activity-analytics/README.md) | Profile-local activity and agent-time summaries |
| [Message Time](plugins/dsh/message-time/README.md) | Timestamps for human messages and complete agent turns |
| [Secrets Vault](plugins/dsh/secrets-vault/README.md) | Encrypted profile-local credential storage |
| [Session Collaboration](plugins/dsh/session-collaboration/README.md) | Session discovery, messaging, waits, and lifecycle controls across projects |

Build versioned `.tgz` archives from the checkout, retain them in persistent
storage, and install or replace bundles with DSH's native `plugin_manager`.
Repository and archive checks cover package source and contents. Native profile
activation and visible behavior are verified separately. [Package, install, or update DSH plugins](docs/installation/dsh-adapter.md)

[Workspace Transfer Safe](plugins/dsh/workspace-transfer-safe/README.md) remains
a paused prototype excluded from the package build and supported installation.

## Verification and security

The GitHub badge tracks the workflow for branch `main`. For another revision,
use that revision's Actions result. The workflow
runs the repository, hook, and credential-helper tests, shell syntax, and
whitespace checks. Analyzer pins are maintained in the runtime installer and
the workflow. [Validation commands](CONTRIBUTING.md#validate-the-change) · [GitHub workflow](.github/workflows/ci.yml)

Installation preserves unrelated user configuration, authentication, histories,
sessions, memories, and projects. MAINFRAME sends no telemetry. The optional DSH
Activity Analytics plugin stores timing data within its profile. [Analytics storage](plugins/dsh/activity-analytics/README.md#storage-and-deployment) · [Security reporting](SECURITY.md)

# Session collaboration

MAINFRAME plugin **0.5.1**, pinned to DSH **0.2.2-rc.1**. One parameterized native tool coordinates ordinary conversations across projects, creates independent sessions, selects session-local models, and archives/unarchives sessions. No subagent spawning, global model-default changes, goal activation, forced stop or permission bypass.

## One tool, progressive actions

Call `collaboration` with a required `action` and only that action's fields. No MCP server, hidden setup or legacy aliases are needed. Agent-facing schemas, errors and peer envelopes are English regardless of UI language.

| Action | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `list_projects`, `list_sessions` | Discover projects and ordinary sessions without waking Agents; distinguish live idle from unloaded. Archived conversations opt-in. |
| `read` | Bounded selected history, state and optional goal without activation. |
| `send` | Enqueue peer context (`followup` default, or `steer`), optionally waking a cold target. Returns stable `taskId` and native `afterSeq`. Optional `label`/`group` support discovery. |
| `wait` | Observe 1–8 distinct `targets`, `any` or `all` (default), within one shared deadline. The singleton uses the same array shape. Stops observations only. |
| `list_tasks`, `get_task`, `cancel_task` | Caller-owned send metadata. Cancel affects observations/notices, **never target execution**. |
| `models` | Progressive, paged provider → model → exact reasoning-effort discovery, without a model run. |
| `create`, `archive`, `unarchive` | Create in an existing project; archive/unarchive another ordinary session. Archive checks inactivity without forcing work to stop. |
| `get_model`, `set_model` | Inspect or select one session's model; never change deployment defaults. |

For example: `{"action":"list_projects"}`, then `{"action":"list_sessions","workspaceId":"<returned-id>"}`. After send, observe with `{"action":"wait","targets":[{"sessionId":"<target-id>","afterSeq":42}]}` using the returned cursor, not the example value. Unknown fields, invalid action/field combinations and invalid nested targets reject before dispatch. The eight 0.4.0 tool names are no longer registered.

List → optionally read → send scoped requests with a common group → continue independent work. A session-window notice returns asynchronously. Use `notify:false` for replies/acknowledgments to avoid loops. Use send's `afterSeq` for manual waits; it is sampled before the durable pre-enqueue write, not an atomic inbox position. Tasks report observations, not delegated work success.

## Session lifecycle

- Discover an existing project with `collaboration({action:"list_projects"})`, then call `collaboration` with `{action:"create", workspaceId}`. Empty projects work. A missing project or unavailable directory rejects before creation; directory status is a preflight, not a filesystem transaction. Only `{workspaceId}` reaches public `sessionController.create`: no session reuse, cwd override, ancestry/origin, title or preset option. Native creation mounts the deployment's configured default preset and returns its selection when present; this is not an inferred per-project preset. The new session is independent and idle; the plugin sends no prompt/message, starts no model turn and rearms no goal. Configured preset initialization remains native-owned.
- Prefer `{action:"create", workspaceId, title:"Review installation"}` for agent-created sessions. Optional `title` accepts 1–200 Unicode code points and must normalize to visible text. The native title service applies its own normalization/byte limit and **pins** the accepted name against future automatic title generation. Success returns the accepted `title` and `titleStatus:"applied"`. Omission preserves old behavior and does not resolve an Agent for naming; peer-only conversations may stay unnamed because native auto-title requires genuine human input. No message source is spoofed: native `session/title` metadata is distinct from a human `user/message`.
- Naming and optional model selection are independent, non-atomic post-create operations. Uncertain naming returns `created-title-unknown`, uncertain model selection `created-model-unknown`, both `created-configuration-unknown`, always retaining the created ID and any confirmed sibling result. `titleStatus:"unknown"` means naming was not confirmed (possibly not attempted); an exception may occur after persistence. Inspect the directory/GUI rather than recreating, renaming again automatically, or deleting.
- Create returns `outcome:"created"` and the native session ID. Native attachment failure with explicit identity returns `created-unattached`; other attempted failures return `unknown`. **Never automatically retry creation**: creation can commit before an exception, cancellation, process exit or lost response. Inspect the session directory first. There is no idempotency/replay ledger, rollback or deletion.
- Discover archived IDs with `includeArchived:true`, then use `{action:"unarchive", sessionId}`. Only public `workspaceRegistry.unarchiveSession(id)` runs: no activation, message, goal rearming or history change. Ordinary forks are eligible; missing, self and subagent targets reject. Native repeated unarchive is idempotent. A failed native call returns `unknown`, not false success.
- `archive` uses public `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id)` **without `stopActivity`**. Passive state and final live-input checks reject observed running, queued or pending input; native activity checks also cover jobs, subagents and scheduled activity. No target is loaded just to archive it, and the plugin sends no stop/clear request. This intentionally follows native snapshot semantics, not the stronger restriction in 0.4.0. **It is not an atomic inactivity lock:** activity can begin between the check and durable archive. A running step may become hidden; a racing input can also be claimed by the native loop and then rejected by archive admission before transcript commitment. This is a real native input-loss edge case, not a guarantee that no work is affected. Avoid archiving a session that another actor is about to prompt. The plugin does not emulate locks or automatically unarchive on a race; either could lose queued input or undo an unrelated user action. Inspect uncertain outcomes before retrying.
- All lifecycle actions require the exact live caller. Inputs have no force/delete option. Cancellation or caller replacement observed during preflight prevents mutation. Once a native mutation is entered it is not cancellable; disposal drains the actual promise and does not claim rollback.

## Session-local models

Use `collaboration({action:"models"})` for registered providers, add `{provider}` for that provider's advertised models, and `{provider,model}` for exact reasoning efforts and the adapter's declared default, if any. Pages default to 30, max 100, and return IDs/names rather than full catalogs. Missing reasoning metadata means no advertised effort, not an invented capability; discovery failures are visible.

- `create` optionally accepts paired `provider` and `model` plus `reasoning_effort`. `set_model` requires the pair and another unarchived ordinary `sessionId`. Unknown providers/models and unsupported explicit efforts fail before create/resolve/selection. Native `llm.resolveCallConfig` performs exact effort validation; its materialized defaults are deliberately not persisted.
- **Omit `reasoning_effort` for Auto**, including when switching models. It never inherits the old model's effort. There is no synthetic `auto` ID: only discovered IDs may be explicit.
- `set_model` may resume a cold Agent but starts no prompt, model run or goal. It calls the public Agent's complete `model.select` with the requested choice, never `sessionController.selectModel` (that API also saves the deployment default). Success returns `selection`, `appliedFrom:"next-unprepared-step"`, `defaultChanged:false`; an already prepared/running step is unaffected. Native Agent selection records `model/selection` for ordinary resume; the plugin owns no duplicate persistence.
- `get_model` reads only a live Agent's public `model.current()`. Cold sessions return `outcome:"unknown",loaded:false`, without activation or inference from global defaults. A live choice is not necessarily the prepared step currently running.
- Creation and subsequent model selection are not atomic. A configuration failure preserves the fresh ID as `created-model-unknown`; inspect that ID and repair with `set_model` if needed, **never recreate automatically**. An uncertain set returns `unknown` and instructs inspection. Native attachment failure can leave a created session unconfigured. There is no rollback, delete, default update or force stop.
- Model operations share the lifecycle drain: cancellation before admission prevents mutation; once native resolve/create/select begins, that actual native promise is drained even if the caller cancels or the plugin unloads. Read-only metadata waits are abort-raced, including post-resolution revalidation on disposal; this can return an explicit partial/unknown configuration outcome while preserving the created ID. Scope and target identity are checked before selection; archive checks are preflights, not a native atomic archival lock. This public API cannot coordinate atomically with the GUI's private image-admission guard; selection does not establish compatibility with prior image history.

## Authority and effects

Native inbox messages use `createUserMessage` with `source.kind: 'session-collaboration'`, never human source `user`. Their native transcript role is `user`; that does not confer human authority. Peer history and labels are contextual data. Nothing changes goals or calls `sessionController.prompt`. Sending may spend tokens or trigger ordinary target tools under existing policy. Cold activation uses native `resolveAgent`; newly resumed goals remain disarmed. The plugin never disposes Host-owned Agents.

Peer envelopes put message content first and concise source/authority/reply guidance in a footer. Replies use `notify:false` to avoid automatic notice loops. Queue previews therefore lead with useful content, but the footer is not completely hidden: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1's public queue text slot passes whitespace facts, not trusted message-source metadata. A text-only hiding rule could mask ordinary user text, so no such Client hook is installed. Tool schemas, results and Agent-facing envelopes are English. Plugin metadata has Russian and English locale files; other locales fall back to English.

Self-send, archived and child/subagent targets are rejected; ordinary forks remain valid. No cold caller is resumed to notify. Notice delivery is allowed only for an exact live Agent that has naturally entered a model step (or invoked send). After restart/replacement, even an opened idle caller waits for its **next natural step**; safe pre-step handling preserves the native decision unchanged. Previously admitted live idle callers may be woken by a notice. Exact identity, archive state and abort signals are rechecked after the durable notice claim.

## Durable coordination and crash semantics

The public `storageDomain` service owns one schema-validated domain, `mainframe_session_collaboration`, version 1. Only bounded IDs, native cursors, timestamps, statuses, short labels and notification state are stored. **No message bodies, transcripts, output snapshots, error strings, permanent execution logs or send replay.** Native session logs remain the source for content. Labels are user/model supplied metadata, max 120 characters each; do not put sensitive message content in them.

- Every send persists a prepared task before target activation/enqueue. Initial storage failure prevents sending. Restarted prepared tasks become `delivery: unknown`; no resend or target activation occurs. An inbox exception is likewise ambiguous, not proof of non-delivery.
- Native inbox enqueue and metadata writes are not atomic. If enqueue succeeds but its acknowledgement write fails, the tool returns `accepted:true` with a persistence warning, rather than an error that invites duplicate sends. Recovery may show unknown delivery. Never automatically resend an unknown task.
- Accepted waiting observations recover without activating targets. Their original deadline does not reset. Terminal reason, observation time and cursor are retained; delayed notices contain metadata and retrieval instructions rather than pretending to reproduce historical output. Immediate notices may include bounded in-memory output.
- Automatic notice delivery is **at-most-once attempted**, not exactly-once or guaranteed delivery. A durable claim precedes the synchronous inbox call. Crash after claim, uncertain inbox failure, or loss of liveness during claim can lose the notice; recovery marks notification unknown and never retries that claim. Claim-write failure sends nothing and leaves ready metadata available for a later attempt. The owner can inspect tasks explicitly.
- Storage-open/recovery failure fails plugin initialization visibly. There is no silent in-memory production fallback or backup-and-skip archive. Ongoing storage failure suppresses unsafe notices; existing committed metadata remains the recovery point. Cancellation/expiry cannot retract an already claimed/enqueued notice.

## Bounds and retention

- Pending notices (`waiting`/`ready`): **8 per caller, 32 profile-wide**, including unloaded-caller notices. Capacity checks and durable changes are serialized. `notify:false` is tracked without an observer. In-flight prepared rows cannot be evicted.
- Metadata: **64 rows per caller, 256 profile-wide**. Oldest terminal rows can be evicted early for capacity; pending/prepared rows are never silently evicted. A full pending store rejects new sends before activation.
- All metadata has an **absolute 24-hour TTL from reservation**, including deferred notices; updates and restart never extend it. Expired rows are removed at startup, task access/send, and a 60-second maintenance pass while running. Storage outages/Host downtime can delay physical deletion until the next successful cleanup; expired rows cannot dispatch notices. This is bounded coordination state, not an audit log.
- Observation deadline: default 30 minutes, configurable 1 second–1 hour. Native waits use at most 120-second windows; unexpectedly fast repeated timeouts use abortable backoff. No target polling/activation is performed by the retention timer.
- Manual waits: default 30 seconds, max 120 seconds. Wait-many has 1–8 distinct targets, bounded per-target outcomes and a shared timeout; `any` cancels only other observers. Idle can follow failure/abort and is not causal completion. Native single-wait pre-sample timeout can throw.
- Discovery: default 30/max 100 rows; ordering may change between pages. Task pages default 20/max 64. Project session counts are membership counts, not guaranteed visible ordinary sessions.
- History: default 10/max 50 native message budget, max 100 returned records, default 12,000/max 32,000 text characters. Chronological returned records prioritize newest content for budget. Cold preparation may still load underlying logs. Reasoning/attachments omitted; tool markers opt-in, never payloads. `throughSeq` freezes the cursor and `nextBeforeSeq` retrieves older events; individually truncated text is not chunk-retrievable.
- Persisted active goals are not proof of live execution or armed continuation. Tool abort stops read/manual observation and prevents enqueue when detected before the boundary, not activation already underway. Detached watches survive send-tool completion; plugin disposal aborts observers, preserves durable state and never cancels target execution.

## Packaging and verification

The bundle mounts one Host plugin. Version 0.3.1 owns domain acquisition and sequential asynchronous cleanup through a Cordis effect, including failed setup and unload during initialization. Ordinary `ctx.on('dispose')` listeners are not lifecycle disposers. Upgrading a Host that already leaked an open domain under 0.2.1/0.3.0 requires a Host restart after installing the repair; do not close an unknown shared handle, erase storage, or repeatedly hot-retry. This fix preserves the domain name/version and stored records.

Exact runtime peers: LLM, session-title, storage-domain and Zod. `sessionTitle` is a hard injected dependency (the plugin cannot activate without it); no duplicate native implementation, build script or client code. Use the maintained MAINFRAME DSH installer; do not manually alter profile storage/configuration.

```sh
node --test plugins/dsh/session-collaboration/*.test.js
node --check plugins/dsh/session-collaboration/index.js
```

The exported `selftest.js` probe uses synthetic in-memory services/Agents only: no models, real sessions or profile mutations. Development tests cover crash boundaries, acknowledgement/claim failures, abort/disposal, duplicate suppression, restart/deadline/TTL, unloaded/replaced caller, ownership and capacity. Model tests cover the public `{agent}|{error}` resolve result, validation before mutation, Auto omission, passive cold reads, target replacement/archive checks, concurrent complete selections, uncertain outcomes and disposal draining. They do not establish native persistence or runtime/model behavior; selection-event persistence is based on the documented public Agent contract, and real-agent acceptance remains separate.

The 0.5.1 first-turn tool-definition JSON (compact array of `name`, `description`, `parameters`) is **4,936 characters / 4,938 UTF-8 bytes across one tool**, versus 4,746 / 4,748 in 0.5.0: **+190 characters/bytes** for explicit naming (about 4%). The earlier eight-tool 0.4.0 surface was 8,912 characters / 8,936 bytes. These are schema-size measurements, not prompt-token counts; no compatible tokenizer is installed locally. Model catalogs, efforts, selected histories and tracking rows remain deferred to bounded discovery results rather than repeated in the initial prompt.

## Where MAINFRAME installs

The versions below identify the latest full delivery mapping maintained here
for each surface. The native guides record earlier and scoped-update versions.
Delivery checks establish file and configuration convergence. Native discovery,
permissions, event execution, and model behavior require separate evidence on
the requested surface.

| Product | Full delivery mapping | Other maintained paths |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Codex Desktop](docs/installation/codex-installer.md) | Engine `0.167.0-alpha.4.1` | `0.166.0-alpha.5.1` and `0.167.0-alpha.3.2` support skill-only updates of an existing installation. |
| [Codex CLI](docs/installation/codex-installer.md) | Engine `0.153.4` | Read-only native discovery is available on the inspected CLI. |
| [ZCode Desktop](docs/installation/zcode-installer.md) | Build `3.18.0.10300` | Build `3.17.2.9661` supports skill-only updates of an existing installation. |

Some hooks have narrower native bindings. Codex retains partial shell guards
where the host omits the actual tool working directory, and both adapters
retain useful code-quality and Fallow behavior within their event limits.
ZCode's installed hook bindings cover the primary runtime. The installer reports
unsupported full contracts and retained partial bindings. [Codex mapping](docs/installation/native/codex.md) · [ZCode mapping](docs/installation/native/zcode.md)

## Install or update MAINFRAME

Use the checked-out repository as the open project in the product you want to
configure. Run the maintained installer on macOS or Linux with Python 3.11 or
newer and Git.

1. Clone or update this repository.
2. Open this repository in Codex or ZCode Desktop.
3. Send [ADAPT-MAINFRAME.md](ADAPT-MAINFRAME.md) by itself as an attachment or
   file reference. The project's [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) defines this invocation.
4. Follow the returned activation handoff. Codex may require reviewing and
   trusting new hooks. ZCode asks you to refresh Skills when skill files changed.
   Use a new chat for discovery on the same surface.

The agent uses the maintained [installer](install.py) to plan, apply, and
verify. It resolves actual instruction conflicts before applying and records
delivery separately from native behavior in an ignored
`ADAPTATION.<product-id>.json`. Use the same route to update an existing
installation on a supported runtime. The per-product procedures also cover
scoped Desktop updates, hook controls, removal, and recovery. [Installation guide](docs/installation/README.md)

The installer prepares the analyzers needed by supported hook bindings and
the shared OpenSpec CLI when delivering its skill. It reuses compatible tools
or provisions their pinned distributions before activation. Some provisioning
paths need Node.js and npm. [Shared runtime and provisioning](docs/installation/components/integrations.md)

The [inventory](ADAPTATION.example.json) lists 55 MAINFRAME components and
four DSH packages. Each global adapter delivers the MAINFRAME components its
native mapping supports.

| Canonical source | Native result |
| --- | --- |
| [Global instruction](instructions/global.md) | One owned section of the product's user-level instructions |
| [27 skills](skills/) | Global skill packages with their approved references, scripts, and assets |
| [7 roles](agents/) | Native agent or subagent profiles |
| [9 commands](commands/) | Explicit workflows projected into the product's command mechanism |
| [10 hooks](hooks/) | Canonical detectors bound to supported native events |
| [Credential helper](shared/credentials/mainframe-secret) | A compatible `mainframe-secret` command and integration with the non-secret index |

Root project instructions, source docs, installer modules, tests, local state,
and archives stay in the repository. The adapter delivers only the small
native transport required by a supported hook. [Payload boundary](docs/installation/README.md#repository-and-payload-boundary)

## Use MAINFRAME in a project

Open the project where you want the work done. Describe the task to select a
relevant skill, such as [testing](skills/mainframe-testing/SKILL.md),
[React frontend work](skills/mainframe-frontend/SKILL.md), or
[shipped-software analysis](skills/mainframe-leanrea/SKILL.md). The native role
profiles are available through the host's delegation mechanism on supported
surfaces. Hook behavior follows the host's supported events and activation state.

Invoke explicit workflows using the product's command mechanism. Codex
projects them as explicit-only skills. ZCode exposes slash commands and uses
a separate ticket-finder skill projection for noninteractive automations.
For example, invoke `$mainframe-project-skill` explicitly in Codex or send

current project's reusable skill. [Codex commands](docs/installation/native/codex.md#explicit-commands) · [ZCode commands](docs/installation/native/zcode.md#skills-and-explicit-commands)

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [todo](commands/todo.md) | Capture or update an idea in the current project's tracked queue |
| [mainframe-init](commands/mainframe-init.md) | Establish ownership and verification for one user-facing coordinating session |
| [mainframe-project-skill](commands/mainframe-project-skill.md) | Initialize, update, or extend the current project's evolving skill |
| [mainframe-tickets-init](commands/mainframe-tickets-init.md) | Initialize or migrate project ticket directories, format and root instructions |
| [mainframe-tickets-find](commands/mainframe-tickets-find.md) | Investigate random project areas and record or enrich deduplicated problem tickets |
| [mainframe-tickets-refine](commands/mainframe-tickets-refine.md) | Deeply investigate ticket execution paths, blast radius, and duplicates; route each outcome |
| [mainframe-tickets-implement](commands/mainframe-tickets-implement.md) | Implement, validate, and locally commit each ready engineering ticket sequentially |
| [mainframe-tickets-verify](commands/mainframe-tickets-verify.md) | Independently verify implemented tickets; edit only ticket records |

## DeepSeek Harness plugins

The four packages target DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`. Choose the ones you want for a
profile.

| Plugin | Capability |
| --- | --- |
| [Activity Analytics](plugins/dsh/activity-analytics/README.md) | Profile-local activity and agent-time summaries |
| [Message Time](plugins/dsh/message-time/README.md) | Timestamps for human messages and complete agent turns |

a paused prototype excluded from the package build and supported installation.

The GitHub badge tracks the workflow for branch `main`. For another revision,
use that revision's Actions result. The workflow
runs the repository, hook, and credential-helper tests, shell syntax, and
whitespace checks. Analyzer pins are maintained in the runtime installer and
the workflow. [Validation commands](CONTRIBUTING.md#validate-the-change) · [GitHub workflow](.github/workflows/ci.yml)

# Workspace Transfer Safe

## Status: paused / разработка отложена (2026-11-06)

**Not part of the installable MAINFRAME inventory.** Removed from the active DSH profile at the user's request. Keep this directory as development source; do not automatically reinstall or enable it during MAINFRAME updates. The implementation below describes an experimental prototype, not a supported feature.

**Почему отложено:** ограничений пока больше, чем пользы от необязательной функции переноса чатов.

- DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 сохраняет запущенный Host Agent после завершения генерации и переключения чата. Освобождение Client-ссылки не закрывает агент. В исследованном публичном API не найден безопасный способ эксклюзивно заморозить и закрыть существующий агент; холодный перенос требует перезапуска DSH.
- Нельзя снимать чужую блокировку записи, принудительно завершать агент или подменять безопасный перенос снимком живой истории: новые сообщения между копированием и архивированием могут потеряться для пользователя.
- Прототип принимает только закрытые обычные top-level истории v4. Ветки, уже перенесённые чаты, незавершённые ходы, очередь сообщений и активные задачи/напоминания блокируют перенос. Файлы, расписания и внешнее состояние не мигрируют; новый ID и безопасный сброс разрешений неизбежны в текущей реализации.
- Копирование и архивирование не являются единой транзакцией; частичный результат требует ручной проверки, а не слепого повтора. Штатного расширения sidebar для межпроектного drag-and-drop также не установлено.

**Когда вернуться:** после обновлений DSH повторно проверить поддерживаемый API переноса либо эксклюзивной приостановки/закрытия агента с сохранением истории, очередей и фоновой активности. Затем проверить целостность и сценарий из обычного открытого чата на искусственных данных, отдельно визуально проверить штатный диалог. Не ослаблять защитные отказы ради удобства. Повторная установка — только по явному запросу пользователя.

Последняя проверка прототипа 0.1.4: 78 автоматических тестов и native self-test на искусственных чатах прошли; реальный пользовательский перенос и отрисованный диалог не подтверждены. Это не снимает перечисленные ограничения.

## Prototype behavior

English: Minimal local DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 plugin. The conversation menu offers **Move to project…**. The source Host agent must be closed: switching chats only releases the Client view and does not close an activated Host agent. For an activated source, finish other work and restart DSH before retrying. Select an existing project and confirm. It creates a new seeded session ID, verifies the durable log and native projections, then archives the original last. The original log is never deleted. Restore the original through DSH's native archive UI if needed.

Русский: В меню разговора появится **Перенести в проект…**. Агент исходного чата на Host должен быть закрыт: переключение чата и остановка генерации его не закрывают. Для уже запущенного чата завершите другую работу и перезапустите DSH перед повторной попыткой. Выберите существующий проект и подтвердите. Будет создан новый ID, проверена сохранённая история, а оригинал архивирован последним. Безвозвратного удаления нет.

## Boundaries

- Current-format v4, non-seeded, top-level CLOSED sources only. Existing forks, subagents, incomplete turns, queued inbox messages, archived sources and active work are refused.
- Source writer ownership blocks cold resume for the full operation. No live Agent is closed automatically. No Agent or model is started to copy the history.
- The new header and final working-directory event both target the destination. Final permissions are read-only + ask; imported Auto identity is replaced with an ordinary configured preset before the restrictive overrides.
- Files are not copied. Attachment references remain unchanged within this profile. Old absolute paths/spill links may no longer work.
- Schedules remain attached to original IDs. Subagent catalogs, active goals, running jobs, pins and external state are not migrated. Inherited goals stay disarmed on native resume until explicitly resumed.
- Archive-last is not a cross-service atomic transaction. Native archive admission rechecks activity. If any post-copy step fails, the original stays present and a partial copy may remain. **Do not blindly retry**; inspect the reported copy ID and destination first.
- No external network clients, shell execution, lifecycle install scripts, registry doctor, bulk organization, rename override or permanent-delete route. The Client calls only the authenticated same-origin Host endpoint.

## Appearance

The Session action uses DSH's shared `contextMenus` renderer and native monochrome glyph, with the same icon/label columns, focus and keyboard behavior as built-in actions. It sits after “Reveal in Finder” and before the native archive divider, without an extra section. The plugin-manager icon uses transparent blue/teal artwork matching the other MAINFRAME plugins; it adds no nested background tile.

The transfer dialog uses the native Modal description/footer and short native buttons. Destination choices show project titles; the selected directory is shown separately. A concise copy/archive notice replaces the acknowledgement checkbox, and detailed restrictions are collapsed. `source-open`, active-work and seeded-source refusals are localized. This does not add support for transferring activated Host agents.

## Verification

`node --test tests/*.test.mjs` exercises transaction ordering and fail-closed behavior with disposable mocks. The opt-in `workspace_transfer` tool `self_test` creates only synthetic native session logs and temporary workspace registrations, validates the real storage/query/projection path, then archives the fixture logs and removes only the test registrations. Directories and logs are retained, never erased. It is not run at plugin activation. UI presence/rendering requires a connected DSH browser; installation alone does not prove it.

## Provenance

New local Host implementation and minimal Client UI informed by review of Stijnus/dsh-move-to-workspace v0.1.13 (MIT), supplied ZIP SHA256 `0b893b7db723205d33b4ec82dfca6bc5965bd64a8b582964f976e8fda5888257`. This is not installation of that unverified npm artifact. Original source: https://github.com/Stijnus/dsh-move-to-workspace . No guarantee of freedom from bugs or malicious behavior is implied by a bounded source audit.

| [Secrets Vault](plugins/dsh/secrets-vault/README.md) | Encrypted profile-local credential storage |
| [Session Collaboration](plugins/dsh/session-collaboration/README.md) | Session discovery, messaging, waits, and lifecycle controls across projects |

Build versioned `.tgz` archives from the checkout, retain them in persistent
storage, and install or replace bundles with DSH's native `plugin_manager`.
Repository and archive checks cover package source and contents. Native profile
activation and visible behavior are verified separately. [Package, install, or update DSH plugins](docs/installation/dsh-adapter.md)

[Workspace Transfer Safe](plugins/dsh/workspace-transfer-safe/README.md) remains
a paused prototype excluded from the package build and supported installation.

## Verification and security

The GitHub badge tracks the workflow for branch `main`. For another revision,
use that revision's Actions result. The workflow
runs the repository, hook, and credential-helper tests, shell syntax, and
whitespace checks. Analyzer pins are maintained in the runtime installer and
the workflow. [Validation commands](CONTRIBUTING.md#validate-the-change) · [GitHub workflow](.github/workflows/ci.yml)

Installation preserves unrelated user configuration, authentication, histories,
sessions, memories, and projects. MAINFRAME sends no telemetry. The optional DSH
Activity Analytics plugin stores timing data within its profile. [Analytics storage](plugins/dsh/activity-analytics/README.md#storage-and-deployment) · [Security reporting](SECURITY.md)

# 贴纸相册：聊天页插件弹层示例 [English](README.en.md) 一个放在聊天页「插件」弹层和「全部功能」里的贴纸面板，演示视图 v2 的四样东西：图集（`gallery`）、空状态（`emptyState`）、环形进度（`progress.shape: "ring"`）和趋势线（`metric.trend`），整块跟随用户在 App 里选的主题色（`accent: "app"`）。贴纸是包里自带的四张小图（`assets/stickers/`），不联网。 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-go-example-album ``` 需要主机提供 `dsh-go-bridge`。装好后打开任一对话，输入框上方胶囊行最后多一枚「插件」，点开就是这个面板；「全部功能」里也有一份。 - 点一张贴纸：它的名字放进输入框，不发送。长按任一张：App 的看图页，左右滑看这一组，保存和分享是 App 的动作。 - 「清空」之后是空状态，按钮「放回」把示例贴纸放回来。 - 老 App 不认图集和空状态：用 SDK 的 `adaptView` 能换成图片和提示条（见测试）。 `lib/view.js` 只产生有界 JSON，`lib/index.js` 注册面板并处理三个动作。在仓库内验证： ```sh node --test examples/plugins/dsh-go-example-album/test/*.test.js node sdk/plugin-kit/bin/check.mjs examples/plugins/dsh-go-example-album --load ``` 诊断里的颜色校正是正常提示。组件的写法见[组件目录](../../../docs/plugins/components.md)，弹层见[网页面板](../../../docs/plugins/web-panels.md)。

简体中文 · English

DeepSeek Harness 的手机应用：Android 版已发布；iOS 版仍在开发和真机测试，需在 Mac 上自行签名编译（iOS 工程 · 架构）。


Trendshift 全语言日榜 #1 · 2026-10-30


Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。


下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

 

感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱！当前下载页提供 Android APK；iOS 版还在开发和真机测试，没有公开安装包，鸿蒙版也在继续推进。

第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。


本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。


插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。


原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。


分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。


横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。


主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。


中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。


手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。敏感操作默认交还给你；放宽应用规则或解除限制前，请先了解风险。


## 可以做什么 DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。 - **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。 - **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。 - **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。 - **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。 - **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。 - **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。 功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。 ## 安装 安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。 1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。 2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。 3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。 仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。 本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。 ## 数据与权限 模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。 “发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。 ## 风险提示与免责声明 DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 无关联，也不代表 DeepSeek。使用前请了解： - **AI 并非万无一失**：回答、代码和操作可能出错，也可能被网页、消息或文件中的恶意指令误导。请核验重要结果；医疗、法律、投资等高风险决策不应仅依赖 AI 输出。 - **工具会产生真实影响**：本机或远程主机上的命令、文件修改及手机操控可能导致数据丢失、隐私泄露、账号、资金或设备损失。免确认、放宽应用规则或解除限制会减少保护；确认与拦截机制不能保证消除所有风险。建议保留默认保护，只授予必要权限，不在存有支付或银行信息的设备上解除限制。详见[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。 - **第三方服务与费用**：模型、远程主机和插件等按各自条款运行；相关数据处理、服务可用性和费用取决于你选择的服务与配置。本机运行不等于模型离线，也不代表数据不会离开设备。 - **使用前做好防护**：备份重要数据，只连接可信主机、安装可信插件，留意模型用量与费用；不要让 AI 无人值守地处理不可逆或高风险任务。 - **无担保与责任范围**：在适用法律允许的范围内，本软件按“现状”提供，不保证准确性、持续可用性或满足特定用途；相关无担保及责任限制见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 第 15–17 条。本声明不排除或限制依法不得排除或限制的责任，也不减损你依法享有的权利。 ## 常见问题
和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？
没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。
安全吗？
本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。
切到后台会被杀吗？
部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。
对手机有什么要求？
Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。
开源吗？
开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。再发布和 fork 时的署名要求见[授权范围与再发布](#授权范围与再发布)。
## 从源码构建 以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。 先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git cd dsh-go bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh source tooling/env.sh flutter --version java -version bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon ``` 工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。 产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。 构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时： ```bash bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64 DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon ``` 未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。 只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行： ```bash DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all ``` ## 目录 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `app/` | Flutter 界面、Android Kotlin 实现与开发中的 iOS Swift/WidgetKit 实现 | | `packages/dsh_client/` | DSH Web API 的 Dart 客户端 | | `packages/dsh_remote/` | DSH Remote 的 Dart 客户端 | | `runtime/` | Android Linux 运行时、iOS 运行时特化、引擎补丁与 App 桥接 | | `sdk/plugin-kit/` | 原生插件作者工具包；在仓库中使用，未发布到 npm | | `examples/plugins/` | 插件示例 | | `docs/guide/`、`docs/plugins/`、`docs/pets/`、`docs/live2d/` | 用户指南、插件开发、宠物包与 Live2D 伙伴制作 | | `docs/assets/` | 本页用到的展示图、桌宠动图和社群二维码 | | `tooling/` | 工具链、Android APK/iOS 开发构建与诊断脚本 | | `services/`、`site/`、`infra/` | 配套分享服务、网站和部署材料 | ## 参与贡献 问题反馈和改进建议可提交到 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues)。代码、文档和翻译贡献请先看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。插件作者可以从[插件教程](docs/plugins/README.md)和 [SDK](sdk/plugin-kit/README.md)开始。 安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 报告，避免在公开 Issue 中提交漏洞细节或凭据。 ## # 文件摘要 在插件面板点「文件」或「图片」，系统选择器允许最多 4 个文件（单个 8 MiB、合计 16 MiB）。内容经当前主机连接上传；插件在选择回调里读取真实字节，显示文件名、实际字节数与 SHA-256。不会自动发消息、调用模型或保留文件副本。面板的摘要随数据订阅生命周期保留；重新订阅后从空状态开始。 本示例仅依赖 NA v1.3 的 `files`，视图全部使用既有 v1 组件，故 F3 可单独应用。完整第二期样式和表单见同批 F1/F2 示例。旧 App 或无能力的连接显示说明文字，无选择按钮。现阶段 Android 适配器及本地/SSH 直连可协商；DSH Remote 中转不可用。 在带本轮桥的主机安装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-go-example-files ``` 开发验证（仓库根目录）： ```sh node sdk/plugin-kit/bin/check.mjs examples/plugins/dsh-go-example-files node --test examples/plugins/dsh-go-example-files/test/*.test.js node --test runtime/tests/native-files.test.mjs ``` 第三个命令通过真实 HTTP/WebSocket、生产桥路由和本示例 handler 验证读取与摘要，不需要 DSH 引擎。系统选择器 UI 和远程设备仍需本机验证，详见[作者文档](../../../docs/plugins/files.md)。 句柄只在被等待的选择回调内有效；长任务需在回调结束前复制或持久化字节。`file.name` 不是路径，MIME 不是内容校验结果。桥接只读交付不等于隔离宿主 Node 插件的沙箱。

简体中文 · English

DeepSeek Harness 的手机应用：Android 版已发布；iOS 版仍在开发和真机测试，需在 Mac 上自行签名编译（iOS 工程 · 架构）。


Trendshift 全语言日榜 #1 · 2026-10-30


Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。


下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

 

感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱！当前下载页提供 Android APK；iOS 版还在开发和真机测试，没有公开安装包，鸿蒙版也在继续推进。

第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。


本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。


插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。


原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。


分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。


横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。


主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。


中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。


手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。敏感操作默认交还给你；放宽应用规则或解除限制前，请先了解风险。


## 可以做什么 DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。 - **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。 - **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。 - **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。 - **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。 - **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。 - **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。 功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。 ## 安装 安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。 1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。 2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。 3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。 仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。 本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。 ## 数据与权限 模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。 “发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。 ## 风险提示与免责声明 DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 无关联，也不代表 DeepSeek。使用前请了解： - **AI 并非万无一失**：回答、代码和操作可能出错，也可能被网页、消息或文件中的恶意指令误导。请核验重要结果；医疗、法律、投资等高风险决策不应仅依赖 AI 输出。 - **工具会产生真实影响**：本机或远程主机上的命令、文件修改及手机操控可能导致数据丢失、隐私泄露、账号、资金或设备损失。免确认、放宽应用规则或解除限制会减少保护；确认与拦截机制不能保证消除所有风险。建议保留默认保护，只授予必要权限，不在存有支付或银行信息的设备上解除限制。详见[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。 - **第三方服务与费用**：模型、远程主机和插件等按各自条款运行；相关数据处理、服务可用性和费用取决于你选择的服务与配置。本机运行不等于模型离线，也不代表数据不会离开设备。 - **使用前做好防护**：备份重要数据，只连接可信主机、安装可信插件，留意模型用量与费用；不要让 AI 无人值守地处理不可逆或高风险任务。 - **无担保与责任范围**：在适用法律允许的范围内，本软件按“现状”提供，不保证准确性、持续可用性或满足特定用途；相关无担保及责任限制见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 第 15–17 条。本声明不排除或限制依法不得排除或限制的责任，也不减损你依法享有的权利。 ## 常见问题
和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？
没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。
安全吗？
本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。
切到后台会被杀吗？
部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。
对手机有什么要求？
Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。
开源吗？
开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。再发布和 fork 时的署名要求见[授权范围与再发布](#授权范围与再发布)。
## 从源码构建 以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。 先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git cd dsh-go bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh source tooling/env.sh flutter --version java -version bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon ``` 工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。 产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。 构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时： ```bash bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64 DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon ``` 未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。 只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行： ```bash DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all ``` ## 目录 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `app/` | Flutter 界面、Android Kotlin 实现与开发中的 iOS Swift/WidgetKit 实现 | | `packages/dsh_client/` | DSH Web API 的 Dart 客户端 | | `packages/dsh_remote/` | DSH Remote 的 Dart 客户端 | | `runtime/` | Android Linux 运行时、iOS 运行时特化、引擎补丁与 App 桥接 | | `sdk/plugin-kit/` | 原生插件作者工具包；在仓库中使用，未发布到 npm | | `examples/plugins/` | 插件示例 | | `docs/guide/`、`docs/plugins/`、`docs/pets/`、`docs/live2d/` | 用户指南、插件开发、宠物包与 Live2D 伙伴制作 | | `docs/assets/` | 本页用到的展示图、桌宠动图和社群二维码 | | `tooling/` | 工具链、Android APK/iOS 开发构建与诊断脚本 | | `services/`、`site/`、`infra/` | 配套分享服务、网站和部署材料 | ## 参与贡献 问题反馈和改进建议可提交到 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues)。代码、文档和翻译贡献请先看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。插件作者可以从[插件教程](docs/plugins/README.md)和 [SDK](sdk/plugin-kit/README.md)开始。 安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 报告，避免在公开 Issue 中提交漏洞细节或凭据。 ## ## 友情链接 - **[DSH-TUI](https://dshtui.com/)**：同一作者的作品，面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式终端界面。手机上用 DSH Go，电脑上就用它——像素鲸鱼、实时状态、时间回溯，装上即开工（[GitHub](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI)）。 ## 授权范围与再发布 代码以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 开源，欢迎 fork 学习、自用和二次开发。请尊重原作者和项目来源： - **改造前请提前联系作者**：如需基于本项目进行改造、二次开发或衍生产品发布，请先通过 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues) 或[社区](#community)联系原作者 ccch1mneyyy，说明用途与计划。 - **fork 请标注主仓库与作者**：基于本仓库改造并发布时，请在仓库说明、应用「关于」页和发布页面清楚标注主仓库 与原作者 [ccch1mneyyy](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy)，并按适用许可证保留版权、许可及修改声明。 - **禁止未授权商业化套皮**：不得未经授权将本项目的品牌标识、Deepy、鲸娘等受保护素材用于套皮售卖、收费分发或其他商业产品；不得违反适用许可证，删除应保留的版权与许可声明、闭源分发衍生代码，或冒充原作者、官方版本。 - **名称与素材另有限制**：DSH Go 的名称、标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘形象不在 AGPL 授权范围内，以修改版身份发布时请换成自己的名称和素材，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。 **许可说明**：AGPL-3.0 允许符合其条款的修改、再发布和商业使用；上述提前联系及署名位置是作者的协作请求，不是对代码许可证追加的限制。品牌与素材须遵守各自的授权条件；本说明不改变 `sdk/`、`examples/` 及第三方内容的许可。 ## 许可证与致谢 本项目采用 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE)；`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 保持 **MIT**。第三方代码和素材以各自声明为准。 - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：DSH Go 运行和连接的就是它。 - [DSH-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI)：吉祥物 Deepy 小鲸鱼和鲸娘来自这里。 Phase 相关代码经作者授权按 MIT 许可使用。DeepSeek Harness、PiPilot、DS Bot、DSH Remote 及其他第三方组件、素材保留各自的许可证和署名。具体来源和条款见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 DSH Go 的名称、标识、Deepy 小鲸鱼和鲸娘等形象不在 AGPL 授权范围内，使用条款见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。 远程连接协议与 [ds-harness-remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote)（MIT）兼容；来源与条款见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

# 网页浮层与三槽示例 [English](README.en.md) 一个仅有网页界面的 DSH 插件：可拖动、可点击计数的小按钮，加上三个常见长尾 slot。它不声明原生 `dshGo` 贡献，不新增原生 `pets` / `bubbles` / `actions` 协议，也不做跨 App 悬浮。 ## 包的约定 - [清单](package.json) 使用真实的 `exports["./client"]`、`dsh.client.platform: "web"` 和 [bundle patch](cordis.patch.yml)，不是原生插件 SDK 清单。声明适用 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 至 0.3 之前；未做逐版本运行验证。 - [网页源码](lib/client.js) 通过宿主 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 加载，用 `require("react")` 取得宿主已有的 React，随后 `ctx.slots.inject/register` 注册。没有 npm 依赖、JSX、打包器、下载脚本或额外构建链；无需 `npm install`。 - 参考本仓库真实的 [route probe](../../../runtime/tests/route-probe/client.js) 和 [bridge 清单](../../../runtime/bridge/dsh-go-bridge/package.json)，不是凭空发明加载协议。[引擎半侧](lib/index.js) 不注册服务或执行操作。 | Slot | 示例 | 在 App 中 | |---|---|---| | `shell.overlay` | 拖动按钮；轻点计数，键盘也可激活 | 详情显式启用后显示在聊天内容区 | | `sidebar.footer.action` | 侧栏底部计数按钮 | 详情 → 侧栏入口，单包整页岛 | | `settings.plugins.tab` | 带计数按钮的插件设置页签正文 | 详情 → 插件设置页，单包整页岛 | | `plugins.detail.section` | 本插件详情分区（按 `subject.pkg.name` 过滤） | 详情 → 插件详情扩展，单包整页岛 | 网页上的示例标题为英文且各不相同。稳定 cell id 都带包名前缀。点击与位置状态只在当前组件挂载期间保存，不读写文件、网络、剪贴板或音频。 ## 手动使用（本轮没有执行） 在具备网页界面及桥接的本机引擎上，由用户主动安装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-go-example-overlay ``` 在 App 插件详情的「App 内界面」开启「在 App 内显示浮层」。这是**本机按主机保存**的偏好；不是安装即开启。主机 `ui.json` 的 `plugins.seats` 显式值优先，例如合并以下设置可显式启用；改成 `hidden` 则关闭，不要覆盖现有其他键： ```json {"version":1,"plugins":{"seats":{"shell.overlay":{"dsh-go-example-overlay":"island"}}}} ``` 手动验收： 1. 未启用时浮层不显示；启用后只有本插件的 cell 出现，其他未启用包不能跟着出现。 2. 小按钮轻点加一，拖动不加一；空白区可操作聊天。拖到边缘后旋转屏幕 / 打开键盘，浮层应跟随原生聊天内容区的可用视口收缩，按钮不应丢到可用区域之外。该示例用 `calc(var(--dsh-go-island-top, 0px) + 16px)` / `calc(var(--dsh-go-island-bottom, 0px) + 16px)` 读取宿主 inset；内容区已保留原生顶栏 / 输入框，变量可以为 `0`，不再扣一次原生 chrome 高度。 3. 分别从详情打开三个长尾入口，核对标题与计数按钮；只有本包、本 cell，设置页签可确认选中；找不到目标应降级网页版，不报假成功。 4. 浮层严格裁在原生顶栏与输入框之间，不覆盖原生 chrome、抽屉、右侧详情或模态；未决审批 / 未答问题时停止，离开聊天页不出现浮层；关闭开关后浮层消失。切换主机核对开关独立，`ui.json` 显式值仍优先。 5. 卸载组件后重开，计数和拖动位置重置；卸载 / 重载插件不残留监听或元素。仅暂时隐藏或缓存的岛不等于组件已卸载。 ## 触摸、生命周期与限制 根容器 `pointer-events: none`，只有小按钮 `pointer-events: auto`；不放透明全屏点击层。按钮以 Pointer Events + pointer capture 完成拖动，处理 `pointerup`、`pointercancel`、失去 capture；卸载时释放 capture，并断开用于尺寸 / inset 变化的 ResizeObserver。React 卸载组件时撤销事件处理器，slot 注入随 Cordis 上下文释放；没有动画循环、计时器或 document 全局监听。 触摸穿透按**矩形而非像素透明度**；透明图片内的空像素仍可能占用触摸。快速运动（尤其 CSS 连续动画）时，上报命中区会有采样 / 桥接滞后，不等于已开始的拖动必然中断。本例仅手动拖动，不展示追着动画点按的保证。 浮层只属于 `HomeShell.chat` 内的 `ChatScreen` 聊天内容区，用 `ClipRect` 限定在原生顶栏与输入框之间，不覆盖原生 chrome、drawer、右详情或模态；未决审批 / 未答问题时停止。键盘出现时视口随原生布局收缩，不能跨 App。仍受桥接归属、路由守卫和资源预算限制；音频用户手势策略保持不变，本例无音频。首岛约 200 MB、首开约 1–3 秒仅为 Android 15 x86_64 debug 模拟器估测，真机未验。历史普查「19% 使用浮层」不是「19% 插件免改可用」。详见[网页接缝说明](../../../docs/plugins/web-panels.md)。 **验证状态：** 只做源码、清单和语法静态检查；本轮未安装或运行插件，未构建 App，未做真机验证。宿主 React / 模块加载器是必需运行条件，不是浏览器直接打开就能运行的独立 HTML 页面。

## 可以做什么 DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。 - **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。 - **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。 - **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。 - **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。 - **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。 - **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。 功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。 ## 安装 安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。 1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。 2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。 3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。 仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。 本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。 ## 数据与权限 模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。 “发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。 ## 风险提示与免责声明 DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 无关联，也不代表 DeepSeek。使用前请了解： - **AI 并非万无一失**：回答、代码和操作可能出错，也可能被网页、消息或文件中的恶意指令误导。请核验重要结果；医疗、法律、投资等高风险决策不应仅依赖 AI 输出。 - **工具会产生真实影响**：本机或远程主机上的命令、文件修改及手机操控可能导致数据丢失、隐私泄露、账号、资金或设备损失。免确认、放宽应用规则或解除限制会减少保护；确认与拦截机制不能保证消除所有风险。建议保留默认保护，只授予必要权限，不在存有支付或银行信息的设备上解除限制。详见[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。 - **第三方服务与费用**：模型、远程主机和插件等按各自条款运行；相关数据处理、服务可用性和费用取决于你选择的服务与配置。本机运行不等于模型离线，也不代表数据不会离开设备。 - **使用前做好防护**：备份重要数据，只连接可信主机、安装可信插件，留意模型用量与费用；不要让 AI 无人值守地处理不可逆或高风险任务。 - **无担保与责任范围**：在适用法律允许的范围内，本软件按“现状”提供，不保证准确性、持续可用性或满足特定用途；相关无担保及责任限制见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 第 15–17 条。本声明不排除或限制依法不得排除或限制的责任，也不减损你依法享有的权利。 ## 常见问题
和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？
没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。
安全吗？
本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。
切到后台会被杀吗？
部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。
对手机有什么要求？
Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。
开源吗？
开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。再发布和 fork 时的署名要求见[授权范围与再发布](#授权范围与再发布)。
## 从源码构建 以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。 先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git cd dsh-go bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh source tooling/env.sh flutter --version java -version bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon ``` 工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。 产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。 构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时： ```bash bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64 DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon ``` 未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。 只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行： ```bash DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all ``` ##
