# 快捷输入（Quick Input）— DSH 插件

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的输入框上方加一个【快捷输入】按钮：点开候选弹层（**向上展开**），点一条就把它填进输入框。
候选内容在「设置 → 快捷输入」里增、删、改、查，数据落盘在本机，重启和换浏览器都不丢。

- 插件 id：`quick-input`，包名 `@fly-cat-2015/dsh-quick-input`
- 形态：标准 DSH bundle（宿主半侧 + 浏览器半侧），纯 JavaScript，无构建步骤
- 语言：中文 / English（跟随 DSH 的 locale 服务）
- 文案与默认内容：文案在 `locale/*.json`、内置示例在 `content/defaults.json`，改字不用动代码

## 适配版本

### 实机验证过的环境

**当前：DSH 0.2.2-rc.3（2026-11-16）**

| 项目 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `0.2.2-rc.3` |
| profile | `desktop`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`，DSH Desktop 外壳） |
| 浏览器半侧依赖的官方包 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`、`dsh-client-ui-settings`、`dsh-client-ui-slots`、`dsh-client-locale` 均为 `0.2.2-rc.3` |
| 宿主半侧依赖的服务 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver` `0.2.2-rc.3` |
| 插件兼容声明 | `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0"`（当前 `0.2.2-rc.3` 命中） |
| Node.js / 平台 | v24 / macOS (darwin) |

验证范围：`conversation.input.dock` 与 `settings.section` 仍按同一注册形状占用、输入框上方出现【快捷输入】按钮、宿主路由 `GET /dsh-quick-input/items` 返回 `200`（含 `items` / `defaults` / `dictionaries` / `path`）。弹层与设置页的点击交互由使用者目视确认。

0.2.2 新增的 `conversation.hero.options`（新会话行右侧的紧凑选项位）**未采用**：本插件仍沿用 chip 行 portal，二者视觉与行为一致，暂不迁移。

**历史：DSH 0.1.7-rc.1（2026-09-24）**

| 项目 | 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `0.1.7-rc.1` |
| profile | `web`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`） |
| 浏览器半侧依赖的官方包 | 同上，均为 `0.1.7-rc.1` |
| 宿主半侧依赖的服务 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver` `0.1.7-rc.1` |
| Node.js / 平台 | v24.5.0 / macOS (darwin) |

### 升级后按钮不见了？

先看插件是不是被 profile 禁用了，而不是先怀疑版本不兼容：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: quick-input
  disabled: true      # ← 有这行时插件根本不加载，界面自然没有按钮
```

在「设置 → 插件」里把「快捷输入」重新启用（等价于删掉上面两行），或直接编辑该文件后重启 Harness。0.1.7-rc.1 → 0.2.2-rc.3 之间，本插件用到的槽位名、注册形状、`InputActions`、locale 服务与 webServer 路由契约都没有变化，**不需要改插件代码**。

`package.json` 声明了版本兼容区间：

```json
"engines": { "dsh": ">=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0" }
```

DSH 从 0.2.1-alpha.3 起在安装/启动时优先读 `engines.dsh`（存在时忽略 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer 依赖），并用 `semver.satisfies(..., { includePrerelease: true })` 判定，所以 `0.2.2-rc.3` 这类预发布版本也落在区间内（普通 semver 默认会把预发布版本排除在区间外，DSH 的检查器显式打开了 `includePrerelease`）。下限 `0.1.7-rc.1` 是首次实机验证的版本，上限 `<0.3.0` 覆盖 0.2.x 全系；0.3 及以后尚未验证，升级到 0.3 时应先复测再放宽区间。宿主契约本身仍是**运行时探测 + 降级**（见下表），`engines.dsh` 只负责提前拒绝明显不兼容的组合。

### 依赖的宿主契约

| 契约 | 出处 | 缺失 / 变更时的表现 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conversation.input.dock` 列表槽位（ownerProps `InputZone`，标准 props 含 `inputActions` / `useInput`） | ui-conversation | 槽位不存在 → 注册失败，输入框上方没有按钮（无降级） |
| `InputActions.captureInsertion()` / `insertText()` / `setDraft()` | ui-conversation `contract/input` | 缺 `insertText` → 退回 `setDraft` 整体填充；两者都缺 → 点选无效果 |
| 新会话 chip 行类名 `heroWorkspaceRow` | ui-conversation `ConversationRoot` | 改名 → 退回「输入框上方独立一行」，功能不受影响 |
| `--dsh-composer-side-clearance` / `--dsh-composer-dock-inset` / `--dsh-composer-card-max-width` / `--dsh-composer-stack-gap` | ui-conversation 的 composer CSS | 缺失 → 用代码内兜底值（16 / 8 / 100% / 6px），仅轻微偏移 |
| `conversation.input.selector.context`（官方「紧随工作区选择器」的加号位） | ui-conversation | **0.2.2-rc.3 仍未声明**，所以本插件继续 portal 进 chip 行；该槽位出现后可直接注册过去，实现更简单 |
| `settings.section` 槽位（只投影 `id` / `order` / `label`，**没有 icon 字段**） | ui-settings-general | 槽位不存在 → 设置页不出现；日后支持 `icon` → 删掉设置菜单图标的绕路实现 |
| 设置 nav 行结构 `[role="dialog"] nav button`，且行文本 = 当前 label | ui-settings-general `SettingsRoot` | 结构变更 → 设置项退回官方默认齿轮（不破版） |
| nav 内置图标白名单 `account` / `models` / `agent-presets` / `plugins` / `archived-sessions` | ui-settings-general `navIcon()` | 与本插件无关：不在白名单内，这正是需要自行认领并绘制 ⚡ 的原因 |
| `ctx.slots.inject` / `register`、`ctx.effect` | dsh-client-ui-slots / Cordis | 变更 → 插件不加载 |
| `ctx.locale.register` / `bind` / `getLocale` / `subscribe` | dsh-client-locale | 缺失 → 文案回落为 key 本身 |
| 浏览器模块表提供 `react`（必需）与 `react-dom`（投送 chip 用） | dsh-client-modules / `window.__ModuleLoader__` | 无 `react-dom` → 不做投送，留在 dock 行 |
| `ctx.webServer.register({ kind: 'exact', path, handler })` 与 `IncomingMessage` / `ServerResponse` 处理器 | dsh-host-webserver | 变更 → 数据路由注册失败：界面能打开，但读写与**文案/默认内容**都取不到（界面回落为 key 名与空列表） |
| 浏览器模块表只服务插件 JS 产物（`/plugins/<id>/client.*.js`），不服务任意静态文件 | dsh-client-modules | 这是文案必须经宿主路由中转的原因；若日后支持静态资源，可直接 `fetch` 语言文件，本绕路即可删除 |
| `$DSH_HOME` 未设置时取 `~/.dsh` | dsh-home-paths 约定 | 数据目录随之变化 |

### 不适用 / 未验证

- **不适用**：`dsh-headless`、`dsh-acp-app`、`dsh-sdk-*` 等没有 Web 界面的 profile——本插件的两个槽位与数据路由只存在于 Web 组成里。
- **未验证**：0.2.2-rc.3 的 `web` profile（非 Desktop 外壳）、Windows / Linux；0.1.7-rc.1 与 0.2.2-rc.3 之外的版本未逐一验证。
- **可简化时机**：一旦宿主补上 `settings.section` 的 `icon` 字段、或声明 `conversation.input.selector.context` 槽位，本插件的两处绕路实现即可删除（README「实现要点」中均有标注）；若愿意接受右侧对齐，新会话的 chip 也可迁移到 0.2.2 的 `conversation.hero.options` 槽位。

## 功能

### 1. 输入框上方的【快捷输入】按钮

- **会话进行中**：按钮作为独立一行出现在输入框卡片上方（`conversation.input.dock`），左侧与输入框内容对齐。
- **新会话（会话尚未开始）**：按钮自动并入官方的 chip 行，和「工作区 / 模式 / 模型」那几个 chip 同一行、同一套样式（透明胶囊、hover 跟随主题）。
- **弹层一律向上展开**（两种座位都是）：弹层被投送到 `document.body`，按按钮的视口矩形用 `position: fixed` 定位在按钮上方——既躲开输入框卡片（dock 行被压在卡片下面），也不会被输入框的滚动容器裁掉。只有在按钮离视口顶部太近、上方放不下可用高度时，才会临时改为向下展开。

弹层内支持：搜索框过滤、`↑`/`↓` 选择、`Enter` 填入、`Esc` 或点击外部关闭。

点击候选内容后的填入方式：优先通过 InputActions 在**光标处插入**（保留已有内容与选区）；若编辑器拒绝了该 span，则退回整体替换草稿。

### 2. 设置 → 快捷输入（增删改查）

- **增**：名称 + 内容 + 「添加」（`Ctrl/⌘ + Enter` 快捷添加；内容为空会被拦下）
- **查**：列表上方搜索框按名称/内容过滤，右上角显示「共 N 条」
- **改**：行内「编辑」→ 就地修改 → 保存 / 取消
- **删**：两步确认（第一次点变红字「确认删除」，再点才真正删除）
- 另有「恢复默认」（同样两步确认）与数据文件路径显示
- 写入即时生效：设置页保存后，输入框上的弹层立刻能选到新内容（同一份内存 store）

设置菜单里这一项用的是 ⚡ 图标（与输入框上的按钮一致），不是默认的齿轮——原因见「实现要点」。

## 安装

本插件是标准 bundle：`package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，安装时会把自己挂进 profile 的 bundle 栈。

1. 在 DSH Web 的「设置 → 插件」中安装本目录，或让 Harness 的插件管理器以本目录的**绝对路径**安装；
2. 安装后刷新页面（浏览器半侧需要重新加载模块）。

安装结果确认：`设置 → 插件` 里能看到「快捷输入」卡片，且输入框上方出现按钮。

### 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @fly-cat-2015/dsh-quick-input
```

> ⚠️ 以目录方式安装时，profile 的 `node_modules` 里是指向本目录的软链（`link:`）；以
> `github:` / 版本号安装时则是一份拷贝，改本目录的代码不会自动生效，需要重新安装。
> 因此不要手动删除或移动本目录；要迁移位置请先卸载、再重新安装。

## 使用

1. 在输入框上方点【快捷输入】（新会话时它在 chip 行里）；
2. 在弹出的候选层里搜索 / 选择一条；
3. 内容被填进输入框，按需编辑后正常发送；
4. 维护列表：设置 → 快捷输入。

首次使用时若还没有数据文件，插件会自动写入 1 条内置示例（代码审查），可随意改删。

## 文案与默认内容（独立成文件维护）

改字不用碰代码：所有面向用户的文案都在语言文件里，内置示例在 `content/defaults.json` 里。

| 文件 | 内容 | 谁读它 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `locale/zh.json` | `meta`（插件卡片标题/描述）+ `quickInput`（中文界面全部文案） | `meta`：dsh-app-boot 读插件卡片；`quickInput`：宿主半侧读，见下 |
| `locale/en.json` | 同上，英文 | 同上 |
| `content/defaults.json` | 内置示例条目（`items` 数组，纯文本，不参与翻译） | 宿主半侧，播种与「恢复默认」 |

### 文案是怎么走到界面上的（以及为什么不能直接读文件）

浏览器半侧**不能**自己读这些 JSON：客户端模块加载器只把插件的 JS 产物当资源服务（`/plugins/<id>/client.js` 及其 `client.*.js` chunk），`locale/zh.json` 之类的静态文件一律 404。所以：

1. 宿主半侧启动后读一遍 `locale/` 目录（文件名即语言 id，如 `zh`、`en`、`zh-CN`），把每个文件的 `quickInput` 对象挂在数据路由上；
2. 浏览器半侧 GET `/dsh-quick-input/items` 时同时拿到 `dictionaries`（各语言文案）与 `defaults`（内置示例），再按当前语言把它们注册进 `locale` 服务；
3. 之后 `t('nav')` 取到的就是文件里的字。语言 id 按「中文 id → zh 字典，其它 → en 字典」派发，正好符合 locale 服务的回退链（`zh-CN → en`），所以中文和英文都不会串到 key 名。

翻译行为：**文案不走 `meta`**。`meta` 只给插件卡片用（`dsh-app-boot` 只允许 `meta.title` / `meta.description`，多写的字段会被丢掉），界面文案一律放在同文件的 `quickInput` 里。

新增一种语言：在 `locale/` 下加一个以语言 id 命名的 `.json`（如 `ja.json`），带 `quickInput` 对象即可。
语言文件是**启动时读一次并缓存**的（`locale` 目录里其它不相干的 `.json` 会被忽略），加完文件重启 Harness 生效。

### 内置示例（`content/defaults.json`）

只有一条，首次使用时写进数据文件，也是「恢复默认」写回去的内容：

```json
{ "id": "default-code-review", "label": "代码审查", "content": "帮我审查当前代码变更：指出潜在的 bug、边界情况与可改进点，并给出具体修改建议。" }
```

`label` 是弹层/设置页里显示的名字，`content` 是点选后填进输入框的内容——都是纯文本，不参与翻译（所以中英文环境下看到的是同一份，想分语言维护的话，改成把文案放进语言文件也可以，只是那就不再是「一份默认内容」了）。

## 数据存储

### 位置

```
$DSH_HOME/quick-input/items.json      # DSH_HOME 未设置时为 ~/.dsh
```

默认即 `~/.dsh/quick-input/items.json`。设置页底部会显示当前实际路径。

### 文档结构

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "updatedAt": "2026-09-24T09:22:19.870Z",
  "items": [
    { "id": "default-code-review", "label": "代码审查", "content": "帮我审查当前代码变更：指出潜在的 bug、边界情况与可改进点，并给出具体修改建议。" }
  ]
}
```

> 这条内容来自 `content/defaults.json`，不是插件代码里的字面量：首次使用时宿主半侧把文件里的示例交给浏览器半侧，后者写入这个文档。改 `defaults.json` 后，对**还没有文档**的机器、以及点过「恢复默认」的机器生效；路由不可用时「恢复默认」会拒绝执行（宁可不动，也不写空列表）。

### 宿主路由（浏览器半侧的唯一数据入口）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/dsh-quick-input/items` | 返回 `{ items, defaults, dictionaries, path }`；`items: null` 表示还没有文档（浏览器半侧会写入内置示例） |
| `PUT` | `/dsh-quick-input/items` | 请求体 `{ items: [...] }`，落盘后返回 `{ items, defaults, dictionaries, path }` |
| `DELETE` | `/dsh-quick-input/items` | 删除文档（即恢复默认），返回 `{ items: null, defaults, dictionaries, path }` |

- `defaults`：内置示例（来自 `content/defaults.json`），每次都带。
- `dictionaries`：各语言文案，形如 `{"en": {...}, "zh": {...}}`，键是语言 id（文件名小写）。只含 `quickInput` 一层，`meta` 不出现在这里。

手工查看 / 重置：

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-quick-input/items
curl -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-quick-input/items
```

### 写入约束（宿主半侧强制）

浏览器传来的任何内容都要过一遍白名单净化，坏数据写不进文档：

- `items` 必须是数组，否则 `400`
- 内容为空（仅空白）的条目直接丢弃
- `label` 去空格并截断到 100 字符；`content` 截断到 20000 字符
- 最多 200 条；`id` 缺失或重复时重新分配
- 通过临时文件 + rename 落盘，中断也不会留下半截文档

## 目录结构

```
quick-input/
├── package.json          # bundle 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 插入宿主行 quick-input
├── index.js              # 宿主半侧：数据文件读写 + 文案/默认内容读取 + /dsh-quick-input/items 路由
├── client.js             # 浏览器半侧：共享 store + 输入框按钮/向上弹层 + 设置页 + 设置菜单图标
├── locale/
│   ├── en.json           # English：插件卡片 meta + 界面文案 quickInput
│   └── zh.json           # 简体中文：同上
├── content/
│   └── defaults.json     # 内置示例条目（纯文本，不参与翻译）
└── icon.svg              # 插件卡片图标
```

> 内置示例**故意不放在 `locale/`**：`dsh-app-boot` 会把该目录下任何 2–8 个字母的文件名当成语言 id 去读（它读插件卡片文案），`defaults.json` 会被它当成一门叫 “defaults” 的语言。目前无害（文件中没有 `meta`，被忽略），但把数据文件放在那里是隐患，所以单独放 `content/`。

## 实现要点（二次开发参考）

- **座位选择**：输入框按钮注册在 `conversation.input.dock`。新会话阶段再通过 `createPortal` 把自己投送进官方的 hero chip 行（`[class*="heroWorkspaceRow"]`），因为本 shell 没有声明 `conversation.input.selector.context` 这个「紧随工作区选择器」的加号位。定位只从自己的探针向上走并在同一个 `composerStack` 内校验，用 `MutationObserver` 重新解析；宿主类名若变更则自动退回 dock 行，不会破版。`react-dom` 用 try/catch 获取。做法参考已安装的 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-git-graph`。
- **弹层向上展开**：dock 行所在的 composer 座位带 `z-index: 7`（`wSkVaW_composerSeat`），输入框卡片画在它上面——弹层挂在按钮旁边会被卡片盖住；`position:absolute` 还会被输入框的滚动容器裁掉。所以弹层 `createPortal` 到 `document.body`，用 `position: fixed` + 按钮 `getBoundingClientRect()` 的视口坐标贴到按钮上方（`placePopup()`）。重算挂在三处：`resize` / `scroll`（含捕获阶段的容器滚动）监听、`visualViewport` 的同样两个事件，以及**弹层自身**的 `ResizeObserver`（列表高度变化时重算；回调经 `requestAnimationFrame` 串联，避免观察自己造成循环）。观察器必须等弹层真正挂载后才创建，所以它单独放在一个以 `open` 为依赖的 effect 里。外部点击判定同时认「chip」与「弹层」两个节点（二者已不在同一棵子树里）。官方 `git-graph` 插件在同一座位是「弹层向下开」，本插件按需求改成两种座位都向上。
- **文案与默认内容**：全部独立成文件（见上文「文案与默认内容」一节），`client.js` 里没有一份可显示的用户文案、也没有内置条目；宿主半侧读文件，浏览器半侧经数据路由取回并注册进 `locale` 服务。注册按语言 id 幂等推进（已注册的 id 不再重复注册——locale 服务对同一 `(namespace, 语言)` 的第二次注册会抛错），卸载时把注册逐个交还。
- **填入输入框**：使用槽位标准 props 里的 `inputActions`（`captureInsertion()` → `insertText()`，失败退回 `setDraft()`），不直接操作 DOM。
- **设置菜单图标**：`settings.section` 只投影 `id / order / label`，外壳也只给内置 id 配图标，其余一律齿轮。因此按 label 精确认领自己的 nav 行，藏掉外壳齿轮、用 `::before` + `mask-image`（`currentColor`）画 ⚡。该绕路方案在 `dshmarket`、`dsh-better-sidebar` 中同样存在，等槽位支持 `icon` 字段后应删除。
- **样式**：只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 语义 token 与宿主的 composer 布局变量（`--dsh-composer-side-clearance` / `--dsh-composer-dock-inset` / `--dsh-composer-card-max-width`，均带兜底值）；类名统一 `dsh-qi-` 前缀；未 import 任何 Harness Client 包。
- **资源归属**：locale 订阅、nav 图标观察器、slot 注册全部挂在插件上下文的 `ctx.effect` 上，插件卸载即回收。
- **持久化**：数据由宿主半侧持有（同一 Harness 的所有浏览器共享一份），浏览器半侧只通过同源路由读写。

## 自检

```bash
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
node -e "for (const f of ['package.json','locale/zh.json','locale/en.json','content/defaults.json']) JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'))"

# 宿主路由（应同时看到 items / defaults / dictionaries / path）
curl http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-quick-input/items
```

安装后在 Harness 内可用 `cordis_inspect_query`（client / Slots）确认两个槽位的占用：
`conversation.input.dock`（id `quick-input`, order 5）与 `settings.section`（id `quick-input`, order 30）。

## 已知限制

- 设置菜单图标的认领依赖 nav 行的可见文本与当前 label 相同；label 为空时不做任何标记（不会误伤其它行）。
- hero chip 行的定位依赖宿主类名 `heroWorkspaceRow`；宿主改名会退回 dock 行（功能不受影响，只是位置变回独立一行）。
- 会话进行中仍会占用输入框上方一行（这是刻意保留的行为）。
- 弹层默认向上展开；按钮离视口顶部不足约 160px 时会临时向下开（否则上方放不下可用高度）。
- 语言文件在启动时读一次并缓存：新增/修改 `locale/*.json` 需要重启 Harness；浏览器端刷新页面只会重新取一遍宿主已缓存的内容。
- 若宿主路由不可用（网络/后端异常），界面会回落到 key 名与空列表：文案只有宿主这一份来源，代码里刻意不留副本。首次加载会重试 3 次（覆盖「浏览器先到、路由后注册」的冷启动竞态），之后打开弹层或进入设置页也会再试一次；恢复默认在拿不到内置示例时直接拒绝执行。
- 暂未实现：拖拽排序、分组/标签、导入导出、变量占位符。
- 未声明开源许可；如需开源请自行补充 `LICENSE` 与 `package.json` 的 `license` 字段。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH Share Session

一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：把一个会话里选中的对话内容生成一张可分享的长图。

## 功能

- 从设置页选择一个可见会话，搜索标题、项目路径或会话 ID。
- 针对长会话，可以选择：
  - 仅本轮
  - 最近 3 / 10 / 20 轮
  - 全部
  - 自定义轮次范围或逐轮勾选
- 可选包含：
  - 思考过程
  - 工具调用（名称、参数、结果摘要）
  - 时间戳
- 生成 1080px 宽 PNG；超过单张高度上限时自动拆分为多张，并显示页码。
- 支持预览、下载当前张、下载全部、复制图片到剪贴板。
- 在回答操作行新增分享入口：复制、点赞/点踩、生成长图分享、分支。
- 分享弹窗默认只选择当前回答所在的一轮，并可直接切换范围与思考过程开关。

## 安装

这是一个 DSH bundle 包，包含：

- Host 半部分：只读、鉴权的会话 manifest / render 路由
- Client 半部分：设置页、回答操作行分享按钮、分享弹窗、Canvas 长图渲染

在 DSH 的 Profile 中使用 Plugin Manager 安装这个目录：

```text
Plugin Manager -> Install bundle -> 选择本仓库目录
```

安装后打开 `Settings -> 会话长图`，或在任意已完成的助手回答操作行点击分享图标。

## 目录

```text
index.js            Host 半部分
client.js           Client 半部分与长图渲染
cordis.patch.yml    Bundle patch
locale/             插件管理元数据（en / zh）
icon.svg            插件图标
```

## 说明

- 会话内容通过 `sessionQuery.readSession()` 读取，支持冷会话，不需要为了导出而启动 Agent。
- 生成图片发生在浏览器 Canvas，Host 只返回所选轮次的文本/工具数据。
- 消息中的图片附件目前以文本标签展示，不会把原图嵌入长图。
- 选择粒度是“轮次”；思考过程、工具调用和时间戳可以独立开关。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-hub-bot (hub-bot-plugin)

中枢 Bot 插件：三层负责人架构的个人 Bot 体系（规格：DSH-Workflow docs/specs/hub-bot-plugin.md；跟踪 issue #62；#63 交付存储与管理面，#64 交付总负责人与路由链路）。

本目录是一个 DSH cordis bundle：

- `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`；bundle 层只插入插件条目（无配置）与两个负责人 preset（`hub-bot-router` L1 路由 / `hub-bot-owner` L2 执行管理，名称与说明均标"负责人专用，不供手动选择"）。**两个 preset 完全只读：无写文件、无命令执行工具**（一切动手只发生在 L3 执行会话）；router preset 另含静态插件行 `dsh-hub-bot/router-tools`，把 L1 五个工具与路由 persona 挂进 preset 的挂载子树。
- `src/index.js` 是插件入口（`name`/`inject`/`apply`）：校验 `stateDir` 与 `homeRepo`（均必填、绝对路径，否则拒绝启动），打开版本化 SQLite 存储（`src/store.js`），引导总负责人注册（`src/registry.js`，懒创建：启动只落 `chief` 行、status `pending`），装配 `Hub`（`src/hub.js` = store + registry + `src/router.js`）并把 `hubBot` 服务提供到根作用域。
- `src/router-tools.js` 是 L1 工具插件（cordis 插件形态，静态列进 router preset）：注册 `list_owners` / `create_owner` / `route_to_owner` / `query_tasks` / `reply_source` 五个工具，并以 `deployment:persona-prefix` 同名 section 把路由 persona（`src/persona.js`，≤30 词路由备注、歧义回候选列表+"其他"不猜）挂成 preset 作用域的部署 persona 遮蔽。
- **管理 API 默认关闭**：它能向本 profile 任意会话注入消息，与 #62 Policy 同级敏感，因此仅当配置显式给出 `devApi: { token: "..." }` 时才注册 `/hub-bot/api/*` 路由；请求须带 `x-hub-bot-token: <token>` 头（sha256 后常量时间比对，不符 401），且仍限 loopback。未配置 `devApi` 时插件正常装载、不注册任何路由。路由：`state` 健康检查、`owners` 读负责人注册表、`sessions` 建会话（带 `owner` 字段则按注册表 cwd/preset 建并绑定）、`route` 直接路由一条消息（与 L1 工具同核心）、`owners/invalidate-session` 把行指向悬挂会话 id（被删重建验收探针）、`inject` 经 `sessionController.prompt()` 注入既有会话（可带幂等 `requestId`）、`decorate` 注册 `hub_bot_ping` 工具（会话关闭经 `agent/disposed` 自动注销）、`wait` 等空闲、`transcript` 读持久 transcript。

## 开发期装载（独立 DSH_HOME，不触碰正在运行的 DSH）

DSH 从 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>` 装载 profile（缺省 `DSH_HOME=~/.dsh`）。把 `DSH_HOME` 指到独立目录即可启动一个完全隔离的开发实例——与 superagent 的 "dedicated profile" 形态相同，但不占用户默认目录、不重启用户服务：

```sh
export DSH=/Applications/Ghost\ DSH\ Station.app/Contents/Resources
export DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-hub-bot-dev          # 任意独立目录
export MAGPIE_GATEWAY_KEY=placeholder         # 本地网关不校验，provider 只要求变量存在

# 1. 从 web 模板建 profile
node "$DSH/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" hub-bot-dev --from-default-profile web --dump-config > /dev/null

# 2. 以 link: 装载开发中的插件（实时反映本目录改动，重启实例生效）
node "$DSH/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" plugin --profile hub-bot-dev add "link:$PWD"

# 3. 编辑 $DSH_HOME/profiles/hub-bot-dev/cordis.patch.yml（完整样本：docs/dev-profile.patch.yml）：
#    webserver 端口、LLM provider、默认 model、permission 默认 preset，以及 hub-bot 条目：
HUB_BOT_TOKEN=$(openssl rand -hex 16)   # 开发实例启动时生成随机 token
#   - id: hub-bot
#     config:
#       stateDir: $DSH_HOME/state
#       homeRepo: /Volumes/外挂/Ghost233HomeRepo   # 总负责人 cwd（L1 落点）
#       devApi: { token: $HUB_BOT_TOKEN }        # 不配 devApi 则管理面整体关闭
#    注意：profile 层同 id 条目是替换语义——stateDir/homeRepo/devApi 必须写在同一条目内，
#    拆成两个 "- id: hub-bot" 会让后一条覆盖前一条的 config。

# 4. 启动（独立端口；停止只需 Ctrl-C，用户的 DSH 不受影响）
node "$DSH/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" --profile hub-bot-dev --no-open

# 调用管理面：curl -H "x-hub-bot-token: $HUB_BOT_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:3199/hub-bot/api/state
```

生产装载（与 superagent 相同形态）：在用户自己的 profile 里 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:<本目录>`（或安装打包后的 tgz），在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给 `hub-bot` 条目加 `config.stateDir` 与 `config.homeRepo`（生产不建议开 `devApi`），重启该 profile 生效。重启用户正在运行的 DSH 需由交付 Lead 协调时机。

## 测试

```sh
npm test    # node --test：config 校验、SQLite schema、负责人注册表、路由核心（懒创建/重建/幂等）、patch 结构
```

patch 结构测试复用仓内先例 `scripts/test-runtime.mjs` 的解析链：`DSH_TEST_RUNTIME_ROOT` 指向一份装好依赖的 DSH 运行时（如 Station 的 Resources 目录），缺省回退仓内 `deepseek-harness/` 源码检出。两者都不可用时 patch 测试 **skip 而非 fail**（其余测试不受影响）；本仓 CI/验收用 `DSH_TEST_RUNTIME_ROOT="/Applications/Ghost DSH Station.app/Contents/Resources" npm test` 获得真实 cordis include 解析器的全量校验。

## 设计决定记录

- **store.js 的 schema v1 即建全 trigger/ticket/owner/outbox 四张表**：它们由规格「数据模型」章节定义，是三层架构的既有数据契约；schema v1 建全后，后续工单只追加迁移不改历史迁移，保证已部署 stateDir 的升级路径单调可测。
- **两个 preset 在 cordis.patch.yml 中保持展开**：preset 是给人读的声明式配置，两份各自完整可比 YAML 锚点更易审阅；L1/L2 的分化已经发生（router 多一行 router-tools）。
- **preset 完全只读成立后才在措辞中宣称"完全只读"**：#64 去掉了 shell/jobs 工具行，无写文件、无命令执行工具，工具面即权限边界；此前 5 秒转后台的 shell 语义只是时延约束，不构成只读。
- **负责人注册表与路由核心是纯领域模块**（registry.js / router.js）：Router 经窄 Sessions 端口（create/prompt）驱动 sessionController，单测用假端口覆盖懒创建、被删重建、triggerRef 幂等，无需 DSH 运行时。先存后做：Trigger→Ticket 先落库再注入，崩溃后可追。
- **preset 挂载子树是独立模块 realm，跨 realm 通道用"根服务 + inject 链"**（2026-11-15 实测）：子树行的模块实例与根插件不共享（模块单例 ✗、globalThis ✗）；插件作用域 `reflect.provide` ✗、`ctx.root.reflect.provide` 单独使用也 ✗。**实证可用组合**：根插件在 `ctx.root` 提供 `hubBot` 服务，且子树行的 `inject` 声明若干根组合服务（`sessionController`/`sessionPersistence`——只起解析链作用，不被调用），子树内 `ctx.reflect.get('hubBot', false)` 即可解析。去掉这两个 inject 项，工具行会静默 pending（mount 审计容忍 pending），因此 inject 列表是承重的，注释必须保留。
- **工具 output schema 不支持 type 数组**：`{ type: ['string','null'] }` 在注册期即被拒绝；可空字段改为单类型 + 不列入 `required`。
- **管理面默认关闭 + token 把守**：注入能力与 #62 Policy 同级，宁可每次开发实例生成一次性 token，不留"静态头即可注入任意会话"的本机面。

## 任务三态与 L2 执行闭环（#65）

- **三态机（src/tasks.js）**：`working → review → done`；review 是挡板，done 只能由 review 经用户验收（resolution:"accept"）到达。追问把 review 恢复为 working（resume, by:'route'），验收 by:'user'；非法迁移拒绝（如 working 直接 accept、done 后追问、double-report）。全部迁移记 transitions 审计数组。
- **L2 六工具（src/owner-tools.js，owner preset 静态行）**：search_sessions / read_session / inject_session / create_session / report / escalate。身份解析：工具执行的 exec.agent 经 workingDirectory.ensure 拿会话 cwd，须等于注册表某 owner 的 cwd，否则拒执。
- **越界拒执**：create/inject/read 的目标会话（或 create_session 的目标 cwd）必须落在 owner 责任子树内（isWithinCwd 路径段感知，`/a/b` 不含 `/a/bc`）；越界抛错并指向 escalate。escalate 不改票阶段、打 escalated 标记并写 outbox(kind=escalation)，L1 经 query_tasks 可见。
- **执行会话保持用户 preset**：create_session 不传 agentPreset（部署默认），插件永不改写执行会话配置。
- **授权不可变**：Ticket 创建时记 authorization{actor,source,at}，注入执行会话的文本自动携带它；追问注入文本带"改完请再次 report"提示（首跑实证：L2 追问后忘了再次 report，票卡在 working）。
- **report 归类**：report{summary,evidence,at} 存票面，stage 转 review；L1 用 query_tasks 看到摘要。完整汇报链（任务外广播）属 task-5/#67。
- **追问/验收从 L1 走 route_to_owner**：ticketId=追问（review→working 并注入，working→原样注入，done→拒），ticketId+resolution:"accept"=用户验收（review→done 不注入；working accept 拒——挡板）。

## 等待状态模型与可靠性硬化（#66）

- **九态一票**（src/tasks.js）：待触发 idle、排队中 queued、进行中 working、等您回复 person/answer、等您确认 person/confirm、等您验收 person/review、被卡住 blocked、失败 failed、完成 done。任何时刻恰处一个阶段；全部迁移经 TRANSITIONS 守卫并记 transitions 审计（含 by/at）。等您验收是挡板：done 只能由 person/review（验收）或 person/confirm（取消）到达；人的追问把 person/*、blocked、failed 释放回 working（spec：人的消息直接释放）。#65 旧票 stage 'review' 读出时归一为 person/review，不做迁移。
- **状态摘要 = 状态朗读**：STAGE_TEXT 逐字文案（进行中/等您验收/被卡住/…），query_tasks 每行带 stageText，summarize 只回 朗读 + 票面既有事实（report 摘要/escalation 原因等），LLM 不即兴总结。
- **先存后做（src/outbox.js OutboxRunner）**：建票先存 idle（待触发），注入先落 outbox 行再投递；投递成功才转 working。失败 2 秒首次重试、指数退避、上限注入 5 分钟/回复 1 分钟；同一任务的注入严格保序（前一条未送达后一条等待）；连续失败 3 次才记 system-problem 行并绕过（一次性错误不惊动人）；重试沿用行内稳定 requestId。permanent 失败（如票面授权缺失）立即终判不重试。插件启动时 markRestart（working/idle/queued 票的 running assignment 以 "host restarted" 结束、打 recoveryPending）并自动恢复投递，另有 1 秒 tick 定时器；devApi 增 POST /deliver 手动驱动（实证用）。
- **触发与授权不可变（票面权威）**：追问不绑定新 Trigger；追问带 authorization 参数直接拒绝（authorization-immutable）；票面授权缺失的票拒绝执行——路由侧转 blocked 并拒注入，投递侧 permanent fail 转 failed；会话叙事声称的授权不扩展权限（owner persona 明文 + L2 工具硬约束）。
- **消息纪律代码化（src/discipline.js）**：对外回复超 100 词由代码截断并附「…（超过 100 词已截断）」；CJK 一字一词、西文一连串一词。
- **重启自动恢复（#72 AC1，spec「重启恢复」）**：markRestart 后 working 票按**最旧优先**自动补投恢复注入（无人干预即继续干活），过执行槽闸门——槽内票直接补投，溢出票 demote 转排队中、注入行 held 等位（槽空由 #promoteQueued 提升释放）。恢复注记恰好一次：恢复后首条注入以「（重启恢复：先检查目录与 git 状态，再重复任何对外动作）」开头，送达即清 recoveryPending。
- **report 三形态（owner-tools）**：summary→等您验收 / question→等您回复 / failure→失败；escalate→被卡住（原"只打标不改阶段"语义废止）。

## 汇报链（#67）

- **每次唤醒至多一条对外汇报**（src/reporting.js）：L2 每次 report/escalate 的事实并入该负责人唯一一条 queued digest 行（先存后做）；digest 等负责人会话转空闲（唤醒结束）才由 OutboxRunner 投递到总负责人会话——同仓库 3 个任务一次唤醒只产生 1 条对外汇报。postpone 不烧 attempts（非失败），2 秒后重看；行 sent 后下一 report 开新行（唤醒边界）。
- **结构化报告四段**：report 的 summary 形态可带 result/changes/verification/risks（结果/变更/验证/风险），四段要么全给要么不给（sections-incomplete），票面存储，digest 逐字渲染（汇报以票面为准，不按会话叙事虚构）。
- **统一出口接通（不假装送达）**：digest 与 to=dsh:session:chief / session:<id> 的 reply 行经 OutboxRunner 实际投递到目标会话（被删自动重建沿用 #promptOwner）；实际投递成功才标 sent。feishu: 等尚无通道的外部目标标 **recorded**（先存后做的持久意图，终态不重试），等真实通道落地后扫描 recorded 行外投。
- **定时汇总自动汇报（默认关）**：config.reporting.auto=true 开启后，1 秒 tick 顺带 autoReportTick（intervalMs 间隔闸门，默认 60s）；汇总只列活跃阶段（进行中/排队中/等您回复/等您确认/等您验收/被卡住），done/failed 不列，空列表不发声（只在结果可用或需要行动时说话）；文本经 100 词截断；**内容与上次相同则不重复发**（unchanged，dev 实证曾刷出「第八份重复汇总」后修复）。devApi POST /deliver 返回 autoReport 字段（force 触发一次，实证用）。
- **DSH 内直接问负责人例外**：谁被问谁答，不绕总负责人（L2 会话本来就是用户可直聊的会话）。
- **下钻**：总负责人收到 digest 后按票面答复；用户追问明细时 query_tasks 下钻到具体票（stageText 朗读 + 票面 detail）。

## 飞书入口（#68）

- **扫码一键建应用**：`POST /hub-bot/api/feishu/register` 启动 `lark.registerApp()` 设备授权流程（RFC 8628）；`GET /hub-bot/api/feishu/status` 轮询拿 `qr.url`（面板可渲染二维码），用户手机飞书确认后 `client_id/client_secret` 写入 `stateDir/feishu-credentials.json`（**0600**）并自动建立长连接。权限一次申请：im:message:send_as_bot / im:message / im:chat:readonly + 事件 im.message.receive_v1。
- **长连接配置**：凭证落地后插件尝试 application-config patch 设长连接模式——**实测不可行**（2026-11-16：设备流权限包不含 `application:application:patch`，返回 404）；**正式路径是手工一次性配置**：open.feishu.cn/app → 应用 → 事件与回调 → 订阅方式 → 使用长连接接收事件/回调。失败只记日志不阻断。
- **消息归一化与来源标记**：im.message.receive_v1 → Trigger（id `feishu-<messageId>`，重启/重连重放去重）→ 注入 L1 总负责人会话，文本带插件自有标记 `[hub-bot 飞书 <chatId>/<messageId>]` 与回投地址（`reply_source to='feishu:chat:<chatId>'`），与人手输入可区分（task-1 遗留修复）。
- **Policy 代码强制**：bot 自己的消息丢弃；**授权边界在飞书侧**——应用的可用范围与可见成员由飞书管理后台配置，能与 bot 说话即已授权，插件不做二次过滤（原 `openIdAllowlist` 已移除，残留该键的旧配置会被严格校验拒绝）；群聊只有 @bot 的消息成请求（botOpenId 缺省时任何 @ 宽松算）；非文本消息回「暂不支持该消息类型」。
- **回复回投**：L1 `reply_source to='feishu:chat:oc_…'` 的行是 recorded 持久意图（阶段 2 诚实语义）；FeishuSource.deliverReplies 每秒 tick 扫描、经 im.message.create 实投成功才标 sent；连续失败 5 次标 failed 并报 system-problem。
- **凭据失效**：`status().credentialState` 为 missing/invalid 时面板提示重新扫码（devApi `feishu/status` 同源）。
- dev 实证探针：`POST /hub-bot/api/feishu/simulate` 注入 mock 事件走真实归一化/Policy/注入路径（无真实飞书时实证全链）。

## fork 路径与确认流程（#69）

- **fork 是重操作，永远先确认**：L2 用 `fork_session` 工具只发起**确认**——意图以结构化 action 落票面 `pendingConfirm`（先存后做），票转「等您确认」，确认文本由代码生成（src/fork.js：对象+预期结果+原因，原样呈用户）；确认请求随汇报链 digest 到 L1。确认前 L2 停手，不重复发起、不注入。
- **确认后由代码执行，不靠模型自觉**：L1 `route_to_owner(ticketId, resolution:"confirm")` → Router 调 sessionController `fork()`（缺省取最近完成回合前缀；`atSeq` 可指定含边界切点，丢掉污染的尾巴）→ 票回进行中、`mechanism:'fork'`、绑新会话（新 Assignment）→ 唤醒 L2 注入续作。fork 失败票保持「等您确认」，可重试/拒绝/取消。
- **否定与取消**：`resolution:"reject"` 票转被卡住、**保持原会话**，等用户下一句释放；`resolution:"cancel"` 是终态（票转完成）。两种决议与确认一样记 `confirmOutcome` 于票面供审计。
- **24h 确认超时自动取消**（spec「错误场景」）：1 秒 tick 顺带清扫超时的「等您确认」票——自动取消（by system）并经 L1 统一出口回复「已取消」（先存后做、恰好一次）。
- **互不干扰**：fork 只读源会话事件切前缀，原会话保留可查、全程不再注入；两个会话用户都可打开。默认注入（inject_session）不改变会话拓扑。
- **独立开发的代码隔离**：worktree 创建沿用 Home Repo 约定 `scripts/create-worktree.sh <repo> <issue> <slug>`（worktree 落在 `<repo>.worktrees/<issue>-<slug>`，分支 `fix/<issue>-<slug>`），由执行会话在续作中完成。

## GitHub 自动处理闭环（#71）

- **轮询**：监听清单跟随 owner 注册表（repo 负责人的 cwd 解析 `git remote get-url origin` → GitHub 仓库，无需配置；无 origin/非 GitHub 记 resolveErrors 跳过）；REST 轮询复用本机 `gh auth`（认证限额 5000 次/小时，`config.github.intervalMs` 默认 5min，下限 30s）。**首轮只记水位线**（stateDir/github-watermarks.json），历史存量不触发；之后只处理编号更大的新 Issue/PR，重启不重放。
- **自动处理闭环**：本人新 Issue = 显式请求豁免（无确认）——插件先记 ack 回复意图（先存后做，deliverReplies 实投并强制 dsh-badge）→ 路由进 L2 仓库负责人（triggerRef `github:<repo>:issue:<n>` 幂等）→ 注入文本携带完整链路指令（worktree 修复 → 提 PR → 汇报链通知审核；**永不直推主分支，合并永远由人**）。新 PR 路由初审指令（摘要+风险点）。
- **Policy**：`loginAllowlist` 默认空 = 启动时经 `gh api user` 解析为本人；非白名单作者与 `bot:ignore` 标签只记录不处理（github-dropped 行）。
- **喊停与关闭**：白名单评论「停」→ 任务终止（让位于人，人的消息仍可释放）+ chief 通知；普通评论归入已有任务（follow-up 不产生新 Trigger）；`mentionHandle` 提及 → 新 Trigger（mention 寻址）；轮询发现源头关闭/合并 → 自动终止 + 通知。
- **回复回投**：`reply_source to='github:<repo>:<n>'` 的 recorded 行经 deliverReplies 用 `gh api` 实投为评论——body 缺 badge 由代码补上——实投成功才标 sent；连续 5 次失败标 failed 并报 system-problem。
- **dsh-badge**：bot 在 GitHub 的一切产出结尾带 powered-by-dsh 徽标（ack/回复由代码强制；PR 描述等 L2/L3 自然产出由注入文本与 persona 约束）。
- dev 实证探针：`GET github/status`（跟随清单/水位线/解析失败留痕）、`POST github/poll {repo?}`（立即一轮）、`POST github/simulate {kind, repo, item}`（mock 事件走真实归一化/Policy/路由）。

## 三类负责人与 scratch 回收（#70）

- **三类形态**：`repo`（仓库+GitHub 联动，常驻）、`dir`（任意本地目录，纯本地执行不进 GitHub，路由按目录匹配，常驻）、`scratch`（临时目录 `stateDir/scratch/<id>`，即时任务，**任务完成即自动回收**）。b 类目录由用户显式指定（"给 <path> 建个负责人"）；路由不到仓库时 L1 反问"要建目录 bot 吗？目录是？"而非自猜；目录已是 git 仓库则利用（diff 审计/回滚），不是则不强制 init。
- **回收触发**：票进入终态（done=验收通过 / failed=终止）即做回收判定——Router 终态转移即时触发，1s tick 的 sweep 兜底不经 Router 的终止（report-failure、github 源头终止）。
- **回收安全**：仅当该 scratch owner 名下无进行中/待确认票时才回收；dir/repo 负责人永不回收；回收失败不阻断任务完成（warn + 下轮重试）。
- **回收动作（落审计）**：先抓目录内容清单（截断至 50 项+总数）→ 删目录 → 注册表行转 `recycled`（行与 sessionId 保留，**会话历史保留可查**）→ 审计行经 outbox 送达 chief（统一出口）。
- **产物带出**：L2 报告必须列目录内容清单（persona 纪律）；产物发到飞书/复制到持久目录/写入产出物清单随报告提交；未带出的随目录删除。
- dev 实证探针：`POST owners {kind,cwd?,workspace?}` 注册动态负责人（scratch 自动分配目录）。

## 可靠性与并发（#72）

- **执行槽**：同 owner 并发 working 任务上限 `config.concurrency.slotsPerOwner`（默认 3，正整数可配，未知键拒绝）。槽只对 **working** 计数——交还给人（person/answer、person/confirm、person/review）立即释放，blocked/failed/done 同样释放。GitHub 自动任务与人的新任务同规则占槽（显式请求豁免的是确认流程，不是槽位）。
- **queued 排队**：槽满时新票照样先存（trigger + ticket + **held** 注入行，先存后做不丢），票转 排队中 阶段；held 行对投递扫描不可见。槽空出后由 1s tick 按 **createdAt FIFO** 提升最旧票（queued→working）并释放其注入行——提升即投递，同一脉搏完成。提升在转移之后才放行注入行，崩溃只落在可修复侧（working 票配 held 行，下一 tick 崩修释放），永不超额准入。
- **人的专用槽**：既有票的跟进消息永不排队——对 queued 票的人为跟进立即提升它（绕过槽上限，queued→working），held 行按序先投、跟进注入紧随其后；RELEASABLE 等待态照旧由人的消息直接释放。
- **多入口串行化**：L1 工具 / devApi / 飞书（经 L1）/ GitHub 轮询四条入口的 routeToOwner 全部经 **per-owner promise 链**串行——槽账本的读-判-写不会与同 owner 的并行调用交错；tick 的提升脉搏也挂在同一链上。SQLite（node:sqlite）语句级同步单写者，链保证的是跨语句决策的原子性。
- **模型限流/预算耗尽**：属 DSH 运行时行为——运行时按同 requestId 续跑/重试，任务票不转 failed（自动反馈永不恢复暂停的工作）；插件不感知也不干预。
- 实证：`docs/evidence-task-10.md`（槽矩阵/FIFO 提升/专用槽/多入口串行/pause 跨重启/先存后做全链审计）。

## Web 面板：三问与设置页（#73）

- **打开**：devApi 开启时（dev 实例）浏览器访问 `http://<host>:<port>/hub-bot/panel?token=<devApi.token>`。面板是 `panel/` 下的**静态 HTML+JS**——无构建链、不依赖 DSH 内部；token 存 sessionStorage，所有数据经 `x-hub-bot-token` 头走 `/hub-bot/api/*`（401 自动弹回 token 输入页）。静态壳 loopback-only、不携带任何数据。
- **三问视图**（默认页）：**有需要我的吗**（person/confirm 票直接给 确认/拒绝 按钮，person/answer 与 blocked/failed 列出待办，安静默认）；**什么状态**（票按阶段分组、组头计数 = 列表长度，stageText 朗读票面原值）；**结果在哪**（等您验收票的报告四段 + 负责人目录清单）。每票详情折叠授权记录 / Trigger / Assignment 时间线 / 内部 id（一概念一位置）。
- **确认裁决**：person/confirm 票的一键 confirm/reject 与 `POST /route resolution` 同一条状态机路径（fork 由代码执行、票面记 confirmOutcome）；面板按钮带二次确认（破坏性动作需确认）。验收动作暂留给 L1 聊天裁决，面板只读呈现。
- **设置页**：飞书 bot 管理（唯一总 bot：名片/连接状态/明文权限清单/扫码绑定与重新注册，授权边界由飞书管理后台配置）、GitHub（轮询开关/间隔 ≥30s/login 白名单；监听清单**跟随 owner 注册表**——注册了 repo 负责人即监听其 origin，只读展示）、并发槽（≥1）。每个设置块一条保存条、仅变更时出现；写回即时生效（所有读者读同一活 config）并持久化为 `stateDir/hub-bot.settings.json`（0600），重启自动回放——**插件永不编辑 profile**。未知节/键与非法值 HTTP 400 拒绝且不破坏既有 overlay。
- **系统健康**：飞书凭据/连接、GitHub 轮询错误、outbox 失败与系统级问题计数、正在退避重试的投递（模型等待的可见信号）——健康时该条不占空间（安静默认）。
- **API**：`GET /overview`（三问数据：票+负责人注册表+健康）、`GET|POST /settings`、`POST /tickets/resolve`。`GET /settings` 返回有效值 = profile ⊕ overlay，标注飞书凭据状态等活 Source 信息。
- 实证：`docs/evidence-task-11.md`（面板服务与 token 门禁、设置写回即时生效+重启回放、确认/拒绝裁决、三问真实数据）。

## 危险命令黑名单（spec「Policy」安全兜底，#73 补足）

- **为什么**：经插件注入链路的会话**无人值守执行命令、不弹审批**（对齐 superagent Executor——远程场景下审批即失效），所以安全兜底 = 渠道侧授权（飞书可用范围 / GitHub loginAllowlist）+ 授权记录可追溯 + **危险命令黑名单**。
- **命中即挂起**：任何注入路径（L1 路由、追问、GitHub/飞书自动入口、L2 的 `inject_session`）的消息文本先做黑名单匹配（大小写不敏感子串）。命中 → **不注入**，票转「等您确认」（先存后做：原文、命中模式、目标存入票面 `pendingConfirm.action`），面板三问页给出确认文本（指明模式与风险）。
- **确认才放行**：用户在面板确认（`POST /tickets/resolve` confirm）后，按票面存储的原文原样注入（携授权记录，注明「已经用户确认放行」）；拒绝 → 票转被卡住且永不注入。与 fork 确认同一条状态机路径（票面记 confirmOutcome）；24 小时未确认由清扫自动取消。
- **清单可配**：`security.dangerousPatterns`（字符串数组，默认含 `rm -rf` / `sudo` / `git push --force` / `mkfs` / `dd of=/dev` / `chmod -R 777` 等级别模式），面板设置页可编辑（每行一个模式，写回即时生效 + 0600 落盘 + 重启回放）；留空 = 显式关闭兜底。
- 实证：`docs/evidence-task-13.md`（路由/GitHub 入口命中挂起→确认放行/拒绝阻断、名单热更新即时生效、设置校验 400）。

## 已知限制

- `sessionController.prompt()` 注入的消息 source.kind 为 "user"，与人手输入不可区分；Source/Trigger 层需按 superagent AgentDelivery 模式打插件自有 source 标记（幂等 requestId 已由插件生成 `hub-bot-<uuid>`，路由注入为 `hub-bot-route-<uuid>`）。
- 会话的 permission/sandbox 记录显示 `danger-full-access`（dev profile 默认值）；负责人的只读保证来自 **preset 工具面**（无写/执行工具可调用），不来自会话沙箱模式。收紧沙箱 preset 属 profile 配置，不在本插件范围。
- 插件配置校验为手写 resolveConfig，未引 schemastery——零运行时依赖的取舍；后续若接 DSH 设置 UI 再评估。
- 危险命令黑名单是**大小写不敏感子串匹配**的启发式兜底：减少误操作与明显危险注入，不能防御刻意混淆（base64/变量拼接等）；真正的边界仍是渠道侧授权 + preset 工具面 + 用户确认裁决。
- 被删重建依赖"注入失败"这一信号：`session "<id>" not found` 与 `ApiSessionNotFound` 之外的删除表现（如静默丢弃）不会被识别为重建触发。
- **owner 重建后的孤儿会话**（#65 首跑实证）：负责人会话被删重建后，旧会话仍在且保持 owner preset；它出现在 search_sessions 结果里（registry 已指向新会话，无法标记 role:'owner'），可能被 L2 误当执行会话注入，形成嵌套委托。功能上闭环仍成立（嵌套层也是 owner，最终完成并 report），但属噪声；后续可考虑按会话的 preset 名或启动侧写登记来识别孤儿。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-markdown-outline — Markdown preview for the Session

A DSH Web bundle that turns Markdown files into a **Session View** beside the
Conversation: every plan and Markdown file the Session has produced or opened
is listed on the left, and the selected document renders on the right.

## What it does

- **Claims Markdown files, then hands them to the view.** Registers an
  `extension`-band right-Sidebar tab type for `dsh-resource://file/session/…`
  addresses ending in `.md`, `.markdown`, `.mdown`, or `.mdx`, and for
  `dsh-resource://plan/…` plan resources. Opening one from a Chat file link, a
  tool result, a file tree, a deliverable card, or a plan card does not open a
  reader beside the chat: the transient tab hands the document to the Session
  View, selects it there, and closes itself.
- **A Session View, beside Conversation.** `conversation.view` adds a
  **Markdown 预览** tab to the Session's view row (Conversation, Trajectory,
  Context, Team, …). The view lists this Session's plans and Markdown files,
  flat and with no workspace level, each expandable into its headings (`H1`–`H6`,
  including setext headings). Plans show their title once the plan resource has
  been read.
- **Document on the right.** Selecting a file or heading renders its Markdown
  (ATX and setext headings, paragraphs with CommonMark soft and hard breaks,
  fenced and indented code with a copy control, nested ordered/unordered and
  task lists, tables with alignment, blockquotes, rules, inline code, emphasis,
  strikethrough, links, autolinks, images through the authenticated `/api/file`
  route, and a leading YAML frontmatter block). Heading clicks scroll to the
  source line; relative file links select the target file in the same view.
- **Plans are Markdown too.** A plan resource is read through the registered
  plan provider, so a submitted plan renders exactly like a file, with its title
  and headings in the tree.
- **Latest content.** Opens read the file through `ctx.remote.workspaceFiles` in
  pages until EOF (bounded at 4 MiB / 40 pages) and record the file's version.
  The standard `useResource('file')` hook reports the version the Sidebar keeps
  live, so a version change re-reads the document while it is open; a page read
  that meets a newer version restarts.
- **Per-Session memory.** Each Session keeps its own opened-document list and
  selection; the view shows only that Session's documents.

## Limitations

- The view is a reader: it does not edit files.
- The list covers documents this plugin has seen opened or redirected, not every
  Markdown file in the workspace (use the files tab for the directory tree).
- A plan or file that is opened outside this plugin's tab type (for example an
  absolute `dsh-resource://file/absolute/…` address) is not claimed.
- The renderer is a self-contained Markdown subset; reference-style links,
  footnotes, raw HTML blocks, math, and syntax highlighting render as plain text.
- Reads stop at the configured Host page limits, 4 MiB, or 40 pages, and say so
  in the document header area.
## Install

The package is a DSH bundle: `dsh.bundle.patch` inserts one Loader row and
`dsh.client` serves the browser half. Install it from a checked-out directory
with **Plugins → Add plugin**, or from the published repository with the
package-manager spec the Host accepts (for example
`github:giant-panda666/dsh-markdown-outline`). Enabling the bundle requires a Host
restart only when the profile replaces an installed package under the same
name; a first install activates live.

The persisted tab kind stays `markdown-outline` on purpose, so Markdown tabs
opened before a package rename keep their body.

## Layout

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: a no-op `apply()`; the row exists so the Web carrier serves the client bundle. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: tab type, Session view, document list, Markdown renderer, and plan support. React is the only module it requests. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row `markdown-outline`. |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin Manager title, description, and detail page. |
| `icon.svg`, `docs/` | Display artwork and the single-image detail page. |

## Develop

`client.js` is a hand-written `window.__ModuleLoader__` factory (no build step).
A profile bundle installed from this directory is linked, so editing
`client.js` is delivered to an open page by the Client HMR poll.

```sh
npm test     # node --check client.js + the browser-free smoke test in test/
```

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # @hiai-gg/dsh-docsmint [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/hiai-gg/dsh-docsmint) English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md) DocsMint in the DeepSeek Harness: a **left-sidebar panel** for your workspace and **five agent tools** the model can call, over either the DocsMint REST API or the DocsMint MCP server. - **DocsMint Cloud** (`docsmint.com`) — default. MCP mode authorizes through the DocsMint OAuth flow (dynamic client registration + PKCE); API mode uses an API key. - **Self-hosted DocsMint OSS** — second option. API mode works today; MCP mode targets an instance that serves `POST /mcp` (Streamable HTTP) and authenticates with that instance's API key. > **Stable release: `1.0.0`.** Includes incremental document loading and the last successful refresh time. ## Install The bundle is a DSH plugin package (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`). Install it into a profile from the registry: ```text plugin_manager install_bundle target: @hiai-gg/dsh-docsmint ``` Install the stable package: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @hiai-gg/dsh-docsmint dsh --profile web --dump-config dsh --profile web ``` or from a checkout while developing: ```text plugin_manager install_bundle target: ``` Then open the **DocsMint** icon in the left sidebar and connect. ## Updating and removing Install a specific newer version in the same profile with the profile-scoped `dsh plugin --profile web add` command above. To remove it: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web remove @hiai-gg/dsh-docsmint ``` Removing the bundle does not delete DocsMint documents. Disconnect the plugin's own authorization before removal when needed; other integrations are unaffected. To roll back, install the previous known-working version explicitly. ## Troubleshooting - No sidebar entry: confirm the bundle is installed in the profile you launched, inspect `--dump-config`, and restart that profile. - Cannot save credentials: enable the Harness credential store. The panel does not persist secrets in browser storage. - Cloud OAuth fails: check the configured endpoint and authorization callback; reconnect from the panel without sharing tokens or callback URLs. - Self-hosted connection fails: check the instance URL and key permissions. MCP requires authenticated Streamable HTTP at `POST /mcp`; use API mode if your instance does not provide it. - Unexpected documents: verify workspace, category and folder, then reset filters. - Report the package and Harness versions and a redacted error. Never include API keys, OAuth tokens, or credential-store contents. ## What the panel does - Connect DocsMint Cloud through OAuth (no API key), or connect either deployment with an API key stored in the Harness credential store. - Browse documents with **workspace / category / folder filters** and a **sort** (updated, title, created), create categories, folders and documents inline, and **edit a document's title and Markdown body** and save it. - Open any document in the DocsMint web app at `/w//documents/`. - Show which tools the agent has and which transport is active. Category, folder and workspace filters and sorting are sent to the server before pagination. Use SDK 2.1.0-compatible DocsMint endpoints for this behavior. ## Tools for the agent | Tool | Purpose | |---|---| | `docsmint_list_workspace_structure` | Discover visible folders and categories with IDs; in MCP mode, also discover workspaces | | `docsmint_search` | Hybrid search over the workspace; returns ids, titles, snippets, scores | | `docsmint_get_document` | Read one document with its Markdown body and a link | | `docsmint_create_document` | Create a document, optionally inside a folder | | `docsmint_update_document` | Update a document's title and/or Markdown body | The tools use the same operations as the panel, so both stay consistent, and they follow whatever transport the connection uses. ## Configuration The Loader row accepts optional fields (all live in `config/cordis.patch.yml`): | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `baseUrl` | Pins the API base, e.g. `http://localhost:50700/api/v1`. Pinning disables the panel's deployment choice. | | `mode` | Pins `api` or `mcp` for every session. | | `deployment` | Pins `cloud` or `self-hosted` semantics. | | `workspace` | Workspace slug used for `X-Docsmint-Workspace` and for document links. | | `apiKey` | Key from the patch instead of the credential store (CI and headless setups). | Credentials live in the Harness credential store under `DOCSMINT_API_KEY`, `DOCSMINT_WORKSPACE`, `DOCSMINT_ENDPOINT`, `DOCSMINT_MODE` and `DOCSMINT_OAUTH` (OAuth token record). Environment variables of the same names are honoured as a fallback. ## Privacy - The API key and OAuth tokens never reach page code; the panel talks to the Host over a same-origin route, and the Host talks to DocsMint. - The plugin sends nothing anywhere except the DocsMint endpoint you configure (`docsmint.com` by default). - No telemetry, no analytics, no third-party requests. ## Compatibility Built and tested against DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` (protocol `2025-06-18` for MCP) and DocsMint MCP server `2.0.4`, on Node 22. `engines` declares both bounds: `node >=22` and `dsh >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0` — the upper bound is raised only after the suite passes against the newer Harness. CI runs Node 22 and 24. The client half uses only the `slots` and `locale` client services and the `react` module from the browser module table. ## Brand The sidebar entry draws the DocsMint mark from the brand asset itself: `dm` plus the leaf, traced to paths and simplified (mask overlap 0.991 against the trace, ~1.7 KB instead of ~4 KB of pixel steps), so the letters follow `currentColor` and read on both themes while the leaf keeps the brand mint `#19B3A8`. `assets/` carries the standalone variants — `docsmint-mark.svg` (dark ink), `docsmint-mark-dark.svg` (light ink) and `docsmint-mark-mono.svg` (`currentColor`) — for documentation and for hosts that need a file instead of inline SVG. The registered plugin icon (`icon.png`) is the DocsMint app tile as served at `docsmint.com`, so it stays readable in both themes. ## Development ```bash npm test # adapter, host security/lifecycle and registered-panel behavior node test/mcp.mjs # adapter + OAuth against a local fake MCP server node test/plugin.mjs # registration, isolation, credentials, unload node test/client.mjs # registered-panel filter/sort and creation requests npm pack --dry-run # what the published tarball contains ``` `.github/workflows/dsh-plugin.yml` runs the three test suites on Node 22/24, installs a real packed archive in an isolated directory and checks exported assets. A matching `dsh-plugin-v*` tag publishes through OIDC with provenance; prereleases use `next` and stable versions use `latest`. ## License Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](./LICENSE). ## Releasing the plugin The plugin has independent versions and tags; do not change the SDK or server version. Update this package version, its changelog and the matching workspace entry in `bun.lock`, then merge the normal PR. Create and push an annotated tag `dsh-plugin-v` on that merged commit. The dedicated workflow tests Node 22/24, verifies the installed tarball, publishes it using the existing npm trusted publisher and checks registry integrity and provenance. It then attaches the same tarball to a plugin GitHub release. No long-lived npm token is required. Prereleases go to `next`; stable versions go to `latest`. Published versions and tags are immutable. Pin an exact version when reproducing a report or rolling back. ## Repository mirror [HiAi-gg/dsh-docsmint](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/dsh-docsmint) is an automatically generated package-root mirror for catalog discovery. Source changes and npm releases remain in this monorepo. Do not edit or merge changes from the mirror. ## Support the project If the integration is useful, you can star the [plugin mirror](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/dsh-docsmint) or the [DocsMint source](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint). Stars are optional and do not unlock features. New to DocsMint? [Create a Cloud account](https://docsmint.com/signup) or [install the self-hosted application with Docker](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint#quickstart), then return to the plugin to connect. Installing this plugin alone does not create a workspace or run the DocsMint server. # DocsMint **Turn your documents into knowledge you and your AI agents can use.** Write and organize notes, guides, and project documentation in one workspace. Find answers with search that understands related concepts, then give your agents access to the same documents through MCP, REST, the SDK, or CLI. **[Connect DocsMint Cloud](https://docsmint.com/mcp/connect?source=github_mcp)** to get started without operating the stack, or **[self-host with Docker](#quickstart)** to run the Apache-2.0 application on your own infrastructure. Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Connect your AI agent Connect DocsMint Cloud instantly or run the self-hosted stdio bridge against your own DocsMint API. Both paths give agents access to persistent knowledge; the self-hosted bridge exposes 22 focused tools covering all 31 existing operations plus bounded batch actions and direct workspace-item inspection, with 2 prompts and 3 resources. **Recommended: [DocsMint Cloud setup](https://docsmint.com/mcp/connect?source=github_mcp).** No server installation is required. Sign up or log in, choose your workspace, and follow your client's connection instructions. OAuth-capable clients use browser consent; API-key clients create an MCP/API credential in the authenticated browser UI. Hosted MCP follows your plan and workspace permissions. Prefer workspace-bound or category-scoped credentials. The Cloud endpoint is `https://docsmint.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). OAuth-capable clients discover the hosted resource and authorization-server metadata; current authorization and client-connection methods are described in the [DocsMint Cloud setup guide](https://docsmint.com/mcp/connect?source=github_mcp). Browser consent binds access to the selected workspaces, optional categories, and requested scopes. DocsMint Cloud 1.1.9 and later supports hourly access tokens and rotating refresh tokens for up to 30 days from authorization when the client supports renewal. Existing connections need one reconnect to enable refresh; clients without refresh support still reconnect after access expires. API-key clients can instead send `Authorization: Bearer ` with an MCP/API credential created in the authenticated browser UI. Credentials cannot create or elevate other credentials; lifecycle management belongs to the signed-in browser session. **Self-hosted alternative:** run [DocsMint with Docker](#quickstart), create an API key in its browser UI, and configure `HIAI_DOCS_URL` and `HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY` for `npx --yes --package @hiai-gg/docsmint docsmint-mcp`. Install Bun 1.4.4 or later to execute the published binary. The npm package is a stdio bridge to your own API; it does not install the DocsMint application or Cloud OAuth server. See the [MCP guide](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/packages/mcp-server/README.md) for client configuration. The [Glama OSS Server listing](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/HiAi-gg/docsmint) describes this bridge; the hosted [DocsMint Cloud Connector](https://glama.ai/mcp/connectors/io.github.HiAi-gg/docsmint) is a separate listing. ## Why DocsMint? - **Keep knowledge easy to edit.** Use a rich visual editor or Markdown; organize documents with folders, categories, and tags. - **Find the document you mean.** Search combines keywords, meaning, typo tolerance, and graph relationships across languages. - **Keep agents close to the source.** Let your tools search, read, and update the same knowledge through MCP, REST, a typed SDK, and CLI. - **Choose what an integration can access.** Category keys grant explicit `read`, `edit`, and `write` permissions for a defined part of your library. - **Keep retrieval up to date.** Document edits and metadata changes refresh the search index automatically in the background. - **Choose how you run it.** Use [managed DocsMint](https://docsmint.com) or self-host the application, database, search, queues, and files. ## Integration diagnostics REST and HTTP MCP responses include a server-issued request ID in the X-Request-ID header. Include that ID when reporting a failed request. See the [2.1.7 release notes](docs/release/v2.1.7-notes.md). ## Document version patch 2.1.4 Preview and restore historical content without reloading the editor. See [2.1.4 release notes](docs/release/v2.1.4-notes.md). ## Security patch 2.1.1 Bun 1.4.4, SvelteKit/Vite and Better Auth patch refreshes preserve the existing MCP/REST contract. See [2.1.1 release notes](docs/release/v2.1.1-notes.md) and the [security report](docs/security/2026-11-02-security-refresh.md). ## What's new in 2.1.0? - Add stateless Bearer HTTP MCP for self-hosted installations, including the public web-origin proxy and configurable Origin/CORS policy. - Keep the 22-tool catalog and generate schemas, annotations and branch examples from real MCP discovery. - Return redacted argument diagnostics as JSON-RPC errors without replacing upstream dispatch; keep compatible compact text and structured results. - Add server-side document filters, stable cursor pagination, scoped totals, previews, metadata-rich export and normalized search fields. - Add credential/workspace discovery and an explicit SDK API prefix while retaining existing routes, fields and methods. [2.1.0 release notes](docs/release/v2.1.0-notes.md). ## Previous release: 2.0.4 Hosted MCP integrations can discover granted workspaces, including empty spaces, with `list_workspace_structure(kind="workspaces")` and select one with the optional `workspaceId` argument. The catalog remains 22 tools. Host authorization hooks preserve the connection's existing workspace/category boundaries. Multi-scope reads carry labeled results and independent pagination. Existing single-scope calls remain compatible. The OSS frontend adopts SvelteKit 3; dependency updates resolve the current security audit findings. No database migration is required. See the [2.0.4 release notes](docs/release/v2.0.4-notes.md). ## Previous release: 1.0.3 - Make MCP tool selection clearer: use a single-document tool for one document and `batch_documents` when multiple explicit IDs need the same action. - Keep the 22-tool catalog, all 31 underlying operations, input schemas, authorization, and stdio behavior unchanged. The LobeHub tool descriptions match the released MCP catalog. - DocsMint Cloud remains a separate hosted Connector. Cloud descriptions change only when the hosted service adopts this package version. No database migration is required. See the [release notes](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/releases/tag/v1.0.3) and [changelog](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). ## Install with an AI agent Prefer an assisted self-hosted setup? Give your coding agent this prompt. You will need Docker and a choice of AI provider. ```text Install DocsMint from https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint. Verify Docker and Docker Compose v2, clone the repository, and run `bash scripts/quickstart.sh`. Do not print or commit .env. Ask me to enter only an OpenRouter key or select Ollama, then run quickstart again. Verify http://localhost:50701, http://localhost:50700/api/health, and `docker compose ps`. Do not replace Bun, rewrite migrations, disable GraphRAG, or delete volumes. ``` After startup, open **http://localhost:50701** and create the first account. For manual installation, use the Docker quickstart below. ## Quickstart ### Requirements - Docker Engine or Docker Desktop - Docker Compose v2 - One of: - an [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/) API key; or - a local [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) instance ### Start with Docker ```bash git clone https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint.git cd docsmint bash scripts/quickstart.sh ``` On its first run, the script creates an ignored root `.env`, generates the database, authentication, and storage secrets, builds the PostgreSQL image, applies migrations, and starts the complete application. Published application images are on [Docker Hub](https://hub.docker.com/r/vgalibov/docsmint). There is no untagged `latest` image; pull the role-specific tags: ```bash docker pull vgalibov/docsmint:api-latest docker pull vgalibov/docsmint:web-latest docker pull vgalibov/docsmint:caddy-latest ``` Use versioned tags `api-v1.0.3`, `web-v1.0.3`, and `caddy-v1.0.3` for reproducible deploys. Caddy is the supporting reverse proxy with rate limiting; it is separate from the API and web application. The quickstart still builds the Compose stack from this repository so PostgreSQL, Redis, and SeaweedFS start together with the application. For OpenRouter, add one value to `.env` and run the script again: ```dotenv OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-your-key ``` For Ollama, select the local provider instead: ```dotenv AI_PROVIDER=ollama OLLAMA_PORT=11434 ``` Then make sure the configured local models are available: ```bash ollama pull bge-m3 ollama pull qwen3:8b bash scripts/quickstart.sh ``` Open **http://localhost:50701**. The API health endpoint is **http://localhost:50700/api/health**. ### First use 1. Create your account in the web application. 2. Create a category or folder and add or import a document. 3. Wait for the document pipeline to finish chunking and embedding. 4. Search using an exact phrase, a related concept, an alternate language, or a misspelling. 5. Open **Settings → API** when you want to connect a CLI, MCP client, or external application. The canonical local ports are: | Service | Port | | -------------------- | ------: | | Web application | `50701` | | REST API | `50700` | | PostgreSQL | `5437` | | Redis | `6384` | | SeaweedFS S3 gateway | `50702` | | SeaweedFS filer UI | `50703` | See [Deployment](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) for domains, TLS, provider tuning, backups, and production operation. Embedding provider URLs, models, and credentials are deployment configuration. They are never stored in browser settings or local storage. ## Use DocsMint from the terminal One public package, **`@hiai-gg/docsmint`**, includes the TypeScript SDK, `docsmint` CLI, and `docsmint-mcp` bridge. These clients connect to a running DocsMint deployment; use the Docker quickstart to install the self-hosted server. ```bash bun add @hiai-gg/docsmint ``` ```bash bunx --package @hiai-gg/docsmint docsmint init \ --url http://localhost:50700 \ --key 'your-global-or-category-key' bunx --package @hiai-gg/docsmint docsmint search "project architecture" bunx --package @hiai-gg/docsmint docsmint list bunx --package @hiai-gg/docsmint docsmint read bunx --package @hiai-gg/docsmint docsmint create \ --title "Release notes" --content "# Highlights" ``` Credentials can also be supplied through `HIAI_DOCS_URL` and `HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY`. See the [CLI guide](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/packages/cli/README.md) for every command and configuration precedence. ## Connect an MCP client Give agents a secure path to search, read, and maintain your knowledge without database or filesystem access. DocsMint publishes MCP tools plus ready-made research prompts, scoped resources, and a document-manager skill. ### Hosted DocsMint Connect directly to the managed Streamable HTTP endpoint. Keep the API key in an environment variable rather than writing it into client configuration: ```bash codex mcp add docsmint \ --url https://docsmint.com/mcp \ --bearer-token-env-var HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY ``` ### Self-hosted DocsMint Run the published stdio bridge against your own DocsMint API: ```json { "mcpServers": { "docsmint": { "command": "npx", "args": ["--yes", "--package", "@hiai-gg/docsmint", "docsmint-mcp"], "env": { "HIAI_DOCS_URL": "http://localhost:50700", "HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY": "your-global-or-category-key" } } } } ``` Category keys let you expose only the documents and operations an agent needs. Use a global key only for trusted owner-wide automation. See the [complete MCP reference](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/packages/mcp-server/README.md) for Bun, npm, local checkout, all tools, prompts, resources, permissions, and REST mappings. ### Self-hosted HTTP The same 24-tool contract is also available at `/mcp` on your installation's **public web origin**. With the default Compose ports, that is `http://localhost:50701/mcp`; with Caddy, use your normal application domain, such as `https://docs.example.com/mcp`. The web server streams requests to the backend using its trusted `API_URL` setting (`http://api:50700` in Compose). Do not point `API_URL` back at the public web server. Create a global or category-scoped key in **Settings → API**, then supply it as an environment variable to your MCP client: ```bash codex mcp add docsmint-selfhost \ --url https://docs.example.com/mcp \ --bearer-token-env-var HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY ``` Self-hosted HTTP uses `Authorization: Bearer `; it does not implement DocsMint Cloud OAuth or accept a browser session as an API credential. Category keys keep their existing category and independent read/edit/write restrictions. An ordinary OSS installation has a personal space rather than Cloud workspace slugs: omit `X-Docsmint-Workspace` on these requests. Configure the public application URL and the exact browser origins you trust: ```dotenv PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://docs.example.com CORS_ORIGINS=https://docs.example.com,https://trusted-client.example.com MCP_HTTP_ENABLED=true ``` `PUBLIC_APP_URL` is used for trusted absolute document links; leaving it unset keeps OSS document links relative. `CORS_ORIGINS` applies to the HTTP integration endpoints. An allowed browser origin receives CORS headers, an unknown Origin is rejected, and authenticated server clients may omit Origin. Do not use a wildcard for credentialed browser access. Compose passes these settings to the API container; restart the application through your normal deployment workflow after changing them. The HTTP transport is stateless and does not issue `Mcp-Session-Id`. Send MCP JSON-RPC through POST; accepted notifications return 202. GET and DELETE return 405 because this endpoint provides neither a standalone SSE listener nor server-side sessions. Clients must accept JSON and SSE responses: the installed MCP SDK can use SSE for legacy protocol requests even when modern JSON mode is configured. `/mcp/` is normalized internally without redirecting the POST or dropping its Bearer header. The proxy preserves response status, authentication challenges, CORS headers and streaming bodies, and does not forward browser cookies or server workspace assertions as authority. Set `MCP_HTTP_ENABLED=false` to disable this HTTP endpoint independently. The existing REST API and stdio bridge remain available; existing stdio client configuration does not need to change. ## TypeScript SDK ```bash bun add @hiai-gg/docsmint ``` ```ts import { DocsClient } from '@hiai-gg/docsmint'; const docs = new DocsClient({ baseUrl: 'http://localhost:50700', apiKey: process.env.HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY, }); const created = await docs.createDoc({ title: 'Meeting notes', content: '# Agenda', }); const results = await docs.search('what did we decide?'); console.log(created.id, results.items); ``` The SDK is a typed `fetch` client with retries for transient failures and idempotent document creation retries. See the [SDK reference](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/packages/sdk/README.md) and [REST API](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/docs/API.md). ## API keys and integrations Create and revoke integration keys from **Settings → API**. | Credential | Intended use | Access | | -------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | | Global API key | Trusted owner-wide CLI, MCP, SDK, or service | All owner content | | Category key | Least-privilege agent or product integration | One category with selected permissions | | Operator key | Administration and reindex operations | `/api/admin/*` only | Category permissions are explicit and non-hierarchical: - `read` permits list, read, search, and export; - `edit` permits updates to existing content, attachments, and versions; - `write` permits create, move, delete, share, and publish operations. Combine permissions when an integration needs more than one capability. API-key lifecycle operations require the owning browser session; an API key cannot create or elevate another key. Server-to-server integrations are not affected by browser CORS. Browser integrations must add their exact origin to `CORS_ORIGINS`. ## What is included? Documents use structured TipTap JSON as canonical content. Markdown is the source-editing, import, and export format. The same document store serves the web application and public integration interfaces. ```text frontend/ SvelteKit workspace and TipTap editor backend/ Elysia REST API, search, workers, and authentication packages/db/ Drizzle schema and migrations packages/sdk/ Typed API client packages/cli/ Terminal client packages/mcp-server/ MCP stdio and HTTP contract postgres/ PostgreSQL image with vector and graph extensions ``` The Docker deployment runs: - **Web** — document editor, folders, categories, sharing, settings, and search; - **API** — documents, attachments, versions, keys, search, and administration; - **PostgreSQL 18** — relational data, pgvector/pgvectorscale vectors, and the Apache AGE graph in one database; - **Redis 8** — BullMQ queues, caching, retries, and job recovery; - **SeaweedFS** — S3-compatible attachment storage. ## How search works Every document save schedules background work. Content is chunked, changed chunks are embedded, and the completed generation is activated atomically. The previous valid generation remains searchable if a provider call fails. Search combines exact title matches, multilingual lexical search, typo-tolerant fuzzy matching, semantic vectors, adaptive query expansion, and Apache AGE graph neighbors. Reciprocal rank fusion combines the channels without allowing one weak provider result to dominate. A cross-encoder then reranks the fused prefix against the original query (Voyage rerank-2.5 by default). On a labeled 24-document corpus that moved MRR 0.969 → 1.000 and nDCG@10 0.958 → 0.986 versus RRF-only. Rerank, expansion, embeddings, and AGE failures keep the remaining channels. Authorization is applied before retrieval and again before results are returned. GraphRAG is part of the normal search path in the reference configuration. It extracts entities after embeddings are ready and finds related documents beyond direct keyword or vector similarity. It degrades gracefully when an external model is unavailable. For pipeline internals and tuning, see [Architecture](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # doubao-image — generate images with the local Doubao app > 面向：使用者 · 状态：stable · 最近核对：2026-09-20 Registers one tool, `generate_image`, that drives the **locally installed and logged-in Doubao (豆包) desktop app** to produce a picture, saves the full-resolution file, and sends it into the conversation. ``` plugins/doubao-image/ ├── package.json # type: module, dsh.bundle.patch, exports ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle patch: the loader row ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # cordis plugin: the generate_image tool │ ├── doubao.mjs # app launch, prompt submission, result harvest │ ├── cdp.mjs # dependency-free Chrome DevTools Protocol client │ ├── watermark.mjs # removes Doubao's own overlay, with a self-check │ ├── image.mjs # minimal PNG codec + raster helpers │ └── generate.mjs # CLI driver, for testing without spending a model turn └── test/ # node --test (no DSH, no app, no network) ``` ## Install ```bash # from npm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-doubao-image # or from the repository root — the leading ./ matters: DSH anchors relative specs # against your current directory, otherwise pnpm would resolve it inside the profile dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/doubao-image ``` Then restart DSH (or reload the profile). The tool appears as `generate_image`. ## Use ```bash # exercise the whole path without going through the model node plugins/doubao-image/lib/generate.mjs \ --prompt "一只戴黄铜护目镜的橘猫，坐在双翼飞机驾驶舱里" \ --style "黏土质感 C4D 渲染，暖色夕阳光" \ --out ~/Pictures/doubao ``` The tool takes `prompt` (required) plus `style`, `composition`, `aspect`, `negative`, `count`, `dir`, and `reuseCurrentChat`. ## How it works, and why it is built this way Doubao ships a **full Chromium** (`Contents/Helpers/Doubao Browser.app`), and its launcher forwards unknown flags, so starting it with `--remote-debugging-port` yields a real CDP endpoint. That is the whole reason this works without the macOS Accessibility permission that `osascript` would need — which matters, because that permission is not granted on this machine. The findings each step depends on, all established by probing the running app: | Step | What is actually true | | --- | --- | | Launch | Doubao holds a **singleton lock**. A normally-launched instance never opens the debug port, and launching again just forwards to it. The app must therefore be quit and restarted — the first call costs ~10–40 s. | | Attach | `doubao-chat` is the real 1200×800 window. `doubao-launcher` is a 400×600 **sidebar that also accepts prompts** and renders results at 90 px, and `doubao-chat` is *additionally* served as an empty `hello` shell. Identification uses live window size plus the presence of the editor, never the URL alone. | | Type | The box is `div.tiptap.ProseMirror[contenteditable=true]`. `execCommand('insertText')` goes through the same `beforeinput` path a keystroke does, so the app's own state and send button update. Assigning `innerText` would not. | | Detect | The status sentence 「已生成 N 张候选图」 is the completion signal, not the image count — the grid mounts placeholders before the renders arrive. | | Harvest | The picture in the grid is a `cpreview_wm1` render behind an overlay, and its full-size sibling `` is a bare `data:image/svg+xml` **placeholder with no pixels**, so the bytes cannot be read from the grid. Instead the tool clicks each thumbnail to open the image viewer and uses the app's own `[data-testid=edit_image_download_button]`, which writes the file to `~/Downloads`; the tool then moves it to `dir`. | `dsh-doctor`-style checks live in the unit tests: the output schema must stay in sync with `execute`, because a tool that returns a value without a declared schema is refused at registration and takes the **whole plugin tree — and every DSH boot, the desktop app included — down with it**. ## The watermark Doubao stamps 「豆包AI生成」 into the bottom-right of every saved picture. It is an overlay the app composites on, not part of the artwork, which is what makes removal a solved problem instead of an inpainting guess. All of this was measured, not assumed: | Property | Measurement | | --- | --- | | Position | Anchored to the bottom-right corner; a glyph mask from one image correlates with an unrelated image's corner at **NCC 0.949** (inverse control −0.949, exactly symmetric) | | Scale | Proportional to the image's **short side**, not its width: 2048²→321×69 box, 1365×2048→214×46 box, both giving width/short ≈ 0.1567. Verified on a second sample per shape | | Blend | Plain alpha composite `C = a·W + (1−a)·B`, fitted at **a = 0.638**, W = 234.4, RMS residual 6.3/255 | | Soft edge | Glyph interiors measure a = 0.63 while the antialiased rim ramps to 0 — which is why a hard 0/1 mask left a visible outline | Removal inverts the composite per pixel, and estimates the artwork behind the mark by coarse-grid interpolation that excludes masked pixels. The output PNG is encoded losslessly (round-trip delta verified 0). **Self-check.** The `verifyOnFlat` helper turns "does it look clean?" into a number: on a flat-background sample the artwork behind the mark is a constant, so any residual offset inside the glyph area *is* the watermark that survived. Measured on a flat 2048² sample: **residual 46.3 → 0.0 (100% removed)**. On a photograph the same metric would be meaningless, so it detects a non-flat frame (background IQR > 8) and says so instead of printing a flattering zero. **Scope.** This targets this one overlay, at this one anchor, with this one calibrated blend. It is not a general watermark remover. It exists for internal reference material — animation reference, storyboards, internal review. Doubao's official API (Volcengine Ark) returns images with no watermark at all, and that is the right channel for anything published or commercial. **Stripping is off by default** (owner's decision, 2026-09-25): an image comes back with Doubao's own 「豆包AI生成」 badge unless the caller explicitly asks for `stripWatermark: true`. Keeping the badge is the safe default — it is what makes a picture traceable to the tool that made it — and the capability stays here for the internal-reference case described above. ## Known limitations - **Generation consumes the user's Doubao quota** (the app reports 「本次生成将 消耗每日免费额度」). Exactly one generation is issued per call; if the plugin cannot confirm a submission it stops rather than retrying, because a blind retry is what once produced duplicate generations. - **The app window is closed and reopened** on the first call, and Doubao must stay running-and-instrumented for the harvest to complete. - The harvest depends on Doubao's own UI markup (`image-box-grid`, `edit_image_download_button`). A Doubao redesign breaks it; the selector surface is deliberately kept to those two names. - The watermark pass only re-encodes PNG. # dsh-plugin-mobile-link

[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![listed in awesome-deepseek-harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/listed%20in-awesome--deepseek--harness-4D6BFE?logo=awesomelists&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Dominic789654/awesome-deepseek-harness)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-mobile-link)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-mobile-link)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](../../LICENSE)

> 面向：使用者与实现者 · 状态：stable · 最近核对：2026-09-20

**The computer half of [DSH Mobile](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile): it
dials a relay over WSS, so the native iOS client reaches this DSH instance even
though the computer has no public IP.**

```
iPhone App ──WSS──▶ Relay（公网，只鉴权与转发）──WSS──▶ this plugin ──HTTP+WS──▶ 127.0.0.1:<port>
```

The connector always talks to the local DSH as `127.0.0.1:<port>`, so the host's
authority and its trust fence are unaffected: no `--trusted-host`, no rewritten
`Host`, no new listening port on this machine.

```
plugins/mobile-link/
├── package.json          # type: module, dsh.bundle.patch, bin: dsh-mobile-link
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch: the loader row + config reference
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # cordis plugin: starts the agent, registers 5 routes
│   ├── link.js           # the DLP agent transport: identity, socket, heartbeat, reconnect
│   ├── router.js         # frames ⇄ local DSH mux streams, per-device `$events`
│   ├── dlp.js            # DLP v1 frame codec (shared with the relay)
│   ├── files.js          # phone → computer file transfers (`_link/file*` methods)
│   ├── enroll.js         # open enrollment (no invite code), writes ~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json
│   ├── journal.js        # lifecycle journal: why a relay link was dropped, after the fact
│   ├── routes.js         # status, enroll, pair-code, pair-code/regenerate, devices/revoke
│   ├── qr.js             # dependency-free QR SVG
│   └── cli.js            # dsh-mobile-link: enroll / mint-pair-code
└── test/                 # node --test, 100+ tests (no DSH, no network)
```

## Install

The connector runs in whichever host runs your DSH. There are two supported hosts today —
**the official desktop app** and **the command-line web host** — and each keeps its own
profile, so you install the plugin into the one you actually use. The connector discovers
the local DSH by itself in both (the host hands it the authenticated loopback address);
you never type an address or a token.

**Command-line web host**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-link
```

**Official desktop app** — install through the app's own plugin page, or with the CLI that
the app ships (`…/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh`, installable from its settings). The npm
`dsh` refuses this profile on purpose (`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the
Electron application`). Two prerequisites matter in practice: let the app start once so it
initializes its profile, and **quit it completely** before installing — otherwise the
profile is locked.

```bash
# quoting the app's bundled CLI; see docs/ONBOARDING.md for the section titles
"<DeepSeek Harness.app>/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-mobile-link
```

Then restart the host (or reload the profile). From a checkout the same command takes
a path — the leading `./` matters, because DSH anchors a relative spec against
your current directory instead of resolving it inside the profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/mobile-link
```

## Use

1. Register this computer with a relay (once). Open the **移动端连接** panel at the
   bottom of the DSH sidebar: the relay address is prefilled (editable) from the
   installation default; click **登记**. The connector derives the computer name
   automatically, writes `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` and reconnects in place —
   no terminal and no DSH restart. Open enrollment is the default; the relay
   rate-limits by source. If an installation has no panel (headless, CI), the CLI
   still works:

   ```bash
   dsh-mobile-link enroll --relay wss://<你的站点>/dsh-link
   ```

   …or register it on the relay host with `dsh-relay admin agent-register
   --write-config ~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json`.

2. The same panel shows the pairing code and its QR once the relay link is up.
   The CLI can still mint one directly:

   ```bash
   dsh-mobile-link --mint-pair-code        # prints JSON: code + relay + agentId
   ```

   The code is persistent: it stays valid until you click 重新生成. Each paired device
   has a quiet 撤销 action; revoking one device leaves the code and other devices alone.

3. Scan it in the iOS app. The code can be claimed again for another phone, a reinstall
   or a new device; only 重新生成 revokes it (already-paired devices stay connected).
   After that the phone reconnects on its own — nothing else has to be run by hand.

`GET /mobile-link/status` reports whether the link is up, which devices are
attached, and whether this computer is registered yet. Its `enroll` block also
carries `panel` (this connector can enroll from the DSH panel), `relayPrefill`
and `relayLocked` (the address to prefill and whether it came from config).
`POST /mobile-link/enroll` performs that enrollment (open enrollment; no invite code); it returns the agent id and
name, never `agentSecret`, and is behind the same DSH request fence as pairing. `GET /mobile-link/devices` lists the full paired roster (including offline) for the panel, and
`POST /mobile-link/devices/revoke` revokes one paired device by `deviceId` through the relay; both are behind
the fence and authenticated with the agent secret. Its `journal` block carries
the current process's newest lifecycle events (link opened/closed with the reason,
device attached/detached); the counters in it reset when the plugin hot-reloads, so
the full history — across restarts — is the JSONL file at `journal.path`.

## Configuration

All optional; the defaults are what a stock deployment needs. Set them in the
plugin's config block (`cordis.patch.yml`), not by editing this file.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` stops the outbound link without uninstalling |
| `relayUrl` | from `agent.json` | Relay base URL; a bare deployment dials `<relay>/link/agent`. Pinning a real value here outranks the enrolled identity and makes the panel field read-only |
| `defaultRelayUrl` | empty | Form-only default: prefills the panel's relay input, but never outranks the enrolled identity. Official installs set this so users can still edit it |
| `agentId` / `agentSecret` | from `agent.json` | Override the enrolled identity |
| `stateFile` | `~/.dsh/mobile-link/agent.json` | Where the identity lives |
| `journalFile` | `~/.dsh/mobile-link/link-events.jsonl` | Lifecycle journal (rotated once at 256 KiB); `false` keeps it in memory only |
| `slowRequestMs` | `2000` | A slower single request gets its own `request.slow` entry; `0` disables those (per-attach `device.summary` is still written) |
| `diagnostics` | `true` | `false` refuses the phone's phase uploads; the phone ignores the refusal and stays connected |
| `dshUrl` | discovery | Explicit local DSH base URL (usually unnecessary — the host hands the connector its own address) |
| `heartbeatMs` | `20000` | DLP ping interval |

The connector does **not** read an endpoint handoff file any more: discovery happens inside
the host process (`ctx.inject(['webServer','connection'])`), which is what makes one npm
package work on both the desktop app and the command-line host. It **writes** one instead —
`$DSH_HOME/mobile-link/endpoint.json`, mode 0600 — for tools that run *outside* the host
(our dev/test scripts and the iOS integration helpers).

Address resolution order: this config block, then `DSH_RELAY_URL` (or
`DSH_MOBILE_LINK_RELAY`), then the enrolled identity file, then the repository
placeholder `wss://relay.example.com/dsh-link` — the placeholder being the
"nothing configured yet" sentinel rather than a real address.

## Design notes

- **No required services.** `inject` is empty and the routes are attached through
  `ctx.inject([...])`, so a future DSH that renames or drops `webServer` /
  `connection` cannot make the tunnel fatal on boot.
- **Protocol-transparent.** Nothing outside `lib/` is imported and no DSH
  business API is touched: the connector forwards frames, it does not interpret
  sessions. The relay has the same property.
- **Disable** by removing the row from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, or by
  setting `enabled: false`.

## Test

```bash
cd plugins/mobile-link && npm test    # zero dependencies
```

The wire protocol is specified in
[`docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md`](https://github.com/jayantTang/DSH_Mobile/blob/main/docs/RELAY-PROTOCOL.md).
