# dsh-global-supervisor

> [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**

Global supervisor plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): cross-workspace project management, task dispatch, status monitoring, scheduled inspections, and event response — without modifying DSH core.

A single Router session manages many project workspaces: identify projects, dispatch tasks, resume sessions, receive structured worker reports, run periodic patrols. All state persists in SQLite and survives host restarts.

## Highlights

- **Router/Worker split** — the Router session holds 24 `supervisor_*` tools; worker sessions report via `worker_report` with server-side permission checks (not prompt constraints).
- **Task state machine** — `pending → queued → running → completed` plus `blocked / need_human / failed / canceled`; strict transition table with audit trail; Task/TaskRun separation keeps retry history intact.
- **SQLite persistence** — 13 tables on built-in `node:sqlite`, zero native dependencies.
- **Event-driven** — webhook intake + 5 cordis event subscriptions with a unified dedup pipeline; observe/auto rule routing; multiple events batched into one Router notification.
- **Thread passthrough** — tasks created from an event auto-subscribe to its thread; follow-up events on the same thread go straight to the assigned worker, bypassing the Router.
- **Context recall** — `supervisor_recall` pulls related context (thread events, subscriptions, worker reports, run history) in one hop.
- **Watchdog, 4 classes** — startup-timeout retry, run-timeout retry, need-human escalation, idle/lost worker detection; 5-minute scans.
- **IM push (optional)** — need-human alerts and completion summaries to Feishu/Telegram etc. via dsh-im, with automatic fallback to the Router session.
- **Model control** — per-task / per-project model selection and switching; `steer` to inject instructions into a running task.
- **Serial dispatch** — ModelQueue defaults to concurrency 1 with priority queue-jumping that never preempts a running task, tuned for local inference.
- **Scheduled inspections** — reuses the DSH native host-wide Schedule service (0.2.2-rc.x); no custom cron.

## Requirements

- DSH Desktop **0.2.2-rc.x** (host-wide Schedule requires 0.2.x; 0.1.x is incompatible)
- Node ≥ 22.19 (built-in `node:sqlite`; shipped with the DSH runtime)

## Install

```powershell
# Run in the DSH Desktop built-in terminal (replace "desktop" with your profile name)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-global-supervisor
```

Restart DSH Desktop. **Installing is not enough**: open the settings panel ("Global Supervisor") and assign a Router session first. IM push is optional (configure a dsh-im bot). Patch-level configuration options: see `cordis.patch.yml`.

For development, link mode works too: in the profile directory run `pnpm add "dsh-global-supervisor@link:<repo path>"` and add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles`.

## Documentation

Full documentation ships inside the npm package (in Chinese) at `node_modules/dsh-global-supervisor/docs/`: USER_GUIDE (usage), DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, API_COMPATIBILITY (API contract + host sandbox contract), ITERATION_PLAN, TEST_PLAN, DEPLOYMENT, TROUBLESHOOTING, INTEGRATIONS. Engineering discipline: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## Development

Build and tests must run on the DSH runtime node (≥ 22.19; PATH node is often too old). All release gates (tsc, client bundle, vitest, bundle smoke) run via `node scripts/prepublish-check.mjs`, wired to `prepublishOnly` — `npm publish` enforces them automatically.

## Status

Version 0.5.2 — the full planned feature set is complete: 25 tools (24 Router + `worker_report`), 190 unit tests, and every major flow verified end-to-end against a real DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.x host.

## License

MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
--- description: "An artifact-backed security review layer for a dsh profile: 29 host tools, ten bundled skills, and a Web workbench that seal schema-validated scans, findings, coverage, and exports under the profile data directory." kind: "package-bundle" --- # @lornatang/dsh-codex-security English | [中文](README.zh.md) ## Summary `dsh-codex-security` adds a reproducible security review workflow to a dsh profile. It registers 29 `codex_security_*` host tools, ten bundled skills, and a Codex Security section in the Web GUI that lists scans, findings, coverage, and exports. The `add` command inserts one patch row into the profile and `remove` takes it out. The bundle records and validates what an agent reviews: it does not analyze source, execute target code, or dispatch workers, and each scan seals immutable artifacts under the profile data directory. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package The layer gives an agent a durable place to record a security review and gives the profile a Web panel to read and export the result: every scan binds its target, revision, and scope, keeps candidates and validations between turns, and seals a schema-checked artifact set on disk. ### Install into a profile ```text dsh plugin --profile add @lornatang/dsh-codex-security dsh plugin --profile remove @lornatang/dsh-codex-security ``` For the GitHub 0.1.7 release, use `dsh plugin --profile add https://github.com/Lornatang/dsh-codex-security/releases/download/v0.1.7/lornatang-dsh-codex-security-0.1.7.tgz`. The npm registry version may be older. The `add` command composes the layer into the profile: the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` gains an insert entry, row id `codex-security`, whose `config` starts from the bundle defaults `maxFiles: 5000`, `maxFileBytes: 1048576`, and `defaultMode: standard`; every other field takes its default from `src/config.ts`. The package manifest points `dsh.bundle.patch` at that document. The `remove` command deletes the row and leaves scans already written under the profile data directory untouched. Restart DSH after installing or removing, because the row is composed when the profile starts. On start the plugin logs `codex-security: registered 10 skills` and `codex-security: ready (state dir will resolve on first scan)`, and the Web GUI gains a Codex Security entry under Settings; profiles that do not run the Web client still receive the tools and skills. A new profile starts with no scans. The first request that touches the store — the workbench status request or `codex_security_inspect_setup` — resolves the state directory and creates `/repositories/`; a scan record appears only after one of the start tools runs, and the plugin itself reviews nothing. Scans live under `/repositories//scans//`, where `repoKey` is the first 16 hexadecimal characters of the target root's SHA-256 and `scanId` is `cs_` plus 24 hexadecimal characters; `` defaults to `data/codex-security` next to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (for the shipped Web profile, `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/data/codex-security`). `scan.json` holds the bound target, scope, inventory, progress, and diff list; `index.json` is a rebuildable list cache. Completion requires a draft submitted with `complete: true`, at least one coverage surface, a final disposition for every candidate and every bound diff file, and an unchanged snapshot digest; the plugin then validates the findings, coverage, and manifest documents against `schemas/`, records hashes in `scan-manifest.json`, and seals the scan. Sealed artifacts are immutable, triage is stored separately and stays editable, and exports default to `/exports/.`. Repeated default exports receive a numbered suffix; an explicitly supplied output path must not already exist. ### What you get The package owns three surfaces in the composed profile: 29 host tools, ten skills, and one workbench section in the Web GUI. [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md) documents each tool's arguments and return shape. - **Setup and target inspection:** `codex_security_inspect_setup`, `codex_security_inspect_target`. - **Scan lifecycle:** `codex_security_start_scan`, `codex_security_start_standard_scan`, `codex_security_start_prompt_only_scan`, `codex_security_start_deep_scan`, `codex_security_get_scan_context`, `codex_security_update_scan_context`, `codex_security_update_scan_progress`. - **Discovery and candidates:** `codex_security_record_discovery_candidates`, `codex_security_list_candidates`. - **Validation:** `codex_security_record_candidate_validations`, `codex_security_record_candidate_attack_paths`. - **Draft and sealing:** `codex_security_record_scan_draft`, `codex_security_complete_scan`, `codex_security_fail_scan`, `codex_security_cancel_scan`. - **Agent artifacts:** `codex_security_save_artifact`, `codex_security_read_artifact`. - **Findings and triage:** `codex_security_list_findings`, `codex_security_set_finding_triage`, `codex_security_set_finding_remediation`. - **Diff review:** `codex_security_prepare_review_items`, `codex_security_list_review_items`, `codex_security_update_review_item`. - **Review and comparison:** `codex_security_list_scans`, `codex_security_get_scan`, `codex_security_compare_scans`. - **Export:** `codex_security_export_findings`. The skill catalog gains ten entries, each loaded from `skills//SKILL.md` at startup with `source: bundled` and both model and user invocation: `security-scan`, `security-diff-scan`, `deep-security-scan`, `fix-finding`, `verify-fix`, `triage-finding`, `threat-model`, `track-findings`, `resolve-dependency-alert`, and `vulnerability-writeup`; [skills/](skills/) holds the workflow text for each. The Web GUI gains one `settings.section` row, id `codex-security`, order 41, label Codex Security, registered by this package's client half (`src/client/index.tsx`, shipped as `lib/client.js`) through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`. The panel shows the version, the resolved state directory, and scan and finding counts; it lists scans with status and age, and opens the selected scan's Overview, Findings, Coverage, and Artifacts & exports panels, including a triage selector and download links for SARIF, JSON, CSV, and Markdown. The panel reads the same service through HTTP routes under `/plugins/codex-security`. ### Configuration The bundle ships the row below, so a profile only lists what differs from it; the profile's own entry is applied after the layer and wins. The loader validates each field against `src/config.ts` and rejects an invalid value at startup instead of substituting a default. ```yaml # $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: codex-security config: maxFiles: 5000 maxFileBytes: 1048576 defaultMode: standard failOnSeverity: high allowExportOutsideWorkspace: false maxScanAgeDays: 30 deepWorkers: 4 deepMaxDiscoveryRuns: 40 # stateDir: /var/lib/dsh/codex-security ``` | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `stateDir` | empty | Directory that holds scans and exports. Empty resolves to `data/codex-security` next to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, or to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/data/codex-security` when no profile patch path is available. | | `maxFiles` | `5000` | Files inventoried per target, 1–200000; truncation is recorded as a scan warning. | | `maxFileBytes` | `1048576` | Per-file size cap for the reviewable inventory, 1024–67108864 bytes. | | `defaultMode` | `standard` | Mode used by `codex_security_start_scan`: `standard`, `prompt-only`, or `deep`. | | `failOnSeverity` | `high` | Policy gate threshold: `informational`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`, or `off`. | | `allowExportOutsideWorkspace` | `false` | Permits exports outside the state directory, the process working directory, and the target root. | | `maxScanAgeDays` | `30` | Age at which the workbench marks a scan as older than the policy window, 1–3650 days. | | `deepWorkers` | `4` | Worker budget recorded on deep scans, 1–32. | | `deepMaxDiscoveryRuns` | `40` | Discovery-pass budget recorded on deep scans, 1–10000. | ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand The layer is one patch row: an `insert` of id `codex-security`, package name `@lornatang/dsh-codex-security`, and three config values. Nothing is platform-gated on the host side; the manifest's `dsh.client.platform: web` scopes only the client bundle, while the host plugin registers tools and skills in any profile that injects them. Cordis must inject `tools` and `skills` before `apply` runs. `apply` builds a `SecurityService` from the resolved config and the profile patch path, then registers the 29 tools, discovers and registers the ten bundled skills from `skills/*/SKILL.md`, and binds optional HTTP routes, each in a disposal-aware effect. The state directory is not created at startup; `ScanStore.init` creates it on the first store access. A start tool resolves the target, binds revisions or diff facts, inventories reviewable files within the caps, computes a snapshot digest, and writes `scan.json` under the scan directory. Later tools append the draft, candidates, validations, attack paths, review items, and saved artifacts, with a per-scan queue serializing mutations. Completion re-resolves the target, rejects a changed digest, checks the draft and coverage contract, builds the findings, coverage, SARIF, and Markdown documents, validates the findings, coverage, and manifest documents against the bundled schemas, and writes the manifest that seals the scan. The workbench reaches the same service through `handleRequest` under `/plugins/codex-security`, registered on `webServer` or `httpServer` when one exists. The client half is compiled separately to CommonJS and wrapped for the DSH module loader; it injects into `settings.section` and fetches those routes. Neither half calls a network service, executes target code, or dispatches workers: the sealed manifest records `runtimeStatus: not_executed` and `validationMode: static_source_review`. Concurrency is in-process: a per-scan queue serializes read-modify-write operations, and the store writes JSON through same-directory temporary files followed by rename. These are not cross-process locks, so sharing one state directory between DSH processes is unsupported. | Source | Contents | |---|---| | `cordis.patch.yml` | The layer: one insert entry, row id `codex-security`, three config defaults. | | `src/index.ts` | Host entry: `apply`, configuration export, bundled-skill discovery and registration. | | `src/config.ts` | `Config` interface, `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, and the schema ranges enforced at startup. | | `src/constants.ts` | Package and plugin names, version, route prefix, tool and skill name inventories. | | `src/service.ts` | Scan lifecycle: target binding, drafts, validations, sealing, findings, exports, and comparisons. | | `src/store.ts` | State directory resolution, scan directories, index cache, atomic JSON writes, sealed-file sets. | | `src/target.ts` | Target resolution, file inventory, content hashing, and language and size caps. | | `src/git.ts` | Git revision, diff, and changed-file queries. | | `src/tools.ts` | The 29 `codex_security_*` tool definitions and their argument schemas. | | `src/routes.ts` | `/plugins/codex-security` HTTP routes used by the workbench. | | `src/contracts.ts` | Finding normalization and fingerprints, coverage, SARIF, and the policy gate. | | `src/schema.ts` | AJV validation of sealed documents against `schemas/`. | | `src/types.ts` | Shared scan, finding, coverage, and record types. | | `src/util.ts` | Filesystem, hashing, timestamp, and JSON helpers. | | `src/client/index.tsx` | The workbench settings section and its fetch calls. | | `tests/*.test.mjs` | Unit, real-host integration, and scan-regression suites. |
----- ## Further Exploration - [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — release history and the unreleased fixes. - [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md) — every tool's arguments, return shape, and lifecycle rule. - [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — host lifecycle, target binding, state and sealing, concurrency. - [docs/ARTIFACTS.md](docs/ARTIFACTS.md) — artifact contracts for scans, findings, coverage, and manifests. - [docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md) — product surface, configuration, storage, and workbench routes. - [docs/VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md) — the automated checks and package inspection commands. - [schemas/](schemas/) — the JSON Schema contracts enforced at sealing. - [references/](references/) — security guidance used by the scan skills. - [examples/](examples/) — a completed scan and a legacy completed scan. - [DeepSeek Harness package-bundle template](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/skills/dsh-doc-writing/templates/package-bundle.md) — the document convention this README follows. - [Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE). ----- ## Model Experience Indirectly, through the 29 registered tool schemas and ten bundled skill descriptions: their names, descriptions, and argument schemas enter the model's tool and skill catalogs, and scan state otherwise reaches the model only as JSON results of tools the agent calls. #### KV Cache effect Activating the layer adds 29 tool definitions and ten skill catalog entries to the prompt prefix the host builds for a session, and removing the layer removes the same text. Within a session the catalog is stable, so the added tokens belong to the cached prefix and do not grow per turn; starting, updating, and completing a scan append ordinary tool results and assistant messages after that prefix. The layer injects no system prompt text and owns no model-facing prose beyond the tool and skill descriptions it registers. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work These limits define when the layer does not fit and what it needs from the profile around it. - **Records, does not review** — the host stores and validates what an agent submits; it performs no source analysis, cannot verify that a skill was followed, and cannot guarantee that submitted coverage is exhaustive. - **No execution and no network** — target code is never built, run, or fetched, and a sealed manifest records `runtimeStatus: not_executed` with `validationMode: static_source_review`, so runtime-only weaknesses stay outside the evidence. - **Deep budgets are recorded, not enforced** — `deepWorkers`, `deepMaxDiscoveryRuns`, the discovery-pass stop rule, and the time budget are stored on the scan for the agent workflow; the host does not dispatch workers or stop a run that exceeds them. - **One process per state directory** — the layer is added per profile and shares no state between profiles; its locks are in-process, so two DSH processes on one state directory are unsupported and a failed seal can leave intermediate files in a running scan. - **Sealing is one-way** — agent artifacts can be written only while a scan is running, and `codex_security_save_artifact` refuses sealed and internal paths; triage is the only post-completion mutation, and it never changes the sealed documents. - **Exports stay local by default** — writing outside the state directory, the process working directory, and the target root requires `allowExportOutsideWorkspace: true`; exporting into the scan storage under `repositories/` is always refused. - **Native support for file exports** — the matching optional platform binary must be available for file export; if it is missing, export fails closed while scans and in-memory exports remain available. The binary package has no dependency install script. - **Inventory caps bound the evidence** — `maxFiles` and `maxFileBytes` limit the reviewable inventory, unreadable files become warnings, and the snapshot digest covers only inventoried content, so files outside the caps are outside the evidence. - **Comparison does not prove a fix** — `codex_security_compare_scans` requires completed scans with a compatible target, mode, and scope, complete coverage, and non-truncated inventories, and it classifies fingerprints only; a missing fingerprint is not a verified fix. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand `npm run build` removes `lib/`, compiles the host with `tsc -p tsconfig.json`, compiles the client with `tsc -p tsconfig.client.json`, and runs `node scripts/bundle-client.mjs` to wrap `lib/client.js` for the DSH module loader. `npm test` builds first and then runs `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`; `npm run typecheck` runs both compiler projects with `--noEmit`; `npm pack --dry-run` lists the published files. Node.js 22.19 or newer is required by `engines`, and the host needs `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (~4.1.0) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` (>=0.2.2-rc.2 <0.3.0) as peer dependencies, with the pinned DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 packages in `devDependencies` backing the host integration test. The compiled `lib/` output is tracked and CI checks that a rebuild leaves it unchanged, so edit `src/` and rebuild rather than patching `lib/`. Scan state under the profile's `data/codex-security` directory is user data: `index.json` is rebuildable, `scan-manifest.json` seals each completed scan, and deleting sealed files destroys the evidence the manifest describes.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-tower

[![CI](https://github.com/louifinn/dsh-tower/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/louifinn/dsh-tower/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-tower.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tower)
[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/louifinn/dsh-tower)
[![Listed on dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/louifinn/dsh-tower)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/louifinn/dsh-tower?ref=badge)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[English](README.en.md)

**Tower** 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的多代理编排插件。它把一个 agent 会话变成一个小型工程团队：会话本身是*控制塔*，worker agent 在隔离的 Git worktree 里实现任务，改动经 scope/合并门禁合入基线分支；独立审查可在配置中强制开启。

Tower 模式与 mission/审查工作流的灵感来自 Moonshot AI 的 **Kimi Code** 中实验性的 Tower 模式（[Kimi Code](https://www.kimi.com/code)）。本项目是面向 DSH 的独立实现，与 Moonshot AI 无隶属关系；详见[致谢](#致谢)。

仓库根目录**就是** DSH bundle 包根：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`cordis.patch.yml` 位于根目录，符合 DSH 插件规范。

## 特性

- **可配置的 Tower 模式。** `/tower` 切换会话级模式：收窄工具面并注入 Tower 协议；`/tower on|off <指令>` 还能把指令作为下一步用户消息转发给模型。默认也允许 Agent 通过 `tower_mode({active:true/false})` 带理由进出；设 `mode.allowAgentControl:false` 可改为仅人类控制。
- **显式的所有权交接。** 仓库状态绑定初始化它的会话。旧会话结束后，新会话可用 `/tower takeover <原因>` 接管（人类命令，任何配置都可用）；模型也可在 Tower 模式中通过 `tower_mode({active:"takeover", authorization:"<审计引用>"})` 请求接管，但必须得到用户明确批准。旧属主仍活跃、仍有运行中的 roster Agent 或外部工作区锁时会拒绝；交接保留全部历史与未读消息，并写入一条 `takeover` 活动记录，不会自动释放所有权。
- **任务级隔离。** 每个 mission 使用独立分支和 Git worktree，worker 不会碰到你的主检出。
- **三种 mission 形状，一个注册表。** 每个 mission 是 `build`、`survey` 或 `artifact`，其状态、完成证据、
  供给方式、路径权限与 spawn 契约都由 shape 拥有，不再散落 `if (kind === …)` 分支。survey 只读：
  固定一个 `readCommit`（默认在 detached sandbox 中）即可完成，不需要提交、分支或合并。artifact 与
  build 一样使用 worktree，声明具体的交付物路径，并且只凭人类对已提交末端（tip）的接受记录合并，
  而不是审查。
  `npm run shape:audit` 会拒绝第二套词汇、`domain/shapes/` 之外的按 kind 条件、
  `domain/evidence.js` 之外的证据读取，以及角色检查与 shape 检查混合的写法。
- **审查门禁合并。** 审查策略是插件页上的一个三态控件：`off`、`optional`（默认）或 `required`（配置键 `review.mode`）。设为 `required` 时，审查者针对当前分支 tip 给出 `clean` / `merge` 结论；合并门禁重新校验 scope、分支新鲜度、任务完成度、审查记录与 worktree 归属，通过后才执行 `--no-ff` 合并。独立审查默认可选；策略为 `required` 时，单个 mission 可用 `reviewPolicy:"none"` + 理由并开启 `gates.allowReviewExemption:true` 做更窄豁免。升级提示：旧的布尔审查开关是保留一个版本的别名；映射关系见[安装、升级与迁移](docs/zh/guide/install-upgrade-migration.md)。
- **可恢复的协作状态。** roster、inbox、findings、reviews 与 mission 状态持久化在 `.git/dsh-tower/` 下，重启不会丢计划。
- **受控的状态增长。** worktree 已移除的终态任务在达到 `archive.afterDays`/`archive.maxMissions` 后移入 `.git/dsh-tower/archive/`，保留 tasks、reviews、findings 与完成报告；此后 mutation 只重写活跃工作。`tower_inspect({view:"status", includeArchived:true})` 列出压缩后的归档摘要，`tower_inspect({view:"doctor"})` 报告归档大小、数量与策略。
- **默认安全。** Tower 模式开启期间拒绝 `create_goal`、`update_goal(resume)`、`todo_write`、Team 任务板与 `spawn_teammate`；被暂停的 goal 不会被自动恢复。
- **可追溯的 finding 生命周期。** `tower_finding` 按 `open → triaged → fixed` / `wontfix` 列表、读取与流转，也可重新打开；只有 tower 或 worker 能改状态，reviewer 只能读。
- **仓库级配置。** 每个仓库可用 `<git-common-dir>/dsh-tower/config.json` 覆盖 review/merge/worktree/spawn 策略，工具参数再覆盖仓库配置；无需为不同仓库改 profile。
- **稳定错误码。** 工具失败统一带 `[tower:<code>]` 前缀（如 `mission-not-found`、`preset-missing`、`config-invalid`），调用方可稳定分支处理。
- **角色强制与可控中断。** worker 不能直接完成/放弃 mission 或扩界（完成必须走 `tower_complete` 证据门），tower 可随时用 `tower_interrupt` 停止跑偏的 agent；`tower_send(interrupt:true)` 可中止运行中的 turn。
- **仓库互斥与限流。** 可选 `mode.workspaceLock` 让同一仓库只有一个 Tower 会话；`spawn.maxLiveWorkers`、`send.maxPerMinute`、roster stale 标记约束并发与消息风暴。
- **可热重载。** 在带 DSH HMR 的 profile 中，`/tower reload`、`tower_reload` 与 `npm run dev:hmr` 让 linked 插件代码改动无需重启即生效；`plugin_manager` 安装/更新本身即时生效。
- **测试证据门与事件。** worker 可在 `tower_complete` 记录 `checks`，`gates.requireChecks` 可强制；每次 mutation 后发射 `tower/*` 事件并刷新 `MISSIONS.md`。
- **2.1 验证与运营。** `tower_test` 执行 worktree 声明的 `tower.testDiscovery`（TAP/json-array，准入可设 spawn/complete），`tower_inspect` 的 `doctor` 视图提供只读健康契约，`tower_batch` 批次证据收口，`tower_resource` advisory lease，`tower_import` 只读旧版导入与审计映射；新增 `worker-stale`、tests 门禁、plan/tower 互斥、`workspaceLockScope`、`docs.boardLocation` 与交付 ack。

## 何时使用 Tower

Tower 是**面向 Git 仓库变更的交付协议**，不是所有多代理场景的默认答案。它适合：

- 一个特性/重构能拆成 2–8 个 scope 清晰、可独立审查的 mission；
- 有依赖顺序、需要分支新鲜度与 scope 约束的迁移；
- 敏感仓库、发布绑定变更，或需要"可审计合并 + 测试证据"（需要时开启独立审查）的工作；
- 跨上下文压缩、重启、多天协作，需要从本地状态恢复的工作；
- 需要把"完成"定义成任务 + 测试（可选独立审查），而不是聊天里的一句"好了"。

不适合：单文件/一行 hotfix、需求仍在探索、开放式研究、大量极小的独立任务、交互式 UI 配对、或跨仓库工作。判断标准：**如果你不会为它开 PR，Tower 很可能太重。**

与其他模式的区别（详见[完整指南](docs/guide/scenarios-and-philosophy.md)）：

- **普通并行子代理**：便宜、灵活，适合只读探索/试方案；没有 worktree、审查与合并门禁。
- **Agent Teams**：共享任务板与多人/多 agent 协作，适合设计、研究、横切决策；集成通常由人做，没有 Git 隔离的硬门禁。
- **Ralph 循环**：用新鲜 agent 对同一目标反复尝试，适合迭代搜索/修复；没有 mission 契约与合并审查。
- **Workflow 编排**：脚本化高扇出/流水线，适合批量分析、审计、验证；不做 Git 分支隔离与合并门禁。
- **Tower**：少量 mission + 隔离写入 + 可选独立审查 + 证据 + 合并门禁，适合"决定要做、需要安全落地"的仓库变更。

Tower 模式会拒绝 Team/Workflow/Ralph/普通 subagent 工具并清除 plan mode，避免两套编排协议同时驱动一个会话；请按阶段组合，例如先用 Workflow/Team 分析决策，再用 Tower 执行仓库变更。

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.3`（已验证的 host 构建见 [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md)）
- Node.js 24.9+
- Git（worktree 在本地创建，不需要联网）

`scripts/support.json` 是唯一的公开支持基线。当 package engines、mount-smoke host pin、live CI 矩阵
或 COMPATIBILITY 最新行与它不一致时，`npm run support:check` 会失败。

## 安装

把已发布的包安装到 DSH profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tower
```

在 DSH 中也可以用插件管理器指定同一目标：

```text
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-tower" })
```

开发时改为从 GitHub 安装或链接本地 checkout：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:louifinn/dsh-tower
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本仓库的绝对路径>
```

Host 插件在 DSH 进程启动时加载，**安装或更新后需重启 DSH**。卸载使用 `remove_bundle`，包名 `dsh-tower`。

可选的 Web UI 随 npm 包一起发布在 `ui-bundle/`：npm 安装后目标为
`<profile>/node_modules/dsh-tower/ui-bundle`，源码安装时为目标仓库的 `ui-bundle/` 目录。用
`plugin_manager({action:"install_bundle", target:"<该目录>"})` 安装并重启 DSH，然后刷新页面。

### 已知冲突

不要同时安装 `dsh-plugins-tower`（第三方包）。它的 loader row 也使用 `name: dsh-tower`，会解析到
本包，导致本包被加载两次或对方代码不生效。`tower_inspect` 的 `doctor` 视图的 `loader-conflicts` 检查会报告该情况；
卸载冲突包并重启 DSH。

## 快速开始

```text
/tower on

tower_init      repoRoot=D:\work\repo            # 首次初始化，记录 base（默认当前分支）
tower_plan      repoRoot=D:\work\repo missions=[{"title":"Feature A","scope":["src/a/**"],"tasks":["implement","commit"],"kind":"build"}]
tower_spawn     repoRoot=D:\work\repo missionId=M1 role=worker
# worker 在 worktree 内实现并提交，调用 tower_complete；最终报告会返回本会话
# 可选：需要强制独立审查时，先设 review.mode:required
tower_spawn     repoRoot=D:\work\repo missionId=M1 role=reviewer
# reviewer 只读审查并调用 tower_review（clean+merge 或 p1-Nitems/p2-Nitems）
tower_inspect   view=preflight repoRoot=D:\work\repo missionId=M1    # 默认审查可选（review.mode:optional）；设为 review.mode:required 时审查前预期 no-review，审查后 ok:true
tower_merge     repoRoot=D:\work\repo missionId=M1
tower_teardown  repoRoot=D:\work\repo

/tower off
```

小改动通常一轮 worker 即可完成；需要独立审查时再加一轮 reviewer。完整可复制示例见 [docs/examples/first-mission.md](docs/examples/first-mission.md)，逐工具参数见 [docs/reference/tools.md](docs/reference/tools.md)。

## 命令

| 输入 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `/tower` | 开启 Tower 模式（已开启则保持） |
| `/tower on` | 开启或保持 |
| `/tower on <指令>` | 开启/保持，并把 `<指令>` 作为下一条用户消息转发 |
| `/tower off` | 退出 Tower 模式 |
| `/tower off <指令>` | 退出并转发 `<指令>` |
| `/tower ack` | 记录人类确认，供 `mode.requireHumanAckOnFirstEntry` 使用 |
| `/tasks`、`/tower tasks` | 只读实时 roster 面板（不消耗模型回合、不写状态）；宿主已占用 `/tasks` 名字时使用 `/tower tasks` |
| `/tower <指令>` | 确保开启，然后转发 `<指令>` |

图片与文件附件会随指令一起作为一条完整的 `UserMessage` 转发。

运行时前置条件（preset 行、组件行与配置的冲突）只在**进入**模式的路径上重新校验：
裸 `/tower`、`/tower on`、`/tower on <指令>`，以及模式关闭时的 `/tower <指令>`。已经开启
模式后的 `/tower <指令>`、`/tower off`、`/tower off <指令>` 与 `/tower ack` 不再重复校验，
因此会话中途关掉某一行之后，人仍然退得出去、指令也仍然转发得出去；`tower_spawn`、规划与
合并/预检各自保留自己的护栏。详见 [组件行与消息语言](docs/guide/quickstart.md#component-rows-runtime-preconditions-and-message-language)。

## 组件模型

本 bundle 采用 **强制 host 锚点 + 可单独启停的可选行**（#121）：`cordis.patch.yml` 插入顶层
`tower` group（挂载 Host 插件与强制的 `preset-tower-worker`），随后是可选组件 `tower-skills`、
`tower-batch`、`tower-import`、`tower-leases`、`tower-tests`、`tower-hmr`（随包关闭）与
`preset-tower-reviewer`。在插件页关闭某一行，只会移除该能力；模式、规划工具、`tower_inspect`
与其余工具继续工作。

进入 Tower 模式与 `tower_plan` 前会校验必需的 preset。worker preset 是强制依赖；reviewer
preset 只在 `review.mode` 为 `required` 时必需，因此策略为 `off` 或 `optional` 时允许关闭
reviewer 行，策略为 `required` 时会以带解释的 `preset-missing` 锁定。`tower-tests` 关闭且
`gates.requireTests:true` 时同样拒绝。`tower_inspect` 的 `doctor` 视图与 `tower_recover` 不是组件、也没有配置键：
任何配置都会注册它们（#122）。

原则 11（[PRINCIPLES.md](PRINCIPLES.md)）与
[ADR 0005](docs/adr/0005-component-surface.md) 要求：只有关闭后仍不破坏其余能力的 capability
才能成为组件；host、健康检查、恢复通道与合并门禁永远不是开关。审查策略是唯一的
三态配置控件（off/optional/required），不是组件行。逐键答案见生成的
[组件表面](docs/reference/component-surface.md)，由 `npm run docs:check:components` 强制。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: tower-host
  name: 'dsh-tower'
  config:
    section: '（可选，兼容别名）覆盖 Tower 模式系统提示文案'
    allowAgentControl: true   # 兼容别名；等价于 mode.allowAgentControl
    mode:
      allowAgentControl: true
      autoPauseGoal: true
      # denyTools 默认等于外部编排组件注册的全部工具（Agent Teams、goal、
      # todo、ralph、subagent、workflow）；显式列表会替换该默认值，
      # 仓库层配置只能在其上扩展
    review:
      mode: optional             # 一个三态控件：off、optional（默认）或 required
      maxRoundsPerReviewer: 5
    merge:
      timeoutMs: 900000
    worktrees:
      root: ''                 # 空 = <主检出父目录>/.dsh-tower-worktrees/<hash>
    spawn:
      workerPreset: tower-worker
      reviewerPreset: tower-reviewer
      maxDepth: 1
```

- 代码中 `mode.allowAgentControl` 默认 `true`；随包 `cordis.patch.yml` 也显式设为 `true`：模型可在用户意图/任务状态明确时自行进出，但必须给出理由；设为 `false` 时只有人类能切换。随包 patch 还默认开启 `mode.workspaceLock`（单活塔）、`send.interruptDefault`、`init.autoGitInit`，并把 `spawn.staleMs` 设为 15s。
- `/tower base <branch>` 可设置会话级 init base 偏好；`/tower on` 会清除活跃 plan mode（`mode.planModePolicy:"refuse"` 则拒绝进入），保证 plan/tower 互斥；Tower 与 Ralph 循环同样按仓库互斥（`mode.ralphPolicy`，见 [ADR 0010](docs/adr/0010-tower-ralph-mutual-exclusion.md)）。
- 仓库级配置：在 `<git-common-dir>/dsh-tower/config.json`（通常是 `.git/dsh-tower/config.json`）放入同样的 JSON 结构，可覆盖 `review`/`merge`/`worktrees`/`spawn`；优先级为代码默认 < profile < 仓库配置 < 工具参数。`mode.*` 属于会话级，只在 profile 生效。
- 所有键与默认值见 [docs/reference/config.md](docs/reference/config.md)；未知键（顶层与分组内）都会被拒绝，防止拼写错误静默失效。三种审查模式、插件页控件位置与单版本别名迁移见[安装、升级与迁移](docs/zh/guide/install-upgrade-migration.md)。工具错误码见 [docs/reference/errors.md](docs/reference/errors.md)。

## 工具（21 个：15 个核心 + 6 个可选）

最多 21 个工具：15 个核心 + 6 个可选。默认 profile 实际注册 16 个；五个子系统行默认关闭，控制塔会话只挂载其中 14 个（不挂 `tower_complete` / `tower_review`）。

`tower_init` · `tower_plan` · `tower_mission` · `tower_inspect` · `tower_spawn` · `tower_send` · `tower_inbox` · `tower_complete` · `tower_interrupt` · `tower_finding` · `tower_review` · `tower_merge` · `tower_rebase` · `tower_teardown` · `tower_mode` · `tower_recover` · `tower_import` · `tower_test` · `tower_batch` · `tower_resource` · `tower_reload`

上面列出的是 15 个核心工具加 6 个由组件行拥有的可选工具（`tower_import`、`tower_test`、`tower_batch`、`tower_resource`、`tower_reload`，其中 `tower_reload` 属于随包关闭的 `tower-hmr` 行）。`tower_mode` 是会话工具：省略 `active` 只读，传入 `active` 才写；设 `mode.allowAgentControl:false` 可禁用写操作。`tower_recover` 属于核心：任何配置都会注册它（#122）；doctor 是只读的 `tower_inspect` `view: "doctor"` 视图。`tower_complete` 与 `tower_review` 分别由 worker/survey 与 reviewer 角色会话挂载；从控制塔误用会得到 `not-authorized` 提示和 `tower_spawn` 角色入口，而不是 unknown tool。`tower_init({op:"adopt"})` 承接旧的 roster 对账，`tower_finding({op:"report"/"list"/"update"})` 与 `tower_import({op:"snapshot"/"map"})` 同理（#163 Phase 4）。mission 级工具同时接受 `id` 作为 `missionId` 的别名；`task_done`/`taskDone` 等 snake/camel 写法均可。

**角色 × 阶段暴露（#164）。** 会话看到的工具是角色契约与宿主阶段的步时投影。Tower 模式关闭的塔会话只暴露 `tower_mode`（846 B）；模式开启但仓库尚无状态文件时加上 `tower_init`（2,185 B）；状态存在后暴露默认宿主准入的 14 个工具（16,017 B；随包挂载 16 个，减去 #163 角色谓词保留给 worker/survey 与 reviewer 的 `tower_complete`/`tower_review`）。21 个工具 / 23,109 B 是全部可选行开启时的构建表面，不是任何会话的基线。由 `tower_spawn` 派生的角色 preset 不受阶段梯子影响，继续使用各自的显式 allow-list（worker 6 个塔工具，reviewer 5 个，survey/survey-sandbox 各 5 个）。允许集合每个模型步解析一次并冻结，所以被隐藏的工具与不存在的工具完全一样（`UNKNOWN_TOOL`）；门禁只做减法且失败时放开。逐 profile 的字节基线与门禁规则见[表面预算](docs/reference/surface-budget.md)，设计记录见 [ADR 0009](docs/adr/0009-role-phase-exposure.md)。

## 安全与约束

- **门禁不全绿不合并。** 只读的 `tower_inspect` `view: "preflight"` 返回稳定的 blocker code；存在 blocker 时 `tower_merge` 拒绝合并。
- **审查绑定提交。** 策略为 `review.mode:required` 时，审查后分支 tip 变化会报 `tip-moved`，必须重新审查；reviewer 使用只读 preset，若在审查期间改动分支，提交审查会被拒绝。`off` 是受支持的模式，会移除 `tower_review`；`optional` 记录审查但从不阻塞合并。非 clean 的一轮审查会让 mission 回到 active，此后其他 route 仍可为同一 reviewed tip 提交结论并追加到同一轮；依赖为 `completed` 的 survey 视为已满足（build 依赖仍需 merged）。
- **scope 强制。** mission 只能修改其 scope glob 匹配的文件，越界会以 `out-of-scope` 阻止合并。
- **worktree 归属。** 脏工作树、运行中的 worker、已关闭 mission 的分支都会阻止合并或 teardown。
- **goal 隔离。** 进入 Tower 模式会暂停活跃 goal 并记录；退出不会自动恢复，需要你自行恢复。

表面计数（实时，由 `npm run docs:check` 校验）：21 个工具、42 个工具错误码、26 个进程内事件、58 个配置键、35 个稳定 blocker/failure code、13 个可见组件。默认 profile 注册其中 16 个。

五个子系统行默认关闭；`tower_inspect` 的 `doctor` 视图逐条显示「已关闭 + 开启方式」，同一张表在 [docs/reference/tools.md](docs/reference/tools.md) 的 “Default-off subsystems” 一节：

| 组件行 | 工具 | 开启方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `tower-batch` | `tower_batch` | 删除 `cordis.patch.yml` 中该行的 `disabled: true` 并重启 DSH |
| `tower-import` | `tower_import` | 同上 |
| `tower-leases` | `tower_resource` | 同上 |
| `tower-tests` | `tower_test` | 同上 |
| `tower-hmr` | `tower_reload` | 同上 |

稳定 blocker/failure code（含 gate 守卫、`no-check-evidence`、worker-stale、tests 门禁与 merge/rebase 操作失败码）——完整清单、触发条件与修复动作见 [docs/reference/blockers.md](docs/reference/blockers.md)。工具本身抛出的错误码见 [docs/reference/errors.md](docs/reference/errors.md)，事件见 [docs/reference/events.md](docs/reference/events.md)。

## 工作原理

mission 生命周期：`planned → active → completed → merged`（或 `blocked` / `paused` / `abandoned`）。状态位置：

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `.git/dsh-tower/state.json` | missions、roster、reviews、findings、inbox |
| `.git/dsh-tower/activity.jsonl` | 只追加的活动日志 |
| `<主检出父目录>/.dsh-tower-worktrees/<hash>/<missionId>` | 每个 mission 的 worktree |
| `$DSH_HOME/tower-mode/modes.json` | 每个 agent/session 的 Tower 模式状态 |

worker 与 reviewer 是使用内置 `tower-worker` preset 的普通 DSH 子代理；它们的工具被限制在 mission 允许面（文件系统、shell、Tower 协议工具），不包含 merge/spawn。

## 项目结构

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 清单与 loader patch（强制 `tower` host group + 可选能力行） |
| `index.js`、`host/`、`adapters/`、`app/`、`domain/`、`ports/`、`tools/`、`worker.js` | Host 入口；`domain/` 纯核心；`ports/` 契约；`adapters/` 唯一 I/O；`app/` 用例；`host/` 组合根与会话胶水；`tools/` 每工具一个 handler；worker preset 策略 |
| `locale/`、`icon.svg` | 本地化与图标 |
| `tests/` | 纯函数、协议 e2e、插件级测试；可选的真实 Web 运行时脚本 |
| `ui-bundle/` | 可选 Client 小挂件（Tower 工具卡片、Tower·on 状态 chip、模式感知的 disabled 行、dock 摘要、临时 overlay 状态条），默认不安装 |
| `.github/workflows/test.yml` | CI：Ubuntu 上 Node 22/24 与 Windows 上 Node 22 的离线套件、release 与覆盖率检查、Node 24 挂载 smoke 与种子失败 fixtures（固定 host 要求 Node >=24.9） |

## 开发与测试

```bash
npm test        # node --test tests/*.test.mjs
```

热重载开发：`npm run dev:hmr` 把本仓库加入当前 profile 的 HMR watch root（需重启 DSH 一次），之后编辑 `host/`、`adapters/`、`app/`、`domain/` 代码可用 `/tower reload` 或自动 watch 生效；详见 [docs/guide/hot-reload.md](docs/guide/hot-reload.md)。

离线套件不需要 DSH 进程，只在系统临时目录创建一次性 Git 仓库。隔离 Web 运行时检查、模型驱动验收和会话诊断脚本见 `tests/README.md`。

## CI 证明了什么

每次 push 与 PR 都运行同一组 job；每个 job 对应一条可检查的声明，而不是一句 README 承诺。

| Job | 声明 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| `test (24.9)`、`test (25)`（Ubuntu） | canonical 支持运行时 leg：每条 leg 只运行一次 `npm run check`——离线套件、文档一致性、生成文档、发布文件清单、架构、类型、支持清单、workflow 契约与 domain 纯度全部成立 | `npm run check` |
| `test (24.9, windows)`（`windows-latest`，必需检查） | 同一套 canonical `npm run check` 在真实 Windows 文件系统上成立；路径大小写、`pwsh` shell、rename/unlink 重试都不是只在 Linux 上被假设 | `npm run check` |
| `test (24.9)` 的 `Coverage (Node 24.9)` 步骤 | 覆盖率在 CI 中真实测量（只报告，不设阈值、不加徽章） | `npm run test:coverage` |
| `test (24.9)` 的 `Release check`（Node 24.9）步骤 | tag 是一种声明：tag 是 annotated tag 对象、其 commit 在 HEAD 历史中、工作树干净、版本已越过上一个版本 tag、CHANGELOG 带有该版本的发布内容、支持清单一致 | `npm run release:check` |
| `publish` 的 `prepublishOnly` 钩子（本地，`npm publish` 自动运行） | 发布前重跑同一套 release 断言，加上支持清单、生成文档与发布文件清单；只读、离线、不写工作树 | `npm run release:prepublish` |
| `mount`（Node 24.9） | 打出的 tarball 经 plugin CLI 装进一次性 profile 后，真实 loader 挂载并注册了 bundle 声称的表面 | `npm run smoke:mount` |
| `mount-fixtures`（Node 24.9，非必需检查） | mount smoke 仍会因正确的种子失败而变红（改名一个工具 id、删除 skills 段），三次运行共用一次缓存的 host 安装 | `npm run smoke:fixtures -- --host-dir <缓存的 host>` |
| `live (<固定 host 版本>)`（nightly/手动，非必需检查） | 浏览器 live suite 在固定 host 版本矩阵上仍能驱动真实 Web 运行时；push/PR 只做无浏览器的环境与解析检查 | nightly 跑 `npm run test:live -- --script nightly`；push 跑 `npm run test:live -- --check` |

canonical 三条 leg 在 job 内用 `matrix.label` 固定各自的 context 字符串：`test (24.9)`、`test (25)` 与 `test (24.9, windows)`，名字逐字节不变；把 `os` 直接塞进 matrix 会把它们改名成 `test (24.9, ubuntu-latest)`，保护规则将永远等不到该 context，所以矩阵用显式 `include` + `label`。`main` 在 `strict` 保护下有四条必需 context：`mount`、`test (24.9)`、`test (25)`、`test (24.9, windows)`。两步切换已经完成：三条 legacy `test (22)` 风格的 context 已移除，冻结的 legacy job 已删除。Windows leg 运行完整的 `npm run check`（无浏览器、无 live suite、无 release/coverage），与 Ubuntu leg 并行，不延长关键路径。切换过程、校验命令与回滚方式见 [docs/operations/ci.md](docs/operations/ci.md)。

live suite 需要下载浏览器并真实启动 host，因此移出 push/PR，改为 nightly `schedule`（另支持 `workflow_dispatch`），在固定 host 版本矩阵上运行；它的输出第一行打印解析后的 `DSH_HOME` 与 host 版本。push 上只保留 `--check`（环境 + Playwright 解析，无浏览器）。Playwright 由 `tests/live/package-lock.json` 固定，root 的 `npm ci` 不下载浏览器。

`tests/platform.test.mjs` 用注入的 `platform`/`rename`/`unlink` 在任意 OS 上同时断言 win32 与 POSIX 两条分支；唯一需要真实 Windows 的“rename 覆盖被打开的目标文件”用例在 Linux 上以 `# SKIP` 计入 TAP（`tests 11`、`skipped 1`），而不是静默消失。macOS 不单设 runner：它与 Linux 走同一条 POSIX 分支，这是 #86 的非目标。

`mount` 断言一次性 profile 的**已加载表面**，而不是 `cordis.patch.yml` 的文本：随包 profile 加载 16 个 `tower_*` 工具（20 个 `tools/*.js` 模块 + `tower_mode`，减去五个默认关闭子系统行的 `tower_batch`/`tower_import`/`tower_resource`/`tower_test`/`tower_reload`；所有可选能力行全开时为 21 个）、3 个内置 skill、`tower-worker` / `tower-reviewer` 两个 preset、`/tower` 命令、一个顶层 `tower` host group 以及可选的顶层能力行（`tower-hmr` 随包关闭）。它不调用模型、不打开浏览器。在维护者的 Windows 机器上实测：host 冷装（含安装）约 100 秒，host 已缓存约 85 秒；CI 中该步骤上限为 3 分钟（`timeout-minutes: 3`），`mount` job 上限 5 分钟。红叉会打印解析后的 profile 路径、host build、已加载计数与每一条未满足的声明。

host build 固定在 `scripts/mount-smoke/host.json`；`scripts/support.json` 记录公开支持基线，`npm run support:check` 保证 package engines、host pin、live 矩阵与 `COMPATIBILITY.md` 最新行一致，单元测试再保证该行与 pin 相等，发布时不再各写一遍。`npm run smoke:fixtures` 用两种种子失败（改名一个工具 id、删除 skills 段）证明 smoke 会以正确原因变红；CI 中它作为非必需的 `mount-fixtures` job 运行，control 与两个种子通过 `--host-dir` 共用一次缓存的 host 安装（本机热跑约 2 分钟）。

## 常见问题

- **安装/更新后插件不出现。** Host 插件在 DSH 启动时加载，请重启 DSH；并确认安装目标指向本仓库根目录（含 `package.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 的那一层），而不是子目录。
- **`tower_mode` 写操作不可用。** 配置中被设为 `allowAgentControl:false`；改回 `true` 并重启（读取模式不受影响）。
- **合并被阻止。** 运行 `tower_inspect({view:"preflight", missionId})` 查看 blocker code；`stale-base` 表示先执行 `tower_rebase`。
- **基线前进后分支过期。** `tower_rebase` 在 worktree 内完成 rebase；干净且无冲突的 rebase 可免去上一轮审查的重审。
- **合并提交已经存在，但 `tower_merge` 报了失败。** 重新执行 `tower_merge` 即可：它会检测已落地的合并提交（或分支已包含在 base 中）并记录为 reconciled，不会重复合并。
- **仓库的 `pre-merge-commit` 钩子很慢。** 合并超时默认 15 分钟，可按次通过 `tower_merge({ ..., timeoutMs: 900000 })` 调大；钩子输出缓冲上限 64 MB。钩子失败返回 `merge-hook-failed`（超时带 `timeout: true`），并保持仓库干净以便重试。

## 贡献

欢迎 issue 与 pull request。提交 PR 前请先运行 `npm test`，细节见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。安全相关问题请不要在公开 issue 里贴利用细节，先开一个最小化 issue 申请私下渠道。

## 致谢

- **Kimi Code（Moonshot AI）**：Tower 模式的整体概念——明确的会话级模式开关、每个 mission 独立 Git worktree、审查门禁合并协议——灵感来自 Kimi Code 的实验性 Tower 模式（[官网](https://www.kimi.com/code)、[源码](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code)）。本项目在 DeepSeek Harness 的服务之上重新实现这些想法，不包含 Kimi Code 源码，也与 Moonshot AI 无隶属关系。
- **DeepSeek Harness**：本插件构建所依赖的插件、工具、会话与子代理 API。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Tower UI (optional Client bundle)

An **optional** Web Client bundle for the Host `dsh-tower` plugin. It never touches Tower state directly: everything it renders is derived from the conversation the user is already looking at, or from the tool results already in that conversation. There is no Host → Client remote channel, no `host.call`, no DOM manipulation, no iframe, and no import of Harness Client packages (the only browser module-table word it requires is `react`).

Version: **0.2.2** (private, not published). The Host plugin version is unchanged.

This revision fixes GitHub **#11** (persistent, history-derived Tower-mode indicator in the composer dock) and **#12** (mode-aware `Tower mode · disabled` rows for guard-denied tools), see below.

## What it registers

| Surface | Slot | Registration | Data source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tower tool cards | `tool.call.toolview` (keyed, session) | 9 entries, one per `key`: `tower_inspect` (status/roster/diff/preflight/doctor views), `tower_spawn`, `tower_mission`, `tower_complete`, `tower_review`, `tower_merge`, `tower_teardown`, `tower_interrupt`, `tower_batch` | The Chat tool-call tree's owner props: `toolName`, `phase` (`preparing` / `start` / `result`), `block` (streaming start block or settled `tool/result` block), `callId`. |
| Composer dock | `conversation.composer.dock` (list, session) | `id: "tower-hint"`, `order: 6` | `useChat` standard selector hook (the durable Chat legacy slice). In Tower mode: a `Tower · on` chip. Otherwise, a Tower tool result in the conversation: a compact latest-status line. Otherwise: the static `/tower` hint. |
| Denied-tool rows | `tool.call.toolview` (keyed, session) | dynamic entries for the Tower-mode deny list, `priority: -10`, plus `update_goal` | The same history-derived Tower mode. Registered only while the displayed session is in Tower mode and disposed when it leaves, so the native toolviews (priority 0) return. |
| Overlay status strip | `shell.overlay` (list, root) | `id: "tower-status-strip"`, `order: 20` | The overlay slot is root-scoped, so it receives no chat hooks. The chat-driven toolview components publish a start/result notice into a module-local observable that this entry injects as `useTowerNotice`; a single timer auto-dismisses it after 4.5 s and is disposed by `ctx.effect`. |
| Locale | Client locale service | namespace `tower-ui` (`en`, `zh`) | Bound `t` seats come from each registration's `locale` option. |

The cards are deliberately compact: mission status/counts, task checklist progress, blockers, roster live/stale counts, review verdict, merge/preflight state, and check/test evidence (exit codes included). All of it is rendered as React elements with inline styles; **theme references are restricted to `--dsw-alias-*` tokens**, so light/dark and token renames degrade gracefully.

The overlay strip is `pointer-events: none` end-to-end and uses `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`; it never blocks the composer or the page.

## Source layout (#71)

The bundle is split along the surfaces above. `client.js` is the entry: it owns
the diagnostics seam and the registrations, and loads the package-local chunks
through the DSH client module system's `require.async("./client.<surface>.js")`
(bundles execute as classic scripts, so the entry cannot require a sibling
synchronously). Every chunk registers through the same `window.__ModuleLoader__`
surface as `{ id: 'dsh-tower-ui', chunk: 'client.<surface>.js', factory }` and
receives the shared helpers/styles/locales through the `env` the entry composes;
no chunk reaches the Host or another chunk.

| File | Surface |
|---|---|
| `client.js` | entry: diagnostics, `apply`, the five registrations |
| `client.toolview.js` | toolview card: lifecycle + `TowerToolCard` |
| `client.cards.js` | the per-tool card models behind the card |
| `client.dock.js` | composer dock: mode chip, unknown state, latest summary |
| `client.mode.js` | history-derived mode model + observable |
| `client.denied.js` | mode-aware `Tower mode · disabled` rows |
| `client.overlay.js` | transient `shell.overlay` status strip + notice store |
| `client.locales.js` | `en`/`zh` dictionaries and the `t`-seat helpers |
| `client.styles.js` | the `--dsw-alias-*` inline style table |
| `client.helpers.js` | tool vocabulary + defensive payload helpers |
| `index.js` | Host half (empty `apply`) |

The client tier is gated by `scripts/architecture.mjs` like any other source
root: `client-no-node` (no `node:*` imports; DOM globals are fine),
`client-size` (800-line ceiling per file) and `client-ambient` (no module-level
`let`; state lives in the `create*` closure), each with a seeded fixture in
`tests/architecture.test.mjs`. Every client source file stays under 400 lines
and the split preserves the pre-split line total within 10%
(`tests/ui-bundle.test.mjs`).

## Persistent Tower-mode indicator (#11)

Tower mode is a Host-side session stance and there is no Client RPC for it. The dock derives it from the durable session history that the Chat projection exposes in `useChat(snapshot.legacy)`:

- the `/tower on|off` command node (`kind: "command"`, `name: "tower"`, `args`, `outcome.kind`); bare `/tower` and `/tower <message>` mean "ensure on", while `/tower ack`, `/tower takeover [reason]`, `/tower reload` and `/tower base <branch>` operate on other state and leave the stance unchanged; a failed command is ignored;
- `tower_mode` results (`mode: "on" | "off" | "unknown"`, `deniedWhileActive`, `workspaceLock`, `lastChange`), including a write acknowledgement (`action: enter|exit|takeover`, `mode`, `changedBy`, `reason`); a `tower_control` result recorded before 2.9.0 is still read from older history.

The last recognized event wins. A page refresh re-derives the same stance from the loaded history; when that history window no longer contains a mode event, the dock falls back to a browser-local last-known value for the same session and labels it as such. An old value expires after seven days and never drives the denied-tool shadowing by itself.

While the mode is on the dock shows a `Tower · on` chip with `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`, and its tooltip carries the actionable hint plus, when known, the repository basename, workspace-lock state (`held`/`free`), and who changed the mode last. The chip is **deliberately non-interactive**: the only existing standard affordance is `inputActions.setDraft` + `inputActions.submit`, which submits the composer draft and would clobber what the user is typing. The tooltip tells the user to run `/tower off`; the bundle itself does not toggle the mode (the model's supported path is the Host `tower_mode` tool with `active: true|false` and a non-empty `reason` — plus `authorization` for a takeover — when `allowAgentControl` is enabled).

## Mode-aware denied-tool rows (#12)

The Host guard returns a plain tool error like `tower mode: <tool> is disabled while Tower mode is active; use the Tower tools or run /tower off`, or — for an agent in a repository whose workspace lock another Tower session holds — `tower mode: <tool> is disabled because this repository is under Tower mode (…); run /tower off in that session first, or /tower takeover <reason> here once it is gone`.

While the displayed session is in Tower mode the bundle dynamically registers `tool.call.toolview` entries for:

- `tower_mode.deniedWhileActive` when the latest `tower_mode` output lists it, otherwise the static mirror of `domain/deny-owners.js` `DEFAULT_DENY_TOOLS` — every tool the foreign orchestration owners register (`create_goal`, `get_goal`, `update_goal`, `interrupt_agent`, `list_agents`, `send_message`, `spawn_teammate`, `subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `team_task_create`, `team_task_get`, `team_task_list`, `team_task_update`, `todo_write`, `wait_agent`, `workflow`, `ralph`);
- `update_goal` also when an older `tower_mode` result (≤ 2.8.0, whose list omitted it) is the latest visible one.

Those entries register with `priority: -10`. The slot core renders the lowest priority for a key, so this shadows the native keyed views without replacing them; disposing the entries (mode off) restores the native views exactly. A denial result renders as a distinct **`Tower mode · disabled`** row (warn marker, label, the preserved denial message, and the `/tower off` hint) — not the generic error text styling. `update_goal` resume denials get the same row. A non-denial result that lands in one of those slots while the mode is on renders a defensive generic row (there is no native view to delegate to while the registration shadows it); ordinary tool errors are not misclassified as Tower-mode denials.

## Accessibility and persisted state contract

The bundle is a status surface, not an interactive control surface, so the
minimum contract is deliberately small and test-enforced in
`tests/ui-bundle.test.mjs`:

- **Dock chip / unknown state**: `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`,
  `aria-atomic="true"`, and an `aria-label` carrying the same text as the
  tooltip. The chip is non-interactive on purpose (see above), so it has no
  focus target and no click handler.
- **Dock summary**: `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`, `aria-atomic="true"`,
  and an `aria-label` with the tool label plus the localized summary text.
- **Tool cards**: `role="group"` with the card headline as `aria-label`;
  `aria-busy="true"` while the call is running. Rows whose tone is
  error/warning/success also carry `data-tower-tone`, `role="note"`, and an
  `aria-label` of the localized tone word plus the row text, so status is never
  conveyed by colour alone.
- **Overlay strip**: `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`,
  `aria-atomic="true"`, `aria-label` equal to the notice text, and
  `pointer-events: none` end-to-end.
- **Review-policy settings control** (root `client.js`, native radios): the
  section is a labelled group with a heading, the radiogroup is named by the
  heading and described by the intro, each input is labelled and described by
  its option spans, and the current/saved state is `role="status"` with
  `aria-live="polite"`/`aria-atomic="true"`. The restart note, inserted only
  after a save away from a profile that started with review off, is
  `role="note"` with `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"` so the
  dynamic insertion is announced instead of silently appearing beside the
  "Saved." status. Keyboard and focus behaviour is the browser's native radio
  group; nothing is implemented with a div that only looks interactive.

The dock stores a last-known mode per browser session. It validates the whole
snapshot before display (plain object, exact keys, boolean `on`, bounded text,
`denied` and `lock` shapes, a sane timestamp, and a 4 KiB raw cap) and discards
foreign, corrupt, stale or oversized values in a `try`/`catch`; storage failure
never breaks the dock, which then falls back to the history-derived model.

The client locale dictionary is gated in `tests/locale-copy.test.mjs`: the test
loads `client.locales.js` as a browser chunk, requires identical `en`/`zh` key
sets, and runs the shared copy gate for empty text, the glossary terms and
untranslated English. The banned config-key/tool-id/command/module rules are
not applied to this dictionary because a few tooltips intentionally quote
`/tower` and `tower_mode`.

## Verification status

Verified **statically** against the installed DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** sources:

- `tool.call.toolview`: declared by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool` as `{ kind: "keyed", scope: "session" }`; the Chat tool-call tree dispatches with `entryKey = toolName` and passes `{ callId, toolName, ...call, openFile, cwd, home, loadImage, useDisclosure, inspect }`, where `call` is `{ phase, block }`. A keyed hit replaces the generic tool row; a miss falls back to it.
- Keyed priority/shadowing: the Client slot core (in the web shell bundle) allows a second keyed registration only at a different `priority` and resolves a key with the **lowest** priority first — `register at a different priority to shadow it (lowest renders)`. Native views use the default priority 0.
- `conversation.composer.dock`: declared by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` as `{ kind: "list", scope: "session" }`, rendered as `div[data-composer-dock]`. Owner props are empty; session-scope standard props (including `useSession`, `useChat`, `useConversation`) are supplied by the renderer.
- `shell.overlay`: declared by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` as `{ kind: "list", scope: "root" }`, rendered inside `[data-shell-overlay]`. Root standard props are `useSessions`, `useSessionStatus`, `useWorkspaces`, `usePanelInfo` and keyed access hooks — **no chat hook**; hence the toolview-published notice design above.
- `/tower` history: DSH logs `command/run` with `{ name, args: parsed.rawInput, source }` and `command/done` with `{ kind, text }`, which the Chat command node exposes as `{ kind: "command", name, args, outcome }` in the legacy slice.
- Guard denial shape: the Host tools pipeline materializes a denial as `{ content: [{ type: "text", text: "Error: <reason>" }], isError: true, error: { message: <reason> } }`.
- Locale: `ctx.locale.register(ns, { en, zh })`, dictionaries are flat `key → template` maps with `{param}` interpolation; a slot declaration's `locale` option supplies the bound `t` seat.
- The bundle's `dsh.client.inject` orders activation after `ui-conversation` and `ui-tool`, the two packages that declare the slots it targets. `ctx.slots.inject` only installs a registration while its owner declaration exists; each injection is guarded and reported in diagnostics instead of crashing the whole Client half.

Automated offline coverage: `tests/ui-bundle.test.mjs` loads `client.js` through a fake `window.__ModuleLoader__` (and each split chunk through the same loader when the entry calls `require.async`), asserts the 12 keys / dock id / overlay id, en–zh dictionary parity, theme-token discipline, every file's loader format and the split-size budget, and renders every card plus the dock/overlay components with fake hooks. It also drives fake chat history through the dock to assert the off hint, the on chip (including refresh re-derivation), `tower_mode`/command updates, dynamic registration for default and configured deny lists, disposal on mode off, `update_goal`, denial-row treatment, generic fallbacks, and locale parity — no browser required.

Live/browser verification is **opt-in** (`tests/live/ui-slots.cjs`) because it needs an isolated profile with the bundle installed. From a teammate/subagent session the Client `Slots` inspect query times out by design (the page answers only the agent whose session it displays), so this phase did not run a live inspection; the source-level contract above is the evidence. When the script runs against an installed profile it binds a session with a bare `/tower` command and asserts, through the read-only `window.__TOWER_UI_DIAG__` report, that apply() ran without errors, that all 12 toolview keys and the dock/overlay entries registered, that the dock outlet is visible, and — since the bind command turns the Host mode on — that the history-derived `Tower · on` chip rendered (#11). The chip can be inspected visually in the same run (`data-tower-ui="dock-mode"`).

`tests/live/ui-slots.cjs` prints `SKIP` and exits 0 when `DSH_TEST_URL` (or Playwright) is missing; it never installs anything and never opens the desktop profile. Set `DSH_TEST_EXPECT_HINT=1` when the bundle is installed so a missing client module or missing dock entry fails instead of skipping the assertion, and `DSH_TEST_EXPECT_MODE=1` to require the history-derived `Tower · on` chip after the script's `/tower` bind step (otherwise that check is a warning, since the bind step is best-effort).

## Why it is a separate bundle

It is not installed by default and does not affect installing or running the Host `dsh-tower` plugin. The Host plugin is fully functional without it; the UI half only decorates the conversation that is already on screen.

## Install (isolated profile only)

```text
# throwaway profile, not the desktop profile
dsh --profile towertest --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile towertest add <absolute path to this ui-bundle>
dsh --profile towertest --port 59001 --no-open
# open the tokenized URL printed at boot, then verify:
$env:DSH_TEST_URL='http://127.0.0.1:59001/?token=<token>'
$env:DSH_TEST_EXPECT_HINT='1'; node tests/live/ui-slots.cjs
```

From a session in that profile, `plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to this ui-bundle>" })` performs the same add + enable. Do not install it into the live desktop profile without the user's explicit request.

## Remove

```text
dsh plugin --profile towertest remove dsh-tower-ui
```

Without HMR a bundle that has been running since process start may need a DSH restart for removal; with HMR a reconcile can unload it. A page refresh (or hard refresh) is enough to update the Client half after a linked-directory change.

## Known limitations

- **No live Host state / no new RPC.** The mode chip is inferred from the **loaded history window** of the displayed session. If the `/tower on` command (or a `tower_mode` result) sits outside that window, the dock falls back to the static hint and the mode-aware rows are not registered; a later `/tower`, `tower_mode`, or pre-2.9.0 control result corrects it. The dock summary is likewise the latest visible Tower tool result, not a dashboard, and does not poll.
- **Mode-driven registration is slot-global.** The dock follows the displayed session. While that session is in Tower mode, the denied-tool shadow entries also apply to other sessions' rows for those tools (they render the defensive generic row); leaving the mode disposes them globally and restores the native views.
- **A custom `mode.denyTools` list needs a `tower_mode` result in the visible history.** The dock learns `deniedWhileActive` only from a `tower_mode` output; if the mode was inferred from `/tower on` alone (or the `tower_mode` result is outside the loaded window), the bundle shadows the default list instead, and a custom denied tool falls back to the native error row until a `tower_mode` output appears.
- **The on-chip is not a button.** `inputActions.submit()` submits the composer draft, so programmatically sending `/tower off` would overwrite the user's draft; the actionable tooltip asks the user to run it. There is no click handler and no automatic toggle from the bundle; the Host `tower_mode` tool (a write with `active`) remains the model's supported path.
- **The overlay is root-scoped.** It cannot read chat state directly, so a result that lands while every Tower toolview is unmounted (for example the user switches sessions before the result renders) shows no strip. The strip itself carries no actionable content by design.
- A tool result whose payload is not JSON (older/foreign shape) renders as a plain one-line summary rather than a card; errors render as an error card.
- Client bundle updates are not auto-rebuilt: edit → reconcile/link → **refresh the page**. Profile patch or manifest changes may need a restart.
- `window.__TOWER_UI_DIAG__` is a read-only diagnostic seam for tests. It contains no session content — only plugin version, applied flag, slot/toolview names, current mode summary, dynamic deny keys, and guarded registration errors.

# dsh-tower

[![CI](https://github.com/louifinn/dsh-tower/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/louifinn/dsh-tower/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-tower.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tower)
[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/louifinn/dsh-tower)
[![Listed on dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/louifinn/dsh-tower)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/louifinn/dsh-tower?ref=badge)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[English](README.en.md)

**Tower** 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的多代理编排插件。它把一个 agent 会话变成一个小型工程团队：会话本身是*控制塔*，worker agent 在隔离的 Git worktree 里实现任务，改动经 scope/合并门禁合入基线分支；独立审查可在配置中强制开启。

Tower 模式与 mission/审查工作流的灵感来自 Moonshot AI 的 **Kimi Code** 中实验性的 Tower 模式（[Kimi Code](https://www.kimi.com/code)）。本项目是面向 DSH 的独立实现，与 Moonshot AI 无隶属关系；详见[致谢](#致谢)。

仓库根目录**就是** DSH bundle 包根：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`cordis.patch.yml` 位于根目录，符合 DSH 插件规范。

## 特性

- **可配置的 Tower 模式。** `/tower` 切换会话级模式：收窄工具面并注入 Tower 协议；`/tower on|off <指令>` 还能把指令作为下一步用户消息转发给模型。默认也允许 Agent 通过 `tower_mode({active:true/false})` 带理由进出；设 `mode.allowAgentControl:false` 可改为仅人类控制。
- **显式的所有权交接。** 仓库状态绑定初始化它的会话。旧会话结束后，新会话可用 `/tower takeover <原因>` 接管（人类命令，任何配置都可用）；模型也可在 Tower 模式中通过 `tower_mode({active:"takeover", authorization:"<审计引用>"})` 请求接管，但必须得到用户明确批准。旧属主仍活跃、仍有运行中的 roster Agent 或外部工作区锁时会拒绝；交接保留全部历史与未读消息，并写入一条 `takeover` 活动记录，不会自动释放所有权。
- **任务级隔离。** 每个 mission 使用独立分支和 Git worktree，worker 不会碰到你的主检出。
- **三种 mission 形状，一个注册表。** 每个 mission 是 `build`、`survey` 或 `artifact`，其状态、完成证据、
  供给方式、路径权限与 spawn 契约都由 shape 拥有，不再散落 `if (kind === …)` 分支。survey 只读：
  固定一个 `readCommit`（默认在 detached sandbox 中）即可完成，不需要提交、分支或合并。artifact 与
  build 一样使用 worktree，声明具体的交付物路径，并且只凭人类对已提交末端（tip）的接受记录合并，
  而不是审查。
  `npm run shape:audit` 会拒绝第二套词汇、`domain/shapes/` 之外的按 kind 条件、
  `domain/evidence.js` 之外的证据读取，以及角色检查与 shape 检查混合的写法。
- **审查门禁合并。** 审查策略是插件页上的一个三态控件：`off`、`optional`（默认）或 `required`（配置键 `review.mode`）。设为 `required` 时，审查者针对当前分支 tip 给出 `clean` / `merge` 结论；合并门禁重新校验 scope、分支新鲜度、任务完成度、审查记录与 worktree 归属，通过后才执行 `--no-ff` 合并。独立审查默认可选；策略为 `required` 时，单个 mission 可用 `reviewPolicy:"none"` + 理由并开启 `gates.allowReviewExemption:true` 做更窄豁免。升级提示：旧的布尔审查开关是保留一个版本的别名；映射关系见[安装、升级与迁移](docs/zh/guide/install-upgrade-migration.md)。
- **可恢复的协作状态。** roster、inbox、findings、reviews 与 mission 状态持久化在 `.git/dsh-tower/` 下，重启不会丢计划。
- **受控的状态增长。** worktree 已移除的终态任务在达到 `archive.afterDays`/`archive.maxMissions` 后移入 `.git/dsh-tower/archive/`，保留 tasks、reviews、findings 与完成报告；此后 mutation 只重写活跃工作。`tower_inspect({view:"status", includeArchived:true})` 列出压缩后的归档摘要，`tower_inspect({view:"doctor"})` 报告归档大小、数量与策略。
- **默认安全。** Tower 模式开启期间拒绝 `create_goal`、`update_goal(resume)`、`todo_write`、Team 任务板与 `spawn_teammate`；被暂停的 goal 不会被自动恢复。
- **可追溯的 finding 生命周期。** `tower_finding` 按 `open → triaged → fixed` / `wontfix` 列表、读取与流转，也可重新打开；只有 tower 或 worker 能改状态，reviewer 只能读。
- **仓库级配置。** 每个仓库可用 `<git-common-dir>/dsh-tower/config.json` 覆盖 review/merge/worktree/spawn 策略，工具参数再覆盖仓库配置；无需为不同仓库改 profile。
- **稳定错误码。** 工具失败统一带 `[tower:<code>]` 前缀（如 `mission-not-found`、`preset-missing`、`config-invalid`），调用方可稳定分支处理。
- **角色强制与可控中断。** worker 不能直接完成/放弃 mission 或扩界（完成必须走 `tower_complete` 证据门），tower 可随时用 `tower_interrupt` 停止跑偏的 agent；`tower_send(interrupt:true)` 可中止运行中的 turn。
- **仓库互斥与限流。** 可选 `mode.workspaceLock` 让同一仓库只有一个 Tower 会话；`spawn.maxLiveWorkers`、`send.maxPerMinute`、roster stale 标记约束并发与消息风暴。
- **可热重载。** 在带 DSH HMR 的 profile 中，`/tower reload`、`tower_reload` 与 `npm run dev:hmr` 让 linked 插件代码改动无需重启即生效；`plugin_manager` 安装/更新本身即时生效。
- **测试证据门与事件。** worker 可在 `tower_complete` 记录 `checks`，`gates.requireChecks` 可强制；每次 mutation 后发射 `tower/*` 事件并刷新 `MISSIONS.md`。
- **2.1 验证与运营。** `tower_test` 执行 worktree 声明的 `tower.testDiscovery`（TAP/json-array，准入可设 spawn/complete），`tower_inspect` 的 `doctor` 视图提供只读健康契约，`tower_batch` 批次证据收口，`tower_resource` advisory lease，`tower_import` 只读旧版导入与审计映射；新增 `worker-stale`、tests 门禁、plan/tower 互斥、`workspaceLockScope`、`docs.boardLocation` 与交付 ack。

## 何时使用 Tower

Tower 是**面向 Git 仓库变更的交付协议**，不是所有多代理场景的默认答案。它适合：

- 一个特性/重构能拆成 2–8 个 scope 清晰、可独立审查的 mission；
- 有依赖顺序、需要分支新鲜度与 scope 约束的迁移；
- 敏感仓库、发布绑定变更，或需要"可审计合并 + 测试证据"（需要时开启独立审查）的工作；
- 跨上下文压缩、重启、多天协作，需要从本地状态恢复的工作；
- 需要把"完成"定义成任务 + 测试（可选独立审查），而不是聊天里的一句"好了"。

不适合：单文件/一行 hotfix、需求仍在探索、开放式研究、大量极小的独立任务、交互式 UI 配对、或跨仓库工作。判断标准：**如果你不会为它开 PR，Tower 很可能太重。**

与其他模式的区别（详见[完整指南](docs/guide/scenarios-and-philosophy.md)）：

- **普通并行子代理**：便宜、灵活，适合只读探索/试方案；没有 worktree、审查与合并门禁。
- **Agent Teams**：共享任务板与多人/多 agent 协作，适合设计、研究、横切决策；集成通常由人做，没有 Git 隔离的硬门禁。
- **Ralph 循环**：用新鲜 agent 对同一目标反复尝试，适合迭代搜索/修复；没有 mission 契约与合并审查。
- **Workflow 编排**：脚本化高扇出/流水线，适合批量分析、审计、验证；不做 Git 分支隔离与合并门禁。
- **Tower**：少量 mission + 隔离写入 + 可选独立审查 + 证据 + 合并门禁，适合"决定要做、需要安全落地"的仓库变更。

Tower 模式会拒绝 Team/Workflow/Ralph/普通 subagent 工具并清除 plan mode，避免两套编排协议同时驱动一个会话；请按阶段组合，例如先用 Workflow/Team 分析决策，再用 Tower 执行仓库变更。

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.3`（已验证的 host 构建见 [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md)）
- Node.js 24.9+
- Git（worktree 在本地创建，不需要联网）

`scripts/support.json` 是唯一的公开支持基线。当 package engines、mount-smoke host pin、live CI 矩阵
或 COMPATIBILITY 最新行与它不一致时，`npm run support:check` 会失败。

## 安装

把已发布的包安装到 DSH profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tower
```

在 DSH 中也可以用插件管理器指定同一目标：

```text
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-tower" })
```

开发时改为从 GitHub 安装或链接本地 checkout：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:louifinn/dsh-tower
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本仓库的绝对路径>
```

Host 插件在 DSH 进程启动时加载，**安装或更新后需重启 DSH**。卸载使用 `remove_bundle`，包名 `dsh-tower`。

可选的 Web UI 随 npm 包一起发布在 `ui-bundle/`：npm 安装后目标为
`<profile>/node_modules/dsh-tower/ui-bundle`，源码安装时为目标仓库的 `ui-bundle/` 目录。用
`plugin_manager({action:"install_bundle", target:"<该目录>"})` 安装并重启 DSH，然后刷新页面。

### 已知冲突

不要同时安装 `dsh-plugins-tower`（第三方包）。它的 loader row 也使用 `name: dsh-tower`，会解析到
本包，导致本包被加载两次或对方代码不生效。`tower_inspect` 的 `doctor` 视图的 `loader-conflicts` 检查会报告该情况；
卸载冲突包并重启 DSH。

## 快速开始

```text
/tower on

tower_init      repoRoot=D:\work\repo            # 首次初始化，记录 base（默认当前分支）
tower_plan      repoRoot=D:\work\repo missions=[{"title":"Feature A","scope":["src/a/**"],"tasks":["implement","commit"],"kind":"build"}]
tower_spawn     repoRoot=D:\work\repo missionId=M1 role=worker
# worker 在 worktree 内实现并提交，调用 tower_complete；最终报告会返回本会话
# 可选：需要强制独立审查时，先设 review.mode:required
tower_spawn     repoRoot=D:\work\repo missionId=M1 role=reviewer
# reviewer 只读审查并调用 tower_review（clean+merge 或 p1-Nitems/p2-Nitems）
tower_inspect   view=preflight repoRoot=D:\work\repo missionId=M1    # 默认审查可选（review.mode:optional）；设为 review.mode:required 时审查前预期 no-review，审查后 ok:true
tower_merge     repoRoot=D:\work\repo missionId=M1
tower_teardown  repoRoot=D:\work\repo

/tower off
```

小改动通常一轮 worker 即可完成；需要独立审查时再加一轮 reviewer。完整可复制示例见 [docs/examples/first-mission.md](docs/examples/first-mission.md)，逐工具参数见 [docs/reference/tools.md](docs/reference/tools.md)。

## 命令

| 输入 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `/tower` | 开启 Tower 模式（已开启则保持） |
| `/tower on` | 开启或保持 |
| `/tower on <指令>` | 开启/保持，并把 `<指令>` 作为下一条用户消息转发 |
| `/tower off` | 退出 Tower 模式 |
| `/tower off <指令>` | 退出并转发 `<指令>` |
| `/tower ack` | 记录人类确认，供 `mode.requireHumanAckOnFirstEntry` 使用 |
| `/tasks`、`/tower tasks` | 只读实时 roster 面板（不消耗模型回合、不写状态）；宿主已占用 `/tasks` 名字时使用 `/tower tasks` |
| `/tower <指令>` | 确保开启，然后转发 `<指令>` |

图片与文件附件会随指令一起作为一条完整的 `UserMessage` 转发。

运行时前置条件（preset 行、组件行与配置的冲突）只在**进入**模式的路径上重新校验：
裸 `/tower`、`/tower on`、`/tower on <指令>`，以及模式关闭时的 `/tower <指令>`。已经开启
模式后的 `/tower <指令>`、`/tower off`、`/tower off <指令>` 与 `/tower ack` 不再重复校验，
因此会话中途关掉某一行之后，人仍然退得出去、指令也仍然转发得出去；`tower_spawn`、规划与
合并/预检各自保留自己的护栏。详见 [组件行与消息语言](docs/guide/quickstart.md#component-rows-runtime-preconditions-and-message-language)。

## 组件模型

本 bundle 采用 **强制 host 锚点 + 可单独启停的可选行**（#121）：`cordis.patch.yml` 插入顶层
`tower` group（挂载 Host 插件与强制的 `preset-tower-worker`），随后是可选组件 `tower-skills`、
`tower-batch`、`tower-import`、`tower-leases`、`tower-tests`、`tower-hmr`（随包关闭）与
`preset-tower-reviewer`。在插件页关闭某一行，只会移除该能力；模式、规划工具、`tower_inspect`
与其余工具继续工作。

进入 Tower 模式与 `tower_plan` 前会校验必需的 preset。worker preset 是强制依赖；reviewer
preset 只在 `review.mode` 为 `required` 时必需，因此策略为 `off` 或 `optional` 时允许关闭
reviewer 行，策略为 `required` 时会以带解释的 `preset-missing` 锁定。`tower-tests` 关闭且
`gates.requireTests:true` 时同样拒绝。`tower_inspect` 的 `doctor` 视图与 `tower_recover` 不是组件、也没有配置键：
任何配置都会注册它们（#122）。

原则 11（[PRINCIPLES.md](PRINCIPLES.md)）与
[ADR 0005](docs/adr/0005-component-surface.md) 要求：只有关闭后仍不破坏其余能力的 capability
才能成为组件；host、健康检查、恢复通道与合并门禁永远不是开关。审查策略是唯一的
三态配置控件（off/optional/required），不是组件行。逐键答案见生成的
[组件表面](docs/reference/component-surface.md)，由 `npm run docs:check:components` 强制。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: tower-host
  name: 'dsh-tower'
  config:
    section: '（可选，兼容别名）覆盖 Tower 模式系统提示文案'
    allowAgentControl: true   # 兼容别名；等价于 mode.allowAgentControl
    mode:
      allowAgentControl: true
      autoPauseGoal: true
      # denyTools 默认等于外部编排组件注册的全部工具（Agent Teams、goal、
      # todo、ralph、subagent、workflow）；显式列表会替换该默认值，
      # 仓库层配置只能在其上扩展
    review:
      mode: optional             # 一个三态控件：off、optional（默认）或 required
      maxRoundsPerReviewer: 5
    merge:
      timeoutMs: 900000
    worktrees:
      root: ''                 # 空 = <主检出父目录>/.dsh-tower-worktrees/<hash>
    spawn:
      workerPreset: tower-worker
      reviewerPreset: tower-reviewer
      maxDepth: 1
```

- 代码中 `mode.allowAgentControl` 默认 `true`；随包 `cordis.patch.yml` 也显式设为 `true`：模型可在用户意图/任务状态明确时自行进出，但必须给出理由；设为 `false` 时只有人类能切换。随包 patch 还默认开启 `mode.workspaceLock`（单活塔）、`send.interruptDefault`、`init.autoGitInit`，并把 `spawn.staleMs` 设为 15s。
- `/tower base <branch>` 可设置会话级 init base 偏好；`/tower on` 会清除活跃 plan mode（`mode.planModePolicy:"refuse"` 则拒绝进入），保证 plan/tower 互斥；Tower 与 Ralph 循环同样按仓库互斥（`mode.ralphPolicy`，见 [ADR 0010](docs/adr/0010-tower-ralph-mutual-exclusion.md)）。
- 仓库级配置：在 `<git-common-dir>/dsh-tower/config.json`（通常是 `.git/dsh-tower/config.json`）放入同样的 JSON 结构，可覆盖 `review`/`merge`/`worktrees`/`spawn`；优先级为代码默认 < profile < 仓库配置 < 工具参数。`mode.*` 属于会话级，只在 profile 生效。
- 所有键与默认值见 [docs/reference/config.md](docs/reference/config.md)；未知键（顶层与分组内）都会被拒绝，防止拼写错误静默失效。三种审查模式、插件页控件位置与单版本别名迁移见[安装、升级与迁移](docs/zh/guide/insta

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 财搭子研究看板 · DSH 插件

四张可更新的研究看板：**存储价格与利润、AI 基建成本与回报、PCB／CCL 升级兑现、美国政策与数据中心**。复用财搭子 Logo、大发头像与白蓝界面，通过财搭子 MCP 获取行情和证据，在 DSH 原生会话继续研究。

![美国政策与数据中心看板](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/markthc/dsh-caidazi-boards/main/docs/policy-board.png)

## 界面语言 / Language

顶部语言菜单提供「跟随系统 / 简体中文 / English」。首次使用跟随 DSH 内嵌浏览器或当前浏览器报告的首选语言。手动选择保存在当前浏览器，返回「跟随系统」后继续响应语言变化。其他语言默认使用英文。

四张看板的研究正文、指标单位、图表、州地图、连接提示和追问均支持中英切换。外部检索文章标题与摘录保留原文。切换语言保留当前栏目、测算参数与正在运行的更新。

The language menu supports System, 简体中文 and English. System follows the language preferences reported by the DSH webview or browser. Manual choices persist in that browser. Research, charts, map labels, connection states and follow-up prompts are localized. Retrieved article titles and excerpts retain their original language.

## 安装与使用

v0.3.2 支持 **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 / rc.2**，不需要 `allow-version`。命令行版需要 Node.js 24.9.0+；官方 Desktop 使用自带运行环境。

Desktop 在 Plugins 中安装以下 URL，然后重新打开财搭子看板；若仍显示旧版，重启 DSH：

```text
https://github.com/markthc/dsh-caidazi-boards/releases/download/v0.3.2/caidazi-dsh-boards-0.3.2.tgz
```

Web 可从 npm 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @caidazi/dsh-boards@0.3.2
dsh web
```

也可使用 GitHub Release 安装包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/markthc/dsh-caidazi-boards/releases/download/v0.3.2/caidazi-dsh-boards-0.3.2.tgz
dsh web
```

1. 打开侧栏「财搭子看板」。无 Key 时仅显示内置研究及静态测算，不请求行情或公共快照。
2. 连接财搭子：App → 大发 → 左侧菜单 → 我的skill → 领取 API Key／我的API KEY管理。实际行情验证成功后保存至 DSH 凭据区，不进入聊天、URL或公共仓库。
3. 政策板使用「核心判断 → 政策进展 → 州级分布 → 关联行情」，地图点选与州选择器联动。其他看板阅读「核心判断 → 产业证据 → 经营数据 → 市场定价」。顶部「更新看板」同步研究版本、报价、K线和最新线索。研究内容较多时按栏目展开，不在结论页堆全部数据。
4. 「继续研究」将问题、已发布研究版本及用户情景参数带入 DSH 会话草稿，检查后发送。需要 DSH 已配置可用模型。

## 内容与数据

| 看板 | 研究与量化内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 存储产业跟踪 | 利基／主流／HBM／供给四个维度；DDR 8Gb两个月合约价对比、SK hynix收入/经营利润/净利润、三星资本开支；兆易、美光K线 |
| AI 基建 · 成本与回报 | 需求→交付→计费、资金、回报与供给约束；CoreWeave收入、经营现金流与现金PP&E、资金承诺拆分、可调回报测算；中际旭创、微软、英伟达、CoreWeave K线 |
| 美国政策与数据中心 | 联邦/州/地方政策状态；51州及DC地图、2026当选与现任州长、JLL在建容量、Cleanview楼栋阶段、EIA用电/电价预测；VRT、ETN、DLR K线 |
| PCB／CCL · 升级兑现 | 规格、认证、排单、现金兑现；胜宏HDI收入/毛利、现金流/扩张支出；生益、沪电、深南、胜宏K线 |

- **当前报价**来自财搭子 `get_real_time_record`，保留接口交易时间与币种。
- **日K**来自 Yahoo Finance 公共历史接口，约一年OHLCV。支持日/周K、3/6/12个月范围、20周期均线、成交量与悬停读数。周K由日K聚合，不把两天分钟数据拼成日K；缺失或损坏OHLC不补造。报价与历史行情来自不同来源，可能不同步。
- **资料检索**使用财搭子 `investment_search_pro`，按“主体＋主题”的短查询分维度检索。仅展示允许使用的标题链接及授权摘录；`citation_only` 不展示正文，`prohibited` 不进入模型。明确的原文发布时间优先于搜索索引日期；模糊日期冲突继续排除。报价资料页不作为研究事件。
- **经营图表**来自已核验公告或注明来源的报道转引，保留时期、单位和来源。不是所有公司指标都已变成自动更新的连续数据库。DDR报价原文未明确代际，不能映射为DDR5或HBM；只有两个披露点，不连成连续行情。
- **情景测算**仍为可修改假设：100亿元×15%÷24%=62.5亿元/年。目标是净利润／投产资本，不是IRR；不包含建设期、融资杠杆和追加投入。

### 最新公共研究：2026-11-16.1

已连接财搭子的 v0.3.0 插件点击「更新看板」即可读取，不需要重新安装。无 Key 预览仍使用随插件提供的内置版本。

- 存储：补入11/15海力士HBM4后道设备采购报道与11/13机构对单机HBM容量的风险观察；区分计划、观察和实际交付。
- AI：补入11/12 CoreWeave 10-Q的授信、到期本金和RPO确认期限，以及Meta已完成的90亿欧元票据发行；融资与投资回报分别判断。
- PCB/CCL：新增生益合并现金流对照图，补齐10/30三季报和11/11订单回应；加入11/13回购披露，明确员工持股/激励用途。
- 美国政策：Cleanview 11/16为1,448投运／577在建／2,653规划；36场州长选举均获ABC/AP判定，新增AK/KS胜者。补全电费保护9/30程序受阻和11月许可改革审议节点。

历史财务、产品价格、JLL 2026H1容量与EIA 11月预测保留原期次；本版发布日期不代表所有指标都是当日数据。不可变快照保留完整来源、计算口径和前版对照。

### v0.3.0内置政策数据范围（更新前）

- Cleanview：2026-11-11全国公开表，1,426已投运／537在建／2,675规划，单位楼栋；45个非零州，另6州/特区原页明确尚未收录。快照差额不解释为新投产/取消。
- 2026州长选举：11/12重读ABC/AP原始结果，34已判、AK/KS未判。现任资料保留11/5核验日期；媒体结果不是认证、就任、州政府统一控制或数据中心政策态度。
- JLL：2026H1，8个单州容量，整数GW约数；未列州和Louisiana在运值不填零。Texas图中9＋18与正文合计26GW的差异原样说明。
- EIA：11/10发布的STEO，模型截止11/5；2026/2027标预测。全美用电及居民价格不代表数据中心用电或合同电价。
- 政策原文：S.4214转委员会；Oakland11/10通过延期至2027-10-05，11/20衔接现行暂停期；Trump EO14318为联邦加速框架。电费保护仅呈现已核9/16、9/17程序，未推断11月最终阶段。
- 地图几何来自us-atlas / U.S. Census，许可随包保留；地理数据进入可更新快照，几何只在客户端内置。

## 一次更新具体做什么

消费者点击「更新看板」后并行：

1. 获取仓库 `research/latest-v2.json`，按版本读取不可变JSON快照并校验SHA256、字段、来源引用、日期、数值与图表期次。
2. 将已发布的结论、事实、图表、研究维度及“本版变化”一起更新；只接受数据，不执行远程HTML或JavaScript。
3. 通过用户自己的财搭子Key刷新公司报价、主题证据，并获取日K。

没有新研究版本时保留现有结论；新检索资料在「产业证据」单独显示。快照同步失败保留当前Host内的上次成功版本，重启后以内置版本兜底。个人Key和情景参数不进入公共快照。网页重载会重新取数；本版没有磁盘行情缓存或后台轮询。

v0.3.0采用schema v2和`latest-v2.json`；旧`latest.json`与v1快照保留，v0.2.0客户端仍可读取原三板。新增第四板需要升级一次插件，之后内容可独立更新。

公共入口：[latest-v2.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/markthc/dsh-caidazi-boards/main/research/latest-v2.json)。历史版本保留在 `research/snapshots/`。GitHub发布有传播延迟；它是当前公共内容分发方案，不是实时事件服务。

## 发布者的研究更新管线

**财搭子检索 → DSH模型生成差异候选 → 原文核验/编辑 → 版本化快照 → GitHub发布 → 所有用户更新读取。**

发布者使用有财搭子Key、已登录/配置模型的本地 DSH Web。`DSH_PUBLISHER_TOKEN` 是该本地Web启动时提供的登录token，不是财搭子Key。环境变量仅传给本地脚本，不提交到仓库。

```sh
# 使用本地 DSH 的默认模型和财搭子连接；结果只写本地候选文件。
DSH_PUBLISHER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8930 node scripts/research.mjs draft memory /tmp/memory-draft.json
# 同样支持 ai / pcb / policy。须先在环境中设置 DSH_PUBLISHER_TOKEN。

# 阅读review中的修改前后、来源、引句/计算式；核验原文后编辑snapshot。
# --reviewed表示操作者已完成审阅，脚本不会替你判断事实真假。
node scripts/research.mjs publish /tmp/reviewed-snapshot.json 2026-11-13.1 --reviewed

git diff -- research
git add research
git commit -m 'Update reviewed research snapshot'
git push origin HEAD:main
```

模型只返回得到来源支持的字段修改，并列出逐项差异；无实质证据返回 `unchanged` 或 `no-evidence`，不为显示“有更新”而改判断。候选稿不会自动覆盖已发布内容。发布脚本验证完整结构、要求版本递增且禁止覆盖已有文件。**格式与来源ID检查不能证明金融推理正确，公开发布仍须审阅。**

本轮实测：DSH DeepSeek模型生成存储候选；逐条核验后采用DRAM价格图与相关逻辑，未采用缺公告核验的公司财务转引。AI/PCB重复或不足的新材料返回“判断不变”。

## 定时与事件更新

DSH Schedule 到时向会话投递指令，模型与MCP执行；它不等于修改公共仓库。Host必须运行，退出/关机后不能按时执行。Webhook可接外部事件，但需要上游真实事件源。

公共研究适合由发布者运行同一条候选生成管线：按固定频率，或收到关键指标/公告事件后生成候选；审核通过再发布。用户只负责消费同一版本，不必每个人重复做研究。**当前已交付按需执行和手动审核发布；未创建定时任务、未部署常驻云端调度，也未接财搭子事件推送。**

[DSH Schedule](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/subsystems/schedule.md) · [Webhook](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/subsystems/webhook.md)

## 开发与边界

```sh
npm ci
npm test
npm run build
npm pack
```

`host.js` 接宿主和凭据，`data.js` 接财搭子检索/报价，`market.js` 接OHLCV，`publication.js` 校验/读取快照，`synthesis.js` 生成待审候选，`scripts/research.mjs` 处理发布者操作。8个财搭子官方 Skills 保留，rc.1使用宿主MCP Client，rc.2沿用MCP Manager；Electron子进程以Node模式启动。

接口沿用DSH浏览器认证、Host/Origin与owner权限。插件只读公共研究数据，不读取个人持仓、不改自选、不交易。配套官方Skills/MCP有个人资产工具，仅在用户后续明确请求时使用。Key额度、权益和撤销由财搭子服务端决定。DSH本地凭据文件不等于OS级密钥隔离。

仍需改进：完整产品价格与企业季度连续数据、行业横向覆盖、自动财报抽取核验、常驻事件/定时调度。公共快照是共享研究，尚不包含个人收藏/fork或账户定制。Yahoo接口无SLA，境内网络及数据授权需在产品化前确认；公司图表不能外推为行业整体。

代码MIT；品牌商标仍归财搭子。公开包不含个人Key、账户、测试响应、研究库原件或机构报告全文。插件已在[1024 Store](https://deepseek1024.com/plugins/markthc/dsh-caidazi-boards)收录，可下载[GitHub Release安装包](https://github.com/markthc/dsh-caidazi-boards/releases/tag/v0.3.2)。Plugin Hub与Plugin Radar的收录申请正在处理中。

研究发布时需在 `src/locales/en.json` 补齐新增正文的英文翻译。现有发布命令会检查覆盖范围，并同时准备 `research/locales/en.json`。英文文件绑定研究版本与原快照 SHA256，随研究快照提交发布后，用户更新即可获取。
